text: Porque así dice la Sabiduría toda virtuosa: He aquí yo derramaré por vosotros un dicho de mi aliento, y os enseñaré mi palabra.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Porque yo llamé y no obedeciste, y yo mantuve palabras y no escuchaste, sino que hice Mis consejos de ningún efecto, y fueron desobedientes a Mis reprensiones; por lo tanto también me reiré de tu destrucción, y me regocijaré sobre ti cuando la ruina venga sobre ti, y cuando la confusión te supere de repente, y tu derrocamiento está cerca como un torbellino,

title: 1 Clemente
text: o cuando me llames, sin embargo, no estaré aquí contigo. Los hombres malignos me buscarán y no me hallarán; porque odiaban la sabiduría, y no escogieron el temor del Señor, ni darían cabeza a Mis consejos, sino burlados de Mis reprensiones.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Por tanto, comerán los frutos de su propio camino, y serán llenos de su propia impiedad.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Porque por haber hecho mal a las chicas, serán muertos, y la inquisición destruirá a los impíos. Mas el que oye Yo moraré con seguridad confiando en la esperanza, y seré callado de todo temor a todo mal.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Por lo tanto, seamos obedientes a Su Nombre santísimo y glorioso, escapando así a las amenazas que se decían de antaño por la boca de la Sabiduría contra los que desobedecen, para que vivamos con seguridad, confiando en el Nombre Santísimo de Su Majestad.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Recibid nuestro consejo, y no tendréis ocasión de arrepentimiento. Porque como Dios vive, y el Señor Jesucristo vive, y el Espíritu Santo, que es la fe y la esperanza de los elegidos, así seguramente el que con humildad de mente e instante en mansedumbre ha cumplido sin arrepentimiento las ordenanzas y mandamientos que son dados por Dios, sea inscrito y tenga un nombre entre el número de los que son salvos a través de Jesucristo, por medio de los cuales la gloria a Él es para siempre y para siempre. Amén.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Pero si ciertas personas deben ser desobedientes a las palabras pronunciadas por Él a través de nosotros, comprendan que se enredarán en ninguna ligera transgresión y peligro;

title: 1 Clemente
text: pero no seremos culpables de este pecado. Y pediremos, con urgencia de oración y súplica, que el Creador del universo guarde intacto hasta el final el número que ha sido numerado de Sus elegidos por todo el mundo, a través de Su Hijo amado Jesucristo, a través de quien Él nos llamó de la oscuridad a la luz, de la ignorancia al conocimiento completo de la gloria de Su Nombre.

title: 1 Clemente
text: [Grand a nosotros, Señor,] para que podamos poner nuestra esperanza en tu Nombre, que es la fuente primaria de toda la creación, y abrir los ojos de nuestros corazones, para que te conozcamos, que solo permanecemos al Altísimo en lo alto, Santo en lo santo; que la más baja en la insolencia de los orgullosos, que ponen a los humildes en lo alto, y matan a los nobles pobres;

title: 1 Clemente
text: Te rogamos, Señor y Maestro, que seas nuestra ayuda y succor. Salva a los que están en tribulación; ten misericordia de los humildes; levanta a los caídos; muéstrate a los necesitados; sana a los impíos; convierte a los vagabundos de tu pueblo; alimenta a los hambrientos; libera a nuestros prisioneros; levanta a los débiles; conforta a los desmayados. Que todos los gentiles sepan que Tú eres el Dios solo, y Jesucristo es tu Hijo, y nosotros somos tu pueblo y las ovejas de tu pasto.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Tú a través de Tus operaciones hiciste manifiesto el tejido eterno del mundo. Tú, Señor, creaste la tierra. Tú que eres fiel a través de todas las generaciones, justo en tus juicios, maravilloso en fuerza y excelencia, Tú que eres sabio en crear y prudente en establecer lo que has hecho, que eres bueno en las cosas que se ven y fiel con los que confían en Ti, piadoso y compasivo, perdona nuestras maldades y nuestras injusticias y nuestras transgresiones y deficiencias.

title: 1 Clemente
text: No os asignéis a nuestra cuenta todo pecado de vuestros siervos y de vuestras siervas, sino que nos limpian con la purificación de vuestra verdad, y guían nuestros pasos para andar en santidad y justicia y unicidad de corazón, y para hacer cosas buenas y agradables en Tu vista y ante los ojos de nuestros gobernantes.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Sí, Señor, hazlo Tu rostro brillará sobre nosotros en paz por nuestro bien, para que podamos ser protegidos por tu mano poderosa y liberados de todo pecado por tu brazo elevado. Y líbranos de los que nos odian injustamente.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Dad concordia y paz a nosotros y a todos los que moran en la tierra, como diste a nuestros padres, cuando te llamaron en fe y verdad con santidad, [para que seamos salvos] mientras damos obediencia a tu omnipotente y excelente Nombre, y a nuestros gobernantes y gobernadores sobre la tierra.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Tú, Señor y Maestro, les has dado el poder de la soberanía a través de tu excelente e indescriptible poder, para que nosotros, sabiendo la gloria y el honor que les has dado, nos sometamos a ellos, en nada resistiendo tu voluntad. Concédeles, Señor, paz de salud, concordia, estabilidad, para que administren el gobierno que les has dado sin fracaso.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Porque Tú, oh Maestro celestial, Rey de los siglos, da gloria a los hijos de los hombres, honor y poder sobre todas las cosas que están sobre la tierra. ¿Tú, Señor, diriges su consejo según lo que es bueno y agradable en Tu vista, para que, administrando en paz y mansedumbre con Diosa el poder que Tú les has dado, obtengan Tu favor.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Tú, que solo eres capaz de hacer estas cosas y cosas mucho más que estas para nosotros, alabamos Por medio del Sumo sacerdote y Guardián de nuestras almas, Jesucristo, por quien sea la gloria y la majestad para Ti ahora y para todas las generaciones y para siempre y para siempre. Amén.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Al tocar las cosas que se ajustan a nuestra religión y son más útiles para una vida virtuosa a los que guían [sus pasos] en santidad y justicia, os hemos escrito plenamente, hermanos.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Por lo que respecta a la fe, el arrepentimiento y el amor genuino y la templanza y la sobriedad y la paciencia hemos manejado todos los argumentos, poniéndolos en recuerdo, para que agradasen al Dios Todopoderoso en justicia y verdad y en largo sufrimiento con santidad, dejando de lado la malicia y persiguiendo la concordia en amor y paz, siendo instantáneos en mansedumbre; así como nuestros padres, de quienes hablamos antes, le agradamente, le a Él, siendo humildemente cuidadosos hacia su Padre y hacia todos los hombres y Creador.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Y os hemos puesto en mente estas cosas con más alegría, ya que sabíamos bien que escribíamos a hombres que son fieles y altamente contados y han buscado diligentemente en los oráculos de la enseñanza de Dios.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Por lo tanto, es justo para nosotros dar atención a tantos y tantos ejemplos y someter el cuello y ocupar el lugar de la obediencia para tomar nuestro lado con los que son los líderes de nuestras almas, que cesando de esta necia disensión podemos alcanzar el objetivo que nos miente en la veracidad, manteniendo alejado de toda culpa.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Porque nos daréis gran gozo y alegría, si hiciereis obediencia a las cosas escritas por nosotros a través del Espíritu Santo, y arraigaréis la ira injusta de vuestros celos, conforme a la virtud que hemos hecho para la paz y la concordia en esta carta.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Y también hemos enviado hombres fieles y prudentes que han caminado entre nosotros desde la juventud hasta la vejez, inquebrantablemente, que también serán testigos entre vosotros y nosotros.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Y esto hemos hecho para que sepáis que hemos tenido, y aún tenemos, toda solicitud que debéis ser rápidamente en paz.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Por último, que todos vean a Dios y a Maestro de Espíritus y Señor de toda carne, que eligieron al Señor Jesucristo, y a nosotros por medio de Él para un pueblo peculiar, conceda a cada alma llamada por Su Nombre excelente y santo fe, temor, paz, paciencia, paciencia, paciencia, paciencia, temperancia, castidad y sobriedad, para que sean bien agradables a Su Nombre por medio de nuestro Sumo sacerdote y guardián Jesucristo, por quien sea siempre gloria y maje. Amén.

title: 1 Clemente
text: Ahora envíennos rápidamente a nuestros mensajeros Claudio Efebus y Valerius Bito, junto con Fortunatus también, en paz y con alegría, hasta el final que ellos puedan informar más rápidamente la paz y la concordia que es orada por nosotros y deseada fervientemente, para que también podamos regocijarnos más rápidamente sobre su buen orden.

title: 1 Clemente
text: La gracia de nuestro Señor Jesucristo sea contigo y con todos los hombres en todos los lugares que han sido llamados por Dios y a través de Él, a través de los cuales sea gloria y honor, poder y grandeza y dominio eterno, para Él, desde los siglos pasado y para siempre y para siempre. Amén.

title: 1 Enoch
text: The words of the blessing of Enoch, wherewith he blessed the elect 〚and〛 righteous, who will be living in the day of tribulation, when all the wicked 〚and godless〛 are to be removed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he took up his parable and said—Enoch a righteous man, whose eyes were opened by God, saw the vision of the Holy One in the heavens, 〚which〛 the angels showed me, and from them I heard everything, and from them I understood as I saw, but not for this generation, but for a remote one which is for to come.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Concerning the elect I said, and took up my parable concerning them:

title: 1 Enoch
text: The Holy Great One will come forth from His dwelling,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the eternal God will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven ⌜of heavens⌝.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all shall be smitten with fear, And the Watchers shall quake, And great fear and trembling shall seize them unto the ends of the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the earth shall be ⌜wholly⌝ rent in sunder, And all that is upon the earth shall perish, And there shall be a judgement upon all (men).

title: 1 Enoch
text: But with the righteous He will make peace, And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they shall all belong to God, And they shall be prospered, And they shall ⌜all⌝ be blessed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: ⌜And He will help them all⌝, And light shall appear unto them, ⌜And He will make peace with them⌝.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of ⌜His⌝ holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy ⌜all⌝ the ungodly:

title: 1 Enoch
text: And to convict all flesh Of all the works ⌜of their ungodliness⌝ which they have ungodly committed, ⌜And of all the hard things which⌝ ungodly sinners ⌜have spoken⌝ against Him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Observe ye every thing that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, ⌜and⌝ the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Behold ye the earth, and give heed to the things which take place upon it from first to last, ⌜how =steadfast= they are⌝, how ⌜none of the things upon earth⌝ change, ⌜but⌝ all the works of God appear ⌜to you⌝.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Behold the summer and the winter, 〚how the whole earth is filled with water, and clouds and dew and rain lie upon it〛.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Observe and see how (in the winter) all the trees 〚seem〛 as though they had withered and shed all their leaves, except fourteen trees, which do not lose their foliage but retain the old foliage from two to three years till the new comes.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And again, observe ye the days of summer how the sun is above the earth over against it. And you seek shade and shelter by reason of the heat of the sun, and the earth also burns with glowing heat, and so you cannot tread on the earth, or on a rock by reason of its heat.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Observe 〚ye〛 how the trees cover themselves with green leaves and bear fruit: wherefore give ye heed ⌜and know⌝ with regard to all ⌜His works⌝, and recognize how He that liveth for ever hath made them so.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And ⌜all⌝ His works go on ⌜thus⌝ from year to year ⌜for ever⌝, and all the tasks ⌜which⌝ they accomplish for Him, and ⌜their tasks⌝ change not, but according as 〚God〛 hath ordained so is it done.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And behold how the sea and the rivers in like manner accomplish ⌜and change not⌝ their tasks ⌜from His commandments⌝.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But ye—ye have not been steadfast, nor done the commandments of the Lord, But ye have turned away and spoken proud and hard words With your impure mouths against His greatness. Oh, ye hard-hearted, ye shall find no peace.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Therefore shall ye execrate your days, And the years of your life shall perish, And ⌜the years of your destruction⌝ shall be multiplied in eternal execration, And ye shall find no mercy.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 6_a._ In those days ye shall make your names an eternal execration unto all the righteous, _b._ And by you shall ⌜all⌝ who curse, curse. _c._ ⌜And all⌝ the sinners ⌜and godless⌝ shall imprecate by you, 7_c._ And for you, the godless, there shall be a curse.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 6_d._ ⌜And all the ... shall rejoice, _e._ And there shall be forgiveness of sins, _f._ And every mercy and peace and forbearance: _g._ There shall be salvation unto them, a goodly light. _i._ And for all of you sinners there shall be no salvation, _j._ But on you all shall abide a curse⌝. 7_a._ But for the elect there shall be light and grace and peace, _b._ And they shall inherit the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And then there shall be bestowed upon the elect wisdom, And they shall all live and never again sin, Either through ungodliness or through pride; But they who are wise shall be humble.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they shall not again transgress, Nor shall they sin all the days of their life, Nor shall they die of (the divine) anger or wrath, But they shall complete the number of the days of their life.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And their lives shall be increased in peace, And the years of their joy shall be multiplied, In eternal gladness and peace, All the days of their life.

title: 1 Enoch
text: VI-XI. _The Fall of the Angels: the Demoralisation of Mankind: the Intercession of the Angels on behalf of Mankind. The Dooms pronounced by God on the Angels: the Messianic Kingdom_ (a Noah fragment).

title: 1 Enoch
text: And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And Semjâzâ, who was their leader, said unto them: ‘I fear ye will not indeed agree to do this deed, and I alone shall have to pay the penalty of a great sin.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they all answered him and said: ‘Let us all swear an oath, and all bind ourselves by mutual imprecations not to abandon this plan but to do this thing.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then sware they all together and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they were in all two hundred; who descended ⌜in the days⌝ of =Jared= on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And these are the names of their leaders: Sêmîazâz, their leader, Arâkîba, Râmêêl, Kôkabîêl, Tâmîêl, Râmîêl, Dânêl, Êzêqêêl, Barâqîjâl, Asâêl, Armârôs, Batârêl, Anânêl, Zaqîêl, Samsâpêêl, Satarêl, Tûrêl, Jômjâêl, =Sariêl=.

title: 1 Enoch
text: These are their chiefs of tens.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all the others together with them took unto themselves wives, and each chose for himself one, and they began to go in unto them and to defile themselves with them, and they taught them charms and enchantments, and the cutting of roots, and made them acquainted with plants.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells:

title: 1 Enoch
text: Who consumed all the acquisitions of men. And when men could no longer sustain them,

title: 1 Enoch
text: The giants turned against them and devoured mankind.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they began to sin against birds, and beasts, and reptiles, and fish, and to devour one another’s flesh, and drink the blood.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then the earth laid accusation against the lawless ones.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them =the metals= ‹of the earth› and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Semjâzâ taught enchantments, and root-cuttings, Armârôs the resolving of enchantments, Barâqîjâl, (taught) astrology, Kôkabêl the constellations, =Ezêqêêl the knowledge of the clouds=, ‹Araqiêl the signs of the earth, Shamsiêl the signs of the sun›, and Sariêl the course of the moon.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And as men perished, they cried, and their cry went up to heaven....

title: 1 Enoch
text: And then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked down from heaven and saw much blood being shed upon the earth, and all lawlessness being wrought upon the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they said one to another: ‘The earth, made †without inhabitant, cries the voice of their crying† up to the gates of heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 〚And now to you, the holy ones of heaven〛, the souls of men make their suit, saying, “Bring our cause before the Most High”.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they said to the Lord =of the ages=: ‘Lord of lords, God of gods, King of kings ‹and God of the ages›, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!

title: 1 Enoch
text: Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and all things Thou seest, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Thou seest what Azâzêl hath done, who hath taught all unrighteousness on earth and revealed the eternal secrets which were (preserved) in heaven, which men were striving to =learn=:

title: 1 Enoch
text: And Semjâzâ, to whom Thou hast given authority to bear rule over his associates.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the women have borne giants, and the whole earth has thereby been filled with blood and unrighteousness.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now, behold, the souls of those who have died are crying and making their suit to the gates of heaven, and their lamentations have ascended: and cannot =cease= because of the lawless deeds which are wrought on the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And Thou knowest all things before they come to pass, and Thou seest these things and Thou dost suffer them, and Thou dost not say to us what we are to do to them in regard to these.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then said the Most High, the Holy and Great One spake, and sent =Uriel= to the son of Lamech, and said to him:

title: 1 Enoch
text: ‘‹Go to Noah and› tell him in my name “Hide thyself!”, and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And again the Lord said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever, and cover his face that he may not see light.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And heal the earth which the angels have corrupted, and proclaim the healing of the earth, that they may heal the plague, and that all the children of men may not perish through all the secret things that the Watchers have =disclosed= and have taught their sons.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And to Gabriel said the Lord: ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men: [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And no request that they (_i. e._ their fathers) make of thee shall be granted unto their fathers on their behalf; for they hope to live an eternal life, and that each one of them will live five hundred years.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the Lord said unto Michael: ‘Go, =bind= Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women so as to have defiled themselves with them in all their uncleanness.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And, when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the =valleys= of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated.

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: ‹and› to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And whosoever shall be =condemned= and destroyed will from thenceforth be bound together with them to the end of all generations.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And destroy all the spirits of the reprobate, and the children of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Destroy all wrong from the face of the earth, and let every evil work come to an end: and let the plant of righteousness and truth appear: ⌜and it shall prove a blessing: the works of righteousness and truth⌝ shall be planted in truth and joy for evermore.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their =old age= shall they complete in peace.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And then shall the whole earth be tilled in righteousness, and shall all be planted with trees and be full of blessing.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all desirable trees shall be planted on it, and they shall plant vines on it: and the vine which they plant thereon shall yield wine in abundance, and as for all the seed which is sown thereon each measure (of it) shall bear a thousand, and each measure of olives shall yield ten presses of oil.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: ⌜And all the children of men shall become righteous⌝, and all nations shall offer adoration and shall praise Me, and all shall worship Me.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the earth shall be cleansed from all defilement, and from all sin, and from all punishment, and from all torment, and I will never again send (them) upon it from generation to generation and for ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in those days I will open the store chambers of blessing which are in the heaven, so as to send them down ⌜upon the earth⌝ over the work and labour of the children of men.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And truth and peace shall be associated together throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations =of men=.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: XII-XVI. _Dream Vision of Enoch: his intercession for Azâzêl and the fallen Angels: and his announcement to them of their first and final doom._

title: 1 Enoch
text: Before these things Enoch was hidden, and no one of the children of men knew where he was hidden, and where he abode, and what had become of him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And his activities had to do with the Watchers, and his days were with the holy ones.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I, Enoch, was blessing the Lord of =majesty= and the King of the ages, and lo! the Watchers called me—Enoch the scribe—and said to me:

title: 1 Enoch
text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, †declare† to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives: “Ye have wrought great destruction on the earth:

title: 1 Enoch
text: And ye shall have no peace nor forgiveness of sin: and inasmuch as †they† delight themselves in †their† children,

title: 1 Enoch
text: The murder of †their† beloved ones shall †they† see, and over the destruction of †their† children shall †they† lament, and shall make supplication unto eternity, but mercy and peace shall ye not attain.”’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And Enoch went and said: ‘Azâzêl, thou shalt have no peace: a severe sentence has gone forth against thee to put thee in bonds:

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thou shalt not have toleration nor †request† granted to thee, because of the unrighteousness which thou hast taught, and because of all the works of godlessness and unrighteousness and sin which thou hast shown to men.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I went and spoke to them all together, and they were all afraid, and fear and trembling seized them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they besought me to draw up a petition for them that they might find forgiveness, and to read their petition in the presence of the Lord of heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For from thenceforward they could not speak (with Him) nor lift up their eyes to heaven for shame of their sins for which they had been condemned.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I wrote out their petition, and the prayer †in regard to their spirits and their deeds individually and in regard to their requests that they should have forgiveness and length ‹of days›†.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I went off and sat down at the waters of Dan, in the land of Dan, to the south of the west of Hermon: I read their petition till I fell asleep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And behold a dream came to me, and visions fell down upon me, and I saw visions of chastisement, ⌜and a voice came bidding (me)⌝ to tell it to the sons of heaven, and reprimand them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And when I awaked, I came unto them, and they were all sitting gathered together, weeping in ’Abelsjâîl, which is between Lebanon and Sênêsêr, with their faces covered.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I recounted before them all the visions which I had seen in sleep, and I began to speak the words of righteousness, and to reprimand the heavenly Watchers.

title: 1 Enoch
text: The book of the words of righteousness, and of the reprimand of the eternal Watchers in accordance with the command of the Holy Great One in that vision.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I saw in my sleep what I will now say with a tongue of flesh and with the breath of my mouth: which the Great One has given to men to converse therewith and understand with the heart.

title: 1 Enoch
text: As He hath created and given 〚to man the power of understanding the word of wisdom, so hath He created me also and given〛 me the power of reprimanding the Watchers, the children of heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I wrote out your petition, and in my vision it appeared thus, that your petition will not be granted unto you 〚throughout all the days of eternity, and that judgement has been finally passed upon you: yea (your petition) will not be granted unto you〛.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And from henceforth you shall not ascend into heaven unto all eternity, and ⌜in bonds⌝ of the earth the decree has gone forth to bind you for all the days of the world.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And (that) previously you shall have seen the destruction of your beloved sons and you shall have no pleasure in them, but they shall fall before you by the sword.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And your petition on their behalf shall not be granted, nor yet on your own: even though you weep and pray and =speak all the words= contained in the writing which I have written.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the vision was shown to me thus: Behold, in the vision clouds invited me and a mist summoned me, and the course of the stars and the lightnings sped and =hastened= me, and the winds in the vision caused me to fly and lifted me upward, and bore me into heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I went in till I drew nigh to a wall which is built of crystals and surrounded by tongues of fire: and it began to affright me.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I went into the tongues of fire and drew nigh to a large house which was built of crystals: and the walls of the house were like a tesselated floor (made) of crystals, and its groundwork was of crystal.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Its ceiling was like the path of the stars and the lightnings, and between them were fiery cherubim, and their heaven was (clear as) water.

title: 1 Enoch
text: A flaming fire surrounded the walls, and its portals blazed with fire.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I entered into that house, and it was hot as fire and cold as ice: there were no delights of life therein: fear covered me, and trembling gat hold upon me.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And as I quaked and trembled, I fell upon my face. And I beheld a vision,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And lo! there was a second house, greater than the former, and the entire portal stood open before me, and it was built of flames of fire.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in every respect it so excelled in splendour and magnificence and extent that I cannot describe to you its splendour and its extent.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And its floor was of fire, and above it were lightnings and the path of the stars, and its ceiling also was flaming fire.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I looked and saw 〚therein〛 a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the =vision= of cherubim.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And from underneath the throne came streams of flaming fire so that I could not look thereon.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the Great Glory sat thereon, and His raiment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow.

title: 1 Enoch
text: None of the angels could enter and could behold His face by reason of the magnificence and glory, and no flesh could behold Him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: The flaming fire was round about Him, and a great fire stood before Him, and none around could draw nigh Him: ten thousand times ten thousand (stood) before Him, yet He needed no counsellor.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the most holy ones who were nigh to Him did not leave by night nor depart from Him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And until then I had been prostrate on my face, trembling: and the Lord called me with His own mouth, and said to me: ‘Come hither, Enoch, and hear my word.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: ⌜And one of the holy ones came to me and waked me⌝, and He made me rise up and approach the door: and I bowed my face downwards.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And He answered and said to me, and I heard His voice: ‘Fear not, Enoch, thou righteous man and scribe of righteousness: approach hither and hear my voice.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And go, say to 〚the Watchers of heaven〛, who have sent thee to intercede 〚for them: “You should intercede〛 for men, and not men for you:

title: 1 Enoch
text: Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And though ye were holy, spiritual, living the eternal life, you have defiled yourselves with the blood of women, and have begotten (children) with the blood of flesh, and, =as the children= of men, have lusted after flesh and blood as those ⌜also⌝ do who die and perish.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Therefore have I given them wives also that they might impregnate them, and beget children by them, that thus nothing might be wanting to them on earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But you were ⌜formerly⌝ spiritual, living the eternal life, and immortal for all generations of the world.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And therefore I have not appointed wives for you; for as for the spiritual ones of the heaven, in heaven is their dwelling.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from =men=, 〚and〛 from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; ⌜they shall be evil spirits on earth, and⌝ evil spirits shall they be called. [10. As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the spirits of the giants =afflict=, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, ⌜but nevertheless hunger⌝ and thirst, and cause offences.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And these spirits shall rise up against the children of men and against the women, because they have proceeded ⌜from them⌝.

title: 1 Enoch
text: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death ⌜of the giants⌝, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great ⌜judgement⌝ in which the age shall be consummated over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: And now as to the Watchers who have sent thee to intercede for them, who had been 〚aforetime〛 in heaven, (say to them):

title: 1 Enoch
text: “You have been in heaven, but ⌜all⌝ the mysteries had not yet been revealed to you, and you knew worthless ones, and these in the hardness of your hearts you have made known to the women, and through these mysteries women and men work much evil on earth.”

title: 1 Enoch
text: Say to them therefore: “You have no peace.”’

title: 1 Enoch
text: XVII-XXXVII. _Enoch’s Journeys through the Earth and Sheol._

title: 1 Enoch
text: XVII-XIX. _The First Journey._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they took ⌜and⌝ brought me to a place in which those who were there were like flaming fire, and when they wished, they appeared as men.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they brought me to the place of darkness, and to a mountain the point of whose summit reached to heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw the places of the luminaries ⌜and the treasuries of the stars⌝ and of the thunder, ⌜and⌝ in the =uttermost depths=, where were a fiery bow and arrows and their quiver, 〚and a fiery sword〛 and all the lightnings.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they took me to the living waters, and to the fire of the west, which receives every setting of the sun.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I came to a river of fire in which the fire flows like water and discharges itself into the great sea towards the west.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I saw the great rivers and came to the great ⌜river and to the great⌝ darkness, and went to the place where no flesh walks.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I saw the mountains of the darkness of winter and the place whence all the waters of the deep flow.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I saw the mouths of all the rivers of the earth and the mouth of the deep.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I saw the treasuries of all the winds; I saw how He had furnished with them the whole creation and the firm foundations of the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear [the earth and] the firmament of the heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 〚And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven〛, and have their station between heaven and earth: 〚these are the pillars of the heaven〛.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I saw the winds of heaven which turn and bring the circumference of the sun and all the stars to their setting.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I saw the winds on the earth carrying the clouds: I saw 〚the paths of the angels: I saw〛 at the end of the earth the firmament of the heaven above.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I proceeded and saw a place which burns day and night, where there are seven mountains of magnificent stones, three towards the east, and three towards the south.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And as for those towards the east ‹one› was of coloured stone, and one of pearl, and one of =jacinth=, and those towards the south of red stone.

title: 1 Enoch
text: But the middle one reached to heaven like the throne of God, of alabaster, and the summit of the throne was of sapphire.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw a flaming fire. And beyond these mountains

title: 1 Enoch
text: is a region, the end of the great earth: there the heavens were completed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw a deep abyss, with columns 〚of heavenly fire, and among them I saw columns〛 of fire fall, which were beyond measure alike towards the height and towards the depth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And beyond that abyss I saw a place which had no firmament of the heaven above, and no firmly founded earth beneath it: there was no water upon it, and no birds, but it was a waste and horrible place.

title: 1 Enoch
text: I saw there seven stars like great burning mountains, and to me, when I inquired regarding them,

title: 1 Enoch
text: The angel said: ‘This place is the end of heaven and earth: this has become a prison for the stars and the host of heaven.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of the Lord in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) ⌜for ten thousand years⌝.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits, assuming many different forms, are defiling mankind, and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons 〚as gods〛, (here shall they stand), till 〚the day of〛 the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the women also of the angels who went astray shall become sirens.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision, the ends of all things: and no man shall see as I have seen.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Names and Functions of the Seven Archangels._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And these are the names of the holy angels who watch.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is over the world and over Tartarus.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is over the spirits of men.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Raguel, one of the holy angels who †takes vengeance on† the world of the luminaries.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Michael, one of the holy angels, to wit, he that is set over the best part of mankind 〚and〛 over chaos.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Saraqâêl, one of the holy angels, who is set over the spirits, who sin in the spirit.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Gabriel, one of the holy angels, who is over Paradise and the serpents and the Cherubim.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Remiel, one of the holy angels, whom God set over those who rise.

title: 1 Enoch
text: XXI-XXXVI. _The Second Journey of Enoch._

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Preliminary and final place of punishment of the fallen angels (stars)._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I proceeded to where things were chaotic.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw there something horrible: I saw neither a heaven above nor a firmly founded earth, but a place chaotic and horrible.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there I saw seven stars of the heaven bound together in it, like great mountains and burning with fire.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I said: ‘For what sin are they bound, and on what account have they been cast in hither?’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then said Uriel, one of the holy angels, who was with me, and was chief over them, and said: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask, and why art thou eager for the truth?

title: 1 Enoch
text: These are of the number of the stars ⌜of heaven⌝ which have transgressed the commandment of the Lord, and are bound here till ten thousand years, the time entailed by their sins, are consummated.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And from thence I went to another place, which was still more horrible than the former, and I saw a horrible thing: a great fire there which burnt and blazed, and the place was cleft as far as the abyss, being full of great descending columns of fire: neither its extent or magnitude could I see, nor could I conjecture.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I said: ‘How fearful is the place and how terrible to look upon!’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then Uriel answered me, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘Enoch, why hast thou such fear and affright?’ And I answered: ‘Because of this fearful place, and because of the spectacle of the pain.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he said 〚unto me〛: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Sheol, or the Underworld._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thence I went to another place, and he showed me in the west ⌜another⌝ great and high mountain [and] of hard rock.

title: 1 Enoch
text: E

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there was in it †four† =hollow= places, deep and wide and very smooth. †How† smooth are =the hollow places= and deep and dark to look at.

title: 1 Enoch
text: G^g

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there were †four† hollow places in it, deep and very smooth: †three† of them were dark and one bright; and there was a fountain of water in its midst. And I said: ‘†How† smooth are these hollow places, and deep and dark to view.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then Raphael answered, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘These hollow places have been created for this very purpose, that the spirits of the souls of the dead should assemble therein, yea that all the souls of the children of men should assemble here.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And these places =have been made= to receive them till the day of their judgement and till their appointed period [till the period appointed], till the great judgement (comes) upon them.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: E

title: 1 Enoch
text: I saw the spirits of the children of men who were dead, and their voice went forth to heaven and made suit.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I asked Raphael the angel who was with me, and I said unto him: ‘This spirit—whose is it whose voice goeth forth and maketh suit?’

title: 1 Enoch
text: G^g

title: 1 Enoch
text: I saw ‹the spirit of› =a dead man= making suit, and his voice went forth to heaven and made suit.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I asked Raphael the angel who was with me, and I said unto him: ‘This spirit which maketh suit, whose is it, whose voice goeth forth and maketh suit to heaven?’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: E

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I asked regarding it, and regarding all the _hollow places_: ‘Why is one separated from the other?’

title: 1 Enoch
text: G^g

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I asked regarding all the =hollow places=: ‘Why is one separated from the other?’

title: 1 Enoch
text: E

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he answered me and said unto me: ‘These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And such a division has been made ‹for› the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the =bright= spring of water.

title: 1 Enoch
text: =And= such has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgement has not been executed on them in their lifetime.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who †curse† for ever, and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And such a division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Such has been made for the spirits of men who were not righteous but sinners, who were complete in transgression, and of the transgressors they shall be companions: but their spirits shall not be slain in the day of judgement nor shall they be raised from thence.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I blessed the Lord of glory and said: ‘Blessed be my Lord, the Lord of righteousness who ruleth for ever.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: G^g

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he answered me saying: ‘These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And =this= division has been made for the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright spring of water.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And =this= has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgement has not been executed upon them in their lifetime.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain, till the great day of judgement, scourgings, and torments of the accursed for ever, =so that= (there may be) retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And =this= division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And =this= has been made for the spirits of men who shall not be righteous but sinners, who are godless, and of the lawless they shall be companions: but their spirits shall not be punished in the day of judgement nor shall they be raised from thence.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I blessed the Lord of Glory and said: ‘Blessed art Thou, Lord of righteousness, who rulest over the world.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Fire that deals with the Luminaries of Heaven._

title: 1 Enoch
text: From thence I went to another place to the west of the ends of the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw a 〚burning〛 fire which ran without resting, and paused not from its course day or night but (ran) regularly.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I asked saying: ‘What is this which rests not?’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then Raguel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me 〚and said unto me〛: ‘This course ⌜of fire⌝ 〚which thou hast seen〛 is the fire in the west which †persecutes† all the luminaries of heaven.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: XXV. _The Seven Mountains in the North-West and the Tree of Life._

title: 1 Enoch
text: 〚And from thence I went to another place of the earth〛, and he showed me a mountain range of fire which burnt 〚day and〛 night.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I went beyond it and saw seven magnificent mountains all differing each from the other, and the stones (thereof) were magnificent and beautiful, magnificent as a whole, of glorious appearance and fair exterior: 〚three towards〛 the east, 〚one〛 founded on the other, and three towards the south, 〚one〛 upon the other, and deep rough ravines, no one of which joined with any other.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the seventh mountain was in the midst of these, and it excelled them in height, resembling the seat of a throne: and fragrant trees encircled the throne.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And amongst them was a tree such as I had never yet smelt, neither was any amongst them nor were others like it: it had a fragrance beyond all fragrance, and its leaves and blooms and wood wither not for ever: and its fruit 〚is beautiful, and its fruit〛 resembles the dates of a palm.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I said: ‘⌜How⌝ beautiful is this tree, and fragrant, and its leaves are fair, and its blooms 〚very〛 delightful in appearance.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then answered Michael, one of the holy 〚and honoured〛 angels who was with me, and was their leader,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he said unto me: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask me regarding the fragrance of the tree, and ⌜why⌝ dost thou wish to learn the truth?’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I answered him, 〚saying〛: ‘I wish to know about everything, but especially about this tree.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he answered, saying: ‘This high mountain 〚which thou hast seen〛, whose summit is like the throne of God, is His throne, where the Holy Great One, the Lord of Glory, the Eternal King will sit, when He shall come down to visit the earth with goodness.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Its fruit =shall be= for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of the Lord, the Eternal King.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then shall they rejoice with joy and be glad. And into the holy place shall they enter; And its fragrance shall be in their bones, And they shall live a long life on earth, Such as thy fathers lived: And in their days shall no 〚sorrow or〛 plague Or torment or calamity touch them.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then blessed I the God of Glory, the Eternal King, who hath prepared such things for the righteous, and hath created them and promised to give to them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _Jerusalem and the Mountains, Ravines, and Streams._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I went from thence to the middle of the earth, and I saw a blessed place ⌜in which there were trees⌝ with branches abiding and blooming [of a dismembered tree].

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there I saw a holy mountain, 〚and〛 underneath the mountain to the east there was a stream and it flowed towards the south.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw towards the east another mountain higher than this, and between them a deep and narrow ravine: in it also ran a stream ⌜underneath⌝ the mountain.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And to the west thereof there was another mountain, lower than the former and of small elevation, and a ravine ⌜deep and dry⌝ between them: and another deep and dry ravine was at the extremities of the three ⌜mountains⌝.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all the ravines were deep 〚and narrow〛, (being formed) of hard rock, and trees were not planted upon them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I marvelled 〚at the rocks, and I marvelled〛 at the ravine, yea, I marvelled very much.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Purpose of the Accursed Valley._

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then said I: ‘For what object is this blessed land, which is entirely filled with trees, and this accursed valley 〚between?〛’

title: 1 Enoch
text: 〚Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This〛 valley is for those who are accursed for ever: here shall all ⌜the accursed⌝ be gathered together who utter with their lips against the Lord unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things.

title: 1 Enoch
text: E

title: 1 Enoch
text: In the last days there shall be upon them the spectacle of righteous judgement in the presence of the righteous for ever: here shall the merciful bless the Lord of Glory, the Eternal King.

title: 1 Enoch
text: G^g

title: 1 Enoch
text: In the last times, in the days of the true judgement in the presence of the righteous for ever: here shall the =godly= bless the Lord of Glory, the Eternal King.

title: 1 Enoch
text: In the days of judgement over the former, they shall bless Him for the mercy in accordance with which He has assigned them (their lot).’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I blessed the Lord of Glory and set forth His ⌜glory⌝ and lauded Him gloriously.

title: 1 Enoch
text: XXVIII-XXXIII. _Further Journey to the East._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thence I went 〚towards the east〛, into the midst 〚of the mountain range〛 of the desert, and I saw a wilderness and it was solitary, full of trees =and plants=.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 〚And〛 water gushed forth from above.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Rushing like a copious watercourse [which flowed] towards the north-west it caused =clouds= and dew to ascend on every side.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thence I went to another place in the desert, and approached to the east of this mountain range.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And 〚there〛 I saw =aromatic= trees exhaling the fragrance of frankincense and myrrh, and the trees also were similar to the almond tree.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And beyond these, I went afar to the east, and I saw another place, a valley (full) of water.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And ⌜therein there was⌝ a tree, the colour (?) of fragrant trees such as the mastic.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And on the sides of those valleys I saw fragrant cinnamon. And beyond these I proceeded to the east.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw other mountains, and amongst them were ⌜groves of⌝ trees, and there flowed forth from them nectar, which is named sarara and galbanum.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And beyond these mountains I saw another mountain ⌜to the east of the ends of the earth⌝, 〚whereon were aloe trees〛, and all the trees were full =of stacte=, being like almond trees.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And when one =burnt= it, it smelt sweeter than any fragrant odour.

title: 1 Enoch
text: E

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after these fragrant odours, as I looked towards the north over the mountains I saw seven mountains full of choice nard and fragrant trees and cinnamon and pepper.

title: 1 Enoch
text: G^g

title: 1 Enoch
text: To the north-east I beheld seven mountains full of choice nard and mastic and cinnamon and pepper.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thence I went over the summits of ⌜all⌝ these mountains, far towards the east ⌜of the earth⌝, and passed above the Erythraean sea, and went far from it, and passed over 〚the angel〛 Zotîêl.

title: 1 Enoch
text: E

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I came to the Garden of Righteousness, and saw beyond those trees many large trees growing there and of goodly fragrance, large, very beautiful and glorious, and the tree of wisdom whereof they eat and know great wisdom.

title: 1 Enoch
text: G^g

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I came to the Garden of Righteousness, and from afar off trees more numerous than these trees and great—†two† trees there, very great, beautiful, and glorious, and magnificent, and the tree of knowledge, whose holy fruit they eat and know great wisdom.

title: 1 Enoch
text: ⌜That tree is in height like the fir, and its leaves are⌝ like (those of) the Carob tree: and its fruit is like the clusters of the vine, very beautiful: and the fragrance of the tree penetrates afar.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then I said: ‘⌜How⌝ beautiful is the tree, and how attractive is its look!’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then Raphael, the holy angel who was with me, answered me 〚and said〛: ‘This is the tree of wisdom, of which thy father old (in years) and thy aged mother, who were before thee, have eaten, and they learnt wisdom and their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked and they were driven out of the garden.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And from thence I went to the ends of the earth and saw there great beasts, and each differed from the other; and (I saw) birds also differing in appearance and beauty and voice, the one differing from the other.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And to the east of those beasts I saw the ends of the earth whereon the heaven rests, and the portals of the heaven open.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw how the stars of heaven come forth, and I counted the portals out of which they proceed, and wrote down all their outlets, of each individual star by itself, according to their number and their names, their courses and their positions, and their times and their months, as Uriel the holy angel who was with me showed me.

title: 1 Enoch
text: He showed all things to me and wrote them down for me: also their names he wrote for me, and their laws and their companies.

title: 1 Enoch
text: XXXV. _Enoch’s Journey to the North._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And from thence I went towards the north to the ends of the earth, and there I saw a great and glorious device at the ends of the whole earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And here I saw three portals of heaven open in the heaven: through each of them proceed north winds: when they blow there is cold, hail, frost, snow, dew, and rain.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And out of one portal they blow for good: but when they blow through the other two portals, †it is with violence and affliction on the earth, and they blow with violence.†

title: 1 Enoch
text: And from thence I went towards the west to the ends of the earth, and saw there three portals of the heaven open such as I had seen in the †east†, the same number of portals, and the same number of outlets.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Journey to the South._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And from thence I went to the south to the ends of the earth, and saw there three open portals of the heaven: and thence there come dew, rain, †and wind†.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And from thence I went to the east to the ends of the heaven, and saw here the three eastern portals of heaven open and small portals above them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Through each of these small portals pass the stars of heaven and run their course to the west on the path which is shown to them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And as often as I saw I blessed always the Lord of Glory, and I continued to bless the Lord of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of His work to the angels and to =spirits= and to men, that they might praise His work and all His creation: that they might see the work of His might and praise the great work of His hands and bless Him for ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: THE PARABLES. XXXVII-LXXI.

title: 1 Enoch
text: The second vision which he saw, the vision of wisdom—which Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Cainan, the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, saw.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And this is the beginning of the words of wisdom which I lifted up my voice to speak and say to those which dwell on earth: Hear, ye men of old time, and see, ye that come after, the words of the Holy One which I will speak before the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: It were better to declare (them only) to the men of old time, but even from those that come after we will not withhold the beginning of wisdom.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Till the present day such wisdom has never been given =by= the Lord of Spirits as I have received according to my insight, according to the good pleasure of the Lord of Spirits by whom the lot of eternal life has been given to me.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Now three parables were imparted to me, and I lifted up my voice and recounted them to those that dwell on the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: XXXVIII-XLIV. =The First Parable.=

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Coming Judgement of the Wicked._

title: 1 Enoch
text: The first Parable. When the congregation of the righteous shall appear, And sinners shall be judged for their sins, And shall be driven from the face of the earth,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon the Lord of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied the Lord of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.

title: 1 Enoch
text: When the secrets of the righteous shall be revealed and the sinners judged, And the godless driven from the presence of the righteous and elect,

title: 1 Enoch
text: From that time those that possess the earth shall no longer be powerful and exalted:

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they shall not be able to behold the face of the holy, For the Lord of Spirits =has caused His light to appear= On the face of the holy, righteous, and elect.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then shall the kings and the mighty perish And be given into the hands of the righteous and holy.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And thenceforward none shall seek for themselves mercy from the Lord of Spirits: For their life is at an end.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Abode of the Righteous and of the Elect One: the Praises of the Blessed._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in those days Enoch received books of zeal and wrath, and books of disquiet and expulsion.]

title: 1 Enoch
text: And mercy shall not be accorded to them, saith the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in those days a whirlwind carried me off from the earth, And set me down at the end of the heavens.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there I saw another vision, the dwelling-places of the holy, And the resting-places of the righteous.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Here mine eyes saw their dwellings with His righteous angels, And their resting-places with the holy.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they petitioned and interceded and prayed for the children of men. And righteousness flowed before them as water,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And mercy like dew upon the earth: Thus it is amongst them for ever and ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 6 _a._ And in that place mine eyes saw the Elect One of righteousness and of faith,

title: 1 Enoch
text: 7 _a._ And I saw his dwelling-place under the wings of the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 6 _b._ And righteousness shall prevail in his days, And the righteous and elect shall be without number before Him for ever and ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 7 _b._ And all the righteous and elect before Him shall be †strong† as fiery lights, And their mouth shall be full of blessing,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And their lips shall extol the name of the Lord of Spirits, And righteousness before Him shall never fail, [And uprightness shall never fail before Him].

title: 1 Enoch
text: There I wished to dwell, And my spirit longed for that dwelling-place:

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there heretofore hath been my portion, For so hath it been established concerning me before the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days I praised and extolled the name of the Lord of Spirits with blessings and praises, because He hath destined me for blessing and glory according to the good pleasure of the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For a long time my eyes regarded that place, and I blessed Him and praised Him, saying: ‘Blessed is He, and may He be blessed from the beginning and for evermore.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And before Him there is no ceasing. He knows before the world was created what is for ever and what will be from generation unto generation.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Those who sleep not bless Thee: they stand before Thy glory and bless, praise, and extol, saying: “Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of Spirits: He filleth the earth with spirits.”’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And here my eyes saw all those who sleep not: they stand before Him and bless and say: ‘Blessed be Thou, and blessed be the name of the Lord for ever and ever.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And my face was changed; for I could no longer behold.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Four Archangels._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And on the four sides of the Lord of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel who went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before the Lord of glory.

title: 1 Enoch
text: The first voice blesses the Lord of Spirits for ever and ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the second voice I heard blessing the Elect One and the elect ones who hang upon the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the third voice I heard =pray and intercede= for those who dwell on the earth and =supplicate= in the name of the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before the Lord of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: After that I asked the angel of peace who went with me, who showed me everything that is hidden: ‘Who are these four presences which I have seen and whose words I have heard and written down?’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long-suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And these are the four angels of the Lord of Spirits and the four voices I heard in those days.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that I saw all the secrets of the heavens, and how the kingdom is divided, and how the actions of men are weighed in the balance.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there I saw the mansions of the elect and the mansions of the holy, and mine eyes saw there all the sinners being driven from thence which deny the name of the Lord of Spirits, and being dragged off: and they could not abide because of the punishment which proceeds from the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: 3-9. _Astronomical Secrets._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightning and of the thunder, and the secrets of the winds, how they are divided to blow over the earth, and the secrets of the clouds and dew, and there I saw from whence they proceed in that place and from whence they saturate the dusty earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there I saw closed chambers out of which the winds are divided, the chamber of the hail and winds, the chamber of the mist, and of the clouds, and the cloud thereof hovers over the earth from the beginning of the world.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And first the sun goes forth and traverses his path according to the commandment of the Lord of Spirits, and mighty is His name for ever and ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And after that I saw the hidden and the visible path of the moon, and she accomplishes the course of her path in that place by day and by night—the one holding a position opposite to the other before the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For the sun changes oft for a blessing or a curse, And the course of the path of the moon is light to the righteous, And darkness to the sinners in the name of the Lord,

title: 1 Enoch
text: Who made a separation between the light and the darkness, And divided the spirits of men,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And strengthened the spirits of the righteous, In the name of His righteousness.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For no angel hinders and no power is able to hinder; for He appoints a judge for them all and he judges them all before Him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Dwelling-places of Wisdom and of Unrighteousness._

title: 1 Enoch
text: Wisdom found no place where she might dwell; Then a dwelling-place was assigned her in the heavens.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Wisdom went forth to make her dwelling among the children of men, And found no dwelling-place:

title: 1 Enoch
text: Wisdom returned to her place And took her seat among the angels.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And unrighteousness went forth from her chambers: Whom she sought not she found, And dwelt with them, As rain in a desert, And dew on a thirsty land.

title: 1 Enoch
text: XLIV. _Astronomical Secrets._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw other lightnings and the stars of heaven, and I saw how He called them all by their names and they hearkened unto Him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I saw how they are weighed in a righteous balance according to their proportions of light: (I saw) the width of their spaces and the day of their appearing, and how their revolution produces lightning: and (I saw) their revolution according to the number of the angels, and (how) they keep faith with each other.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I asked the angel who went with me who showed me what was hidden: ‘What are these?’

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he said to me: ‘The Lord of Spirits hath showed thee their parabolic meaning (lit. ‘their parable’): these are the names of the holy who dwell on the earth and believe in the name of the Lord of Spirits for ever and ever.’

title: 1 Enoch
text: Also another phenomenon I saw in regard to the lightnings: how some of the stars arise and become lightnings and cannot part with their new form.

title: 1 Enoch
text: XLV-LVII. =The Second Parable.=

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Lot of the Apostates: the New Heaven and the New Earth._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And this is the Second Parable concerning those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And into the heaven they shall not ascend, And on the earth they shall not come:

title: 1 Enoch
text: Such shall be the lot of the sinners Who have denied the name of the Lord of Spirits, Who are thus preserved for the day of suffering and tribulation.

title: 1 Enoch
text: On that day Mine Elect, One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall =try= their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing:

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For I have provided and satisfied with peace My righteous ones, And have caused them to dwell before Me:

title: 1 Enoch
text: But for the sinners there is judgement impending with Me, So that I shall destroy them from the face of the earth.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Head of Days and the Son of Man._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there I saw One, who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I asked the =angel= who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Man, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he answered and said unto me:

title: 1 Enoch
text: This is the Son of Man who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden,

title: 1 Enoch
text: Because the Lord of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before the Lord of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And this Son of Man whom thou hast seen Shall †raise up† the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones]

title: 1 Enoch
text: And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners;

title: 1 Enoch
text: [And he shall put down the kings from their thrones and kingdoms] Because they do not extol and praise Him, Nor humbly acknowledge whence the kingdom was bestowed upon them.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And these are they who †judge† the stars of heaven, [And raise their hands against the Most High], †And tread upon the earth and dwell upon it†.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And all their deeds manifest unrighteousness, And their power rests upon their riches,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And their faith is in the †gods† which they have made with their hands, And they deny the name of the Lord of Spirits,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And they persecute the houses of His congregations, And the faithful who hang upon the name of the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Prayer of the Righteous for Vengeance and their Joy at its coming._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in those days shall have ascended the prayer of the righteous. And the blood of the righteous from the earth before the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days the holy ones who dwell above in the heavens Shall unite with one voice And supplicate and pray [and praise, And give thanks and bless the name of the Lord of Spirits] On behalf of the blood of the righteous which has been shed, And that the prayer of the righteous may not be in vain before the Lord of Spirits, That judgement may be done unto them, And that they may not have to suffer for ever.

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the hearts of the holy were filled with joy;

title: 1 Enoch
text: Because the number of the righteous =had been offered=, And the prayer of the righteous had been heard, And the blood of the righteous been required before the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Fount of Righteousness: the Son of Man—the Stay of the Righteous: Judgement of the Kings and the Mighty._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness, Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom;

title: 1 Enoch
text: And at that hour that Son of Man was named In the presence of the Lord of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

title: 1 Enoch
text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.

title: 1 Enoch
text: All who dwell on earth shall fall down and worship before him, And will praise and bless and celebrate with song the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the wisdom of the Lord of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous;

title: 1 Enoch
text: Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of the Lord of Spirits:

title: 1 Enoch
text: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.

title: 1 Enoch
text: In those days downcast in countenance shall the kings of the earth have become, And the strong who possess the land because of the works of their hands;

title: 1 Enoch
text: And I will give them over into the hands of Mine elect:

title: 1 Enoch
text: As straw in the fire so shall they burn before the face of the holy: As lead in the water shall they sink before the face of the righteous, And no trace of them shall any more be found.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And on the day of their affliction there shall be rest on the earth, And before them they shall fall and not rise again:

title: 1 Enoch
text: And there shall be no one to take them with his hands and raise them: For they have denied the Lord of Spirits and His Anointed. The name of the Lord of Spirits be blessed.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Power and Wisdom of the Elect One._

title: 1 Enoch
text: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.

title: 1 Enoch
text: For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before the Lord of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before the Lord of Spirits according to His good pleasure.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Glorification and Victory of the Righteous: the Repentance of the Gentiles._

title: 1 Enoch
text: And in those days a change shall take place for the holy and elect, And the light of days shall abide upon them, And glory and honour shall turn to the holy,

title: 1 Enoch
text: On the day of affliction on which evil shall have been treasured up against the sinners.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And the righteous shall be victorious in the name of the Lord of Spirits: And He will cause the others to witness (this), That they may repent And forgo the works of their hands.

title: 1 Enoch
text: They shall have no honour through the name of the Lord of Spirits, Yet through His name shall they be saved, And the Lord of Spirits will have compassion on them, For His compassion is great.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And He is righteous also in His judgement, And in the presence of His glory unrighteousness also shall not maintain itself: At His judgement the unrepentant shall perish before Him.

title: 1 Enoch
text: And from henceforth I will have no mercy on them, saith the Lord of Spirits.

title: 1 Enoch
text: _The Resurrection of the Dead, and the Separation by the Judge of the Righteous and the Wicked._

title: 1 Enoch
