title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: But I said, “I implore you, show me what are these men.” And he said to me, “These are the ones who built the tower of strife against God, and the Lord banished them.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel of the Lord took me and led me to a second heaven. And he showed me there also a door like the first and said, “Let us enter through it.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And we entered, being carried on wings a distance of about sixty days' journey.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And he showed me there also a plain, and it was full of men, whose appearance was like that of dogs, and whose feet were like those of stags.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I asked the angel: “I implore you, Lord, tell me who these are.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And he said, “These are the ones who gave counsel to build the tower, for they whom you see drove forth multitudes of both men and women, to make bricks; among whom, a woman making bricks was not allowed to be released in the hour of child-birth, but brought forth while she was making bricks, and carried her child in her apron, and continued to make bricks.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the Lord appeared to them and confused their speech, when they had built the tower to the height of four hundred and sixty-three cubits.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And they took a gimlet, and tried to pierce heaven, saying, ‘Let us see (whether) heaven is made of clay, brass, or iron.'

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: When God saw this He did not permit them, but smote them with blindness and confusion of speech, and rendered them as you see.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I Baruch said, “Behold, Lord, You showed me great and wonderful things; and now show me all things for the sake of the Lord.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said to me, “Come, let us proceed.” (And I went) with the angel from that place about one hundred and eighty-five days' journey.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And he showed me Hades, and its appearance was dark and abominable.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: “Who is this dragon, and what is this harshness around him?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said, “The dragon is he who eats the bodies of those who spend their life wickedly, and he is nourished by them.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And this is Hades, which itself also closely resembles him, in that it also drinks about a cubit from the sea, which does not sink at all.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: Baruch said, “And how (does this happen)?” And the angel said, “Listen, the Lord God made three hundred and sixty rivers, of which the chief of all are Alphias, Abyrus, and the Gericus; and because of these the sea does not sink.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I said, “I implore you, show me which is the tree which led Adam astray.” And the angel said to me, “It is the vine, which the angel Sammael planted, where the Lord God was angry, and He cursed him and his plant, while also on this account He did not permit Adam to touch it, and therefore the devil being envious deceived him through his vine.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I Baruch said, “Since also the vine has been the cause of such great evil, and is under judgment of the curse of God, and was the destruction of the first created, how is it now so useful?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said, “You ask correctly. When God caused the deluge upon earth, and destroyed all flesh, and four hundred and nine thousand giants, and the water rose fifteen cubits above the highest mountains, then the water entered into paradise and destroyed every flower; but it removed wholly outside the bounds the shoot of the vine and cast it outside.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And when the earth appeared out of the water, and Noah came out of the ark, he began to plant of the plants which he found.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: But he found also the shoot of the vine; and he took it, and was reasoning in himself, What then is it? And I came and spoke to him the things concerning it.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And he said, ‘Shall I plant it, or what shall I do? Since Adam was destroyed because of it, let me not also meet with the anger of God because of it.' And saying these things, he prayed that God would reveal to him what he should do concerning it.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And when he had completed the prayer which lasted forty days, and having requested many things and wept, he said: ‘Lord, I ask you to reveal to me what I should do concerning this plant.'

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: Then God sent his angel Sarasael, and said to him, ‘Arise, Noah, and plant the branch, for thus says the Lord. Its bitterness shall be changed into sweetness, and its curse shall become a blessing, and that which is produced from it shall become the blood of God; and as through it the human race obtained condemnation, so again through Jesus Christ the Immanuel will they receive in Him the upward calling, and the entry into paradise.'

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: Know therefore, O Baruch, that as Adam through this very tree obtained condemnation, and was divested of the glory of God, so also the men who now drink insatiably the wine which is begotten of it, transgress worse than Adam, and are far from the glory of God, and are surrendering themselves to the eternal fire.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: For (no) good comes through it. For those who drink it to excess do these things: neither does a brother pity his brother, nor a father his son, nor children their parents, but from the drinking of wine come all evils, such as murders, adulteries, fornications, perjuries, thefts, and such like. And nothing good is established by it.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I Baruch said to the angel, “Let me ask you one thing, Lord.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: Because you told me that the dragon drinks one cubit out of the sea, tell me also how great is his belly?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said, “His belly is Hades; and as far as three hundred men throw a javelin, so great is his belly. Come, then, that I may show you also greater works than these.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And taking me, he led me where the sun rises.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And he showed me a four-wheeled chariot that was under fire. And a man was sitting in the chariot wearing a crown of fire. The chariot was being pulled by forty angels. And behold a bird hovered in front of the sun about nine cubits away.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I said to the angel, “What is this bird?” And he said to me, “This is the guardian of the (inhabited) world.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I said, “Lord, how is he the guardian of the (inhabited) world? Teach me.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said to me, “This bird flies alongside the sun, and expanding its wings receives its fiery rays.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: For if he were not receiving them, the human race would not be preserved, nor any other living creature. But God posted this bird in place.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And it expanded its wings, and I saw on its right wing very large letters, as large as the space of a threshing-floor, the size of about four thousand modii;1 and the letters were of gold.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said to me, “Read them.” And I read. And they said thus: “Neither earth nor sky gave me birth, but the wings of fire gave me birth.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I said, “Lord, what is this bird, and what is its name?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said to me, “Its name is called Phoenix.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: “And what does it eat?” And he said to me, “The manna of heaven and the dew of earth.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I said, “Does the bird excrete?” And he said to me, “He excretes a worm, and the excrement of the worm is cinnamon, which kings and princes use. But wait and you shall see the glory of God.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And while he was conversing with me, there was as a thunder-clap, and the place was shaken on which we were standing. And I asked the angel, “My Lord, what is this sound?” And the angel said to me, “Even now the angels are opening the three hundred and sixty-five gates of heaven, and the light is being separated from the darkness.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And a voice came which said, “Light giver, give to the world radiance.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And when I heard the noise of the bird, I said, “Lord, what is this noise?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And he said, “This is the bird that awakens from slumber the roosters upon earth. For as men do through the mouth, so also does the rooster signify to those in the world, in its own speech. For the sun is made ready by the angels, and the rooster crows.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I said, “And where does the sun begin its labors, after the rooster crows?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said to me, “Listen, Baruch! All things whatever I showed you are in the first and second heaven, and in the third heaven the sun passes through and gives light to the world. But wait, and you shall see the glory of God.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And while I was talking with him, I saw the bird, and it appeared in front, and grew little by little, and then it was full size.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And behind it I saw the shining sun, and the angels who draw it, and a crown upon its head, the sight of which we were not able to look directly at and see.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And as soon as the sun shone, the Phoenix also stretched out its wings. But when I saw such great glory, I was brought low with great fear, and I fled and hid in the wings of the angel.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said to me, “Fear not, Baruch, but wait and you shall also see their setting.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And taking me, he led me toward the west. And when the time of the setting came, I saw again the bird coming in front of it, and the sun coming with the angels. And when it came, I saw the angels, and they lifted the crown from its head.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: But the bird was exhausted and its wings contracted.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And seeing these things, I said, “Lord, why did they lift the crown from the head of the sun, and why is the bird so exhausted?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said to me, “The four angels take the crown of the sun when it has run through the day and carry it up to heaven and renew it because its rays have been defiled upon the earth. And so every day it is thus renewed.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I Baruch said, Lord, “And why are its beams defiled upon earth?” And the angel said to me, “Because it sees the lawlessness and unrighteousness of men, namely fornications, adulteries, thefts, extortions, idolatries, drunkenness, murders, strife, jealousies, evil-speakings, murmurings, whisperings, divinations, and such like, which are not well-pleasing to God. Because of these things is it defiled, and therefore is it renewed.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: But you asked concerning the bird, why it is exhausted. Because by restraining the rays of the sun through the fire and burning heat of the whole day, it is exhausted thereby.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: For, as we said before, unless his wings were screening the rays of the sun, no living creature would be preserved.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And when they retired, the night also overtook. At the same time, came the moon along with the stars.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I, Baruch said, “Lord, Show me also, I implore you, how it (the moon) goes forth, where it departs, and in what form it moves along.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said, “Wait, and you will see it also shortly.” And on the next day I also saw it in the form of a woman, sitting on a wheeled chariot. And there were before it oxen and lambs in the chariot, and a multitude of angels likewise.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I said, “Lord, what are the oxen and the lambs?” And he said to me, “They also are angels.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And again I asked, “Why is it that at one time it increases, but at another time it decreases?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: “Listen, O Baruch! This that you see in beauty had been written by God as no other.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And at the transgression of the first Adam, it was near to Sammael when he wore the serpent as a garment. And it did not hide itself but increased, and God was angry with it, and afflicted it, and shortened its days.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I said, “And how does it not also shine always, but only in the night?” And the angel said, “Listen! just as their courtiers cannot speak freely in the presence of a king, so the moon and the stars cannot shine in the presence of the sun; for the stars are always suspended, but they are screened by the sun, and the moon, although it is uninjured, is consumed by the heat of the sun.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And when I had learned all these things from the archangel, he took and led me into a fourth heaven.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I saw a plain stretched out, and in the middle of it a lake of water.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And in it there were multitudes of birds of all kinds, but not like those here [on earth]. But I saw a crane as big as an ox. And all were bigger than those in the world.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I asked the angel, “What is this plain, and what is the lake, and what is the multitudes of birds around it?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said, “Listen, Baruch! The plain which contains the lake and other wonders in it is the place where the righteous souls come. They gather assembling choir by choir.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: But the water is what the clouds receive, and rain upon the earth, and the fruits increase.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I said again to the angel of the Lord, “And these birds?” And he said to me, “They are those which continually sing praise to the Lord.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I, Baruch, said, “Lord, how do men say that the water which descends in rain is from the sea?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said, “The water which comes from the sea and also from here descends as rain upon the earth; but the rain that activates the fruit comes only from this latter source.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: It is therefore from this latter source which is what is called the dew of heaven.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And after taking me, this angel led me into a fifth heaven.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the gate was locked. And I said, “Lord, doesn't this gateway open so that we may enter?” And the angel said to me, “We cannot enter until Michael comes, who holds the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven; but wait and you will see the glory of God.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And there was a loud sound, like thunder. And I said, “Lord, what is this sound?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And he said to me, “Even now Michael, the commander of the angels, comes down to receive the prayers of men.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And behold there was a voice, “Let the gates be opened.” And they opened them, and there was a roar as of thunder.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And Michael came, and the angel who was with me came face to face with him and said, “Hail, my commander, and all those of our troops.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the commander Michael said, “Hail you also, our brother, and the interpreter of the revelations to those who pass through life appropriately.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And having saluted one another thus, they stood still. And I saw the commander Michael, holding an exceedingly great vessel; its depth was as great as the distance from heaven to earth, and its breadth as great as the distance from north to south. And I said, “Lord, what is Michael the archangel holding?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And he said to me, “This is where the merits of the righteous enter, and such good works as they do, which are escorted before the heavenly God.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And as I was conversing with them, behold angels came carrying baskets full of flowers. And they gave them to Michael.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I asked the angel, “Lord, who are these, and what are the things brought here from beside them?”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And he said to me, “These are angels (who) are over the righteous. ”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the archangel took the baskets, and threw them into the bowl.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And the angel said to me, “These flowers are the merits of the righteous.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I saw other angels carrying baskets which were empty not full. And they began to lament, and did not dare to draw near, because they didn't have complete prizes.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And Michael shouted and said, “Come here, also, you angels, bring what you have brought.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And Michael was exceedingly grieved, and the angel who was with me, because they did not fill the bowl.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And then there came other Angels weeping and crying and fearfully saying, “We are bruised, O Lord, that wicked men have surrendered, and we will depart from them.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And Michael said, “You cannot depart from them; lest, in the end, the enemy wins; but tell me what you are asking for.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And they said, We ask you, Michael, our chief commander, transfer us from them, for we cannot live with wicked and foolish men, for there is nothing good in them, but they are all unrighteous and greedy.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: “Because we never see them enter the church, not as spiritual fathers, not in good work. But where there is murder these in the middle of it. Where there is fornication, thefts, slanders, perjuries, jealousies, drunkenness, strife, envy, murmurings, whispering, idolatry, divination, and such like, then are they workers of such works, and of others worse. Therefore we want to depart from them.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And Michael said to the angels, “Wait until I learn from the Lord what shall happen.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And in that very hour Michael departed, and the doors were closed. And there was a sound like thunder.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And I asked the angel, “What is that sound?” And he said to me, “Right now Michael is presenting the merits of men to God.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And in that very hour Michael descended, and the gate was opened; and he brought oil.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And for the angels who brought the baskets which were full, he filled them with oil, saying, “Take it away, reward our friends a hundredfold, and to those who diligently performed good works. Because those who sowed well, also reap well. ”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And he said also to those bringing the half-empty baskets, “Come here also; take away the reward according as you brought, and deliver it to the sons of men.”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: Then he said also to those who brought the full and to those who brought the half-empty baskets: “Go and bless our friends, and say to them that thus says the Lord, ‘You were faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things; enter into the joy of your Lord.' ”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And turning he said also to those who brought nothing: “Thus says the Lord, ‘Don't be sullen and don't weep, nor leave the sons of men alone.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: But since they angered me by their works, go and make them envious and angry and provoked against those who are not a nation, a nation that lacks understanding.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: As well, with these, send forth the caterpillar and the unwinged locust, and the mildew, and the common locust, hail with lightnings and wrath, and punish them severely with the sword and with death, and their children with demons.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: Because they did not obey my voice, nor did they observe my commandments, nor do them, but they were despisers of my commandments, and insolent toward the priests who proclaimed my words to them.' ”

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And while he yet spoke, the door was closed, and we withdrew.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And taking me, the angel restored me to the place where I was at the beginning.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: And having come to myself, I gave glory to God, who counted me worthy of such honour.

title: 3 Baruch (Greek Apocalypse of Baruch)
text: As for you brothers, who have received such a revelation, glorify God yourselves, so that he might also glorify you both now and for ever and ever. Amen.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Ahora, Baruch estaba llorando en mi mente y sufriendo por causa del pueblo, y que Nabucodonosor el rey fue permitido por Dios para destruir Su ciudad, diciendo:

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Señor, ¿por qué puso su viña en llamas, y lo desperdiciaron? ¿Por qué hiciste esto? ¿Y por qué, Señor, no nos requirió con otro castigo, sino que nos entregó a naciones como estas, para que nos reprocharan y dijeran: ‘¿Dónde está su Dios?’

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y he aquí, mientras lloraba y decía tales cosas, vi venir a un ángel del Señor y me decía: «Entender, oh hombre, grandemente amado, y no te molestes tanto en la salvación de Jerusalén, porque así dice el Señor Dios, el Todopoderoso.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Porque me envió delante de ti para anunciar y mostrarte todo lo de Dios.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Porque vuestra oración fue escuchada delante de él, y entró en los oídos del Señor Dios.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y cuando me había dicho estas cosas, estaba en silencio. Y el ángel me dijo: “Cea provocar a Dios, y te mostraré otros misterios, más grandes que estos.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y Baruch dije: "Como el Señor Dios vive, si me muestras, y oigo tu palabra, no seguiré hablando más. Dios añadirá a mi juicio en el día del juicio, si hablo más adelante.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel de los poderes me dijo: Ven, y te mostraré los misterios de Dios.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y él me llevó y me llevó donde el firmamento ha sido apoyado, y donde había un río que nadie puede cruzar, ni ninguna brisa extraña de todos aquellos a quienes Dios creó.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y me llevó y me llevó al primer cielo, y me mostró una puerta enorme. Y me dijo: “Entramos a través de ella.” Y entramos en las alas, una distancia de unos treinta días de viaje.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y me mostró dentro del cielo un llano; y había hombres que moraban sobre él, con rostros de bueyes, y cuernos de establos y pies de cabras, y con las hacinas de corderos.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y yo Baruch le pregunté al ángel: «Avisadme, os pido, ¿cuál es el grosor del cielo en el que viajamos, o cuál es su alcance, o cuál es la llanura, para que también pueda contar a los hijos de los hombres?»

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel cuyo nombre es Phamael me dijo: “Esta puerta que ves es la puerta del cielo, y tan grande como la distancia de la tierra al cielo, tan grande también es su grosor; y otra vez tan grande como la distancia (de Norte al Sur, tan grande) es la longitud de la llanura que viste.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y nuevamente el ángel de los poderes me dijo: Ven, y te mostraré más misterios.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Pero dije: "Te imploro, muéstrame cuáles son estos hombres". Y me dijo: Estos son los que construyeron la torre de lucha contra Dios, y el Señor los desterró.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel del Señor me llevó y me llevó a un segundo cielo. Y él me mostró allí también una puerta como la primera y dijo, "Entramos a través de ella."

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y entramos, llevando a las alas una distancia de unos sesenta días de viaje.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y me mostró allí también una llanura, y estaba llena de hombres, cuya apariencia era como la de los perros, y cuyos pies eran como los de los escalones.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y le pregunté al ángel: “Te imploro, Señor, dime quiénes son estos.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y él dijo: Estos son los que dieron consejo para construir la torre, porque aquellos a los que ustedes ven condujeron multitudes de hombres y mujeres, para hacer ladrillos; entre ellos, una mujer que hace ladrillos no fue permitida ser liberada en la hora del nacimiento de los niños, sino que sacó mientras ella estaba haciendo ladrillos, y llevó a su hijo en su delantal, y continuó haciendo ladrillos.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el Señor se les apareció y confundió su discurso, cuando habían construido la torre a la altura de cuatrocientos sesenta y tres codos.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y tomaron un pantano, y trataron de atravesar el cielo, diciendo: "Veamos (ya sea) el cielo está hecho de arcilla, bronce, o hierro."

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Cuando Dios vio esto Él no los permitió, sino que los golpeó con ceguera y confusión de discurso, y los hizo como ustedes ven.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y Baruch dije: He aquí, Señor, me mostraste cosas grandes y maravillosas; y ahora me mostraste todas las cosas por amor del Señor.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel me dijo: Ven, vamos. (Y yo fui) con el ángel de ese lugar cerca de ciento ochenta y cinco días de viaje.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y me mostró Hades, y su apariencia era oscura y abominable.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: ¿Quién es este dragón, y qué es esta dureza alrededor de él?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel dijo: El dragón es el que come los cuerpos de los que pasan su vida mal, y él es nutrido por ellos.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y este es Hades, que también se parece mucho a él, porque también bebe alrededor de un codo del mar, que no se hunde en absoluto.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Baruch dijo: "¿Y cómo (hace esto)?" Y el ángel dijo: Escucha, el Señor Dios hizo trescientos sesenta ríos, de los cuales el jefe de todos son Alphias, Abyrus y Gericus; y por éstos el mar no se hunde.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y dije: "Te imploro, muéstrame cuál es el árbol que llevó a Adán extraviarse." Y el ángel me dijo: "Es la vid, que el ángel Sammael plantó, donde el Señor Dios estaba enojado, y él lo maldijo a él y a su planta, mientras que también en este relato Él no permitió que Adán lo tocara, y por lo tanto el diablo siendo envidioso lo engañaba a través de su vid.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y Baruch dije: "Pues también la vid ha sido la causa de tal gran mal, y está bajo juicio de la maldición de Dios, y fue la destrucción de la primera creada, ¿cómo es ahora tan útil?"

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel dijo: "Usted pregunta correctamente. Cuando Dios causó el diluvio sobre la tierra, y destruyó toda carne, y cuatrocientos nueve mil gigantes, y el agua subió quince codos por encima de las montañas más altas, el agua entró en el paraíso y destruyó cada flor; pero quitó totalmente fuera de los límites el tiro de la vid y la echó fuera.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y cuando la tierra apareció del agua, y Noé salió del arca, comenzó a plantar de las plantas que halló.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Pero halló también el brote de la vid, y lo tomó, y razonaba en sí mismo, ¿Qué es entonces? Y vine y hablé con él las cosas que le conciernen.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y él dijo: ¿Lo plantaré, o qué haré? Puesto que Adán fue destruido por ello, no me reunáis también con la ira de Dios por ello. Y diciendo estas cosas, oró para que Dios le revelara lo que debía hacer con respecto a ella.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y cuando había completado la oración que duró cuarenta días, y habiendo pedido muchas cosas y llorado, dijo: Señor, te pido que me reveles lo que debo hacer con respecto a esta planta.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Entonces envió Dios su ángel Sarasael, y le dijo: Levántate, Noé, y planta la rama, porque así dice el Señor. Su amargura será transformada en dulzura, y su maldición se convertirá en bendición, y lo que se produce de ella se convertirá en la sangre de Dios; y como por ella la raza humana obtuvo condenación, así de nuevo a través de Jesucristo el Immanuel recibirán en Él el llamado ascendente, y la entrada en el paraíso.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Sabed pues, oh Baruch, que como Adán a través de este mismo árbol obtuvo condenación, y fue inmerso en la gloria de Dios, así también los hombres que ahora beben insaciablemente el vino que es engendrado de él, transgreden peor que Adán, y están lejos de la gloria de Dios, y se están rindiendo al fuego eterno.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Porque (no) el bien viene a través de él. Porque los que lo beben por exceso hacen estas cosas: ni un hermano compadece a su hermano, ni a su hijo, ni a sus hijos, sino a la bebida del vino vienen todos los males, como asesinatos, adulterios, fornicaciones, perjurias, robos, y tales como. Y nada bueno es establecido por ella.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y Baruch le dijo al ángel: "Déjame preguntarte una cosa, Señor.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Porque me dijiste que el dragón bebe un codo del mar, dime también cuán grande es su vientre?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel dijo: Su vientre es Hades; y hasta trescientos hombres lanzan una jabalina, tan grande es su vientre. Ven, entonces, para que pueda mostrarte también obras mayores que estas.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y llevándome, me llevó donde se levanta el sol.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y me mostró un carro de cuatro ruedas que estaba bajo fuego. Y un hombre estaba sentado en el carro usando una corona de fuego. El carro estaba siendo tirado por cuarenta ángeles. Y he aquí un pájaro flotaba delante del sol a unos nueve codos de distancia.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y le dije al ángel: ¿Qué es este pájaro? Y me dijo: “Este es el guardián del mundo (habitado).

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y dije: Señor, ¿cómo es el guardián del mundo (habitado)? Enséñame.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel me dijo: “Este pájaro vuela junto al sol, y expandiendo sus alas recibe sus ardientes rayos.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Porque si no los estuviera recibiendo, la raza humana no sería preservada, ni ninguna otra criatura viviente. Pero Dios puso a este pájaro en su lugar.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y amplió sus alas, y vi en su ala derecha letras muy grandes, tan grandes como el espacio de una trilladora, el tamaño de alrededor de cuatro mil modii;1 y las letras eran de oro.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel me dijo: "Lean". Y leí. Y dijeron así: Ni la tierra ni el cielo me dieron a luz, pero las alas de fuego me dieron a luz.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y dije: Señor, ¿qué es este pájaro, y cuál es su nombre?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel me dijo: "Su nombre se llama Fénix".

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: ¿Y qué come? Y me dijo: El maná del cielo y el rocío de la tierra.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y dije, ¿excreta el pájaro? Y me dijo: Excreta un gusano, y el excremento del gusano es canela, que usan reyes y príncipes. Pero espera y verás la gloria de Dios.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y mientras él estaba conversando conmigo, había como un trueno, y el lugar fue sacudido en el que estábamos de pie. Y le pregunté al ángel: Mi Señor, ¿qué es este sonido? Y el ángel me dijo: Aun ahora los ángeles están abriendo las trescientas sesenta y cinco puertas del cielo, y la luz está siendo separada de la oscuridad.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y vino una voz que dijo, "Light giver, dar al mundo el resplandor."

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y cuando escuché el ruido del pájaro, dije: Señor, ¿qué es este ruido?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y él dijo: Este es el pájaro que despierta de somnolencia los gallos sobre la tierra. Porque como los hombres hacen a través de la boca, así también el gallo significa a los del mundo, en su propio discurso. Porque el sol está preparado por los ángeles, y el gallo canta.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y dije: ¿Y dónde comienza el sol sus labores, después de que el gallo cuervo?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel me dijo: "¡Escucha, Baruch! Todas las cosas que te mostré están en el primer y segundo cielo, y en el tercer cielo el sol pasa y da luz al mundo. Pero espera, y verás la gloria de Dios.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y mientras hablaba con él, vi al pájaro, y apareció en frente, y creció poco a poco, y entonces era de tamaño completo.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y detrás de ella vi el sol brillante, y los ángeles que la dibujan, y una corona sobre su cabeza, la vista de la cual no pudimos mirar directamente y ver.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y tan pronto como el sol brillaba, el Fénix también extendía sus alas. Pero cuando vi tal gran gloria, me desplomé con gran temor, y huí y escondí en las alas del ángel.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel me dijo: No temas, Baruch, pero espera y también verás su escenario.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y llevándome, me llevó hacia el oeste. Y cuando llegó el momento del escenario, volví a ver al pájaro que venía delante de él, y el sol que venía con los ángeles. Y cuando vino, vi a los ángeles, y alzaron la corona de su cabeza.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Pero el pájaro estaba agotado y sus alas contratadas.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y viendo estas cosas, dije: Señor, ¿por qué levantaron la corona de la cabeza del sol, y por qué está tan agotado el pájaro?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel me dijo: "Los cuatro ángeles toman la corona del sol cuando ha corrido por el día y la llevan al cielo y la renuevan porque sus rayos han sido contaminados sobre la tierra. Y así cada día se renueva”.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y Baruch dije: Señor, ¿Y por qué sus vigas están contaminadas sobre la tierra? Y el ángel me dijo: "Porque ve la impiedad y la injusticia de los hombres, a saber, fornicaciones, adulterios, robos, extorsiones, idólatras, embriaguez, asesinatos, luchas, celos, malversaciones, murmuraciones, susurros, adivinaciones, y tales como, que no son buenos para Dios. Debido a estas cosas está contaminado, y por lo tanto es renovado.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Pero usted preguntó acerca del pájaro, por qué está agotado. Debido a que al contener los rayos del sol a través del fuego y el calor ardiente de todo el día, se agota así.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Porque, como dijimos antes, a menos que sus alas estuvieran proyectando los rayos del sol, ninguna criatura viviente sería preservada.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y cuando se retiraron, la noche también se asomó. Al mismo tiempo, vino la luna junto con las estrellas.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y yo, Baruch dijo, Señor, Muéstrame también, te imploro, cómo sale (la luna), donde sale, y en qué forma se mueve.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel dijo: "Espera, y lo verás también pronto." Y al día siguiente también lo vi en forma de mujer, sentada en un carro con ruedas. Y había antes bueyes y corderos en el carro, y multitud de ángeles también.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y dije: Señor, ¿qué son los bueyes y los corderos? Y me dijo: “También son ángeles.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y otra vez pregunté, "¿Por qué es que en un momento aumenta, pero en otro momento disminuye?"

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: ¡Escuchen, Baruch! Esto que ustedes ven en la belleza había sido escrito por Dios como ningún otro.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y en la transgresión del primer Adán, estaba cerca de Sammael cuando llevaba la serpiente como una prenda. Y no se escondió sino se incrementó, y Dios estaba enojado con él, y lo afligió, y acortaron sus días.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y dije: ¿Y cómo no brilla siempre, sino sólo en la noche? Y el ángel dijo: ¡Escucha! Así como sus cortesanos no pueden hablar libremente en presencia de un rey, por lo que la luna y las estrellas no pueden brillar en la presencia del sol; porque las estrellas están siempre suspendidas, pero son proyectadas por el sol, y la luna, aunque no se lesiona, es consumida por el calor del sol.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y cuando había aprendido todas estas cosas del arcángel, me llevó y me llevó a un cuarto cielo.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y vi una llanura extendida, y en medio de ella un lago de agua.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y en ella había multitudes de aves de todo tipo, pero no como las aquí [en la tierra]. Pero vi una grúa tan grande como un buey. Y todos eran más grandes que los del mundo.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y le pregunté al ángel: ¿Qué es esta llanura, y cuál es el lago, y cuáles son las multitudes de aves alrededor de ella?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel dijo: "Escucha, Baruch! La llanura que contiene el lago y otras maravillas en ella es el lugar donde vienen las almas justas. Se reúnen juntando coro por coro.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Pero el agua es lo que las nubes reciben, y la lluvia sobre la tierra, y los frutos aumentan.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y dije otra vez al ángel del Señor: ¿Y estas aves? Y me dijo: “Son los que continuamente cantan alabanza al Señor.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y yo, Baruch, dije: Señor, ¿cómo dicen los hombres que el agua que baja en lluvia es del mar?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel dijo: El agua que viene del mar y también de aquí descende como lluvia sobre la tierra; pero la lluvia que activa el fruto viene solamente de esta última fuente.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Es, pues, de esta última fuente la que se llama el rocío del cielo.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y después de llevarme, este ángel me llevó a un quinto cielo.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y la puerta estaba cerrada. Y dije: Señor, ¿no abre esta puerta para entrar? Y el ángel me dijo: "No podemos entrar hasta que venga Miguel, que tiene las llaves del Reino de los Cielos; pero espera y verás la gloria de Dios."

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y hubo un sonido fuerte, como el trueno. Y dije: Señor, ¿qué es este sonido?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y me dijo: “Aún ahora Miguel, el comandante de los ángeles, viene a recibir las oraciones de los hombres.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y he aquí una voz, Que se abran las puertas. Y ellos los abrieron, y había un rugido como de trueno.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y vino Miguel, y el ángel que estaba conmigo, se volvió cara a cara con él y dijo: "Salve, mi comandante, y todas las tropas de nosotros."

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el comandante Michael dijo: “Ay de vosotros también, nuestro hermano, y el intérprete de las revelaciones a los que pasan por la vida apropiadamente.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y habiendo saludado unos a otros así, se quedaron quietos. Y vi al comandante Miguel, sosteniendo un vaso muy grande; su profundidad era tan grande como la distancia del cielo a la tierra, y su anchura tan grande como la distancia de norte a sur. Y dije: Señor, ¿qué es Michael el arcángel que sostiene?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y me dijo: Aquí es donde entran los méritos de los justos, y las buenas obras que hacen, que son escoltadas delante del Dios celestial.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y mientras yo estaba conversando con ellos, he aquí ángeles vinieron llevando canastas llenas de flores. Y se los dieron a Michael.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y le pregunté al ángel: Señor, ¿quiénes son éstos, y cuáles son las cosas que vienen de su lado?

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y me dijo: “Estos son ángeles (quienes) están sobre los justos”.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el arcángel tomó las canastas, y las tiró al tazón.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y el ángel me dijo: Estas flores son los méritos de los justos.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y vi a otros ángeles llevando canastas que no estaban vacías. Y comenzaron a lamentarse, y no se atrevieron a acercarse, porque no tenían premios completos.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y Michael gritó y dijo: Ven aquí, también vosotros ángeles, traed lo que habéis traído.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y Miguel estaba muy afligido, y el ángel que estaba conmigo, porque no llenaron el tazón.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y luego vinieron otros ángeles llorando y llorando y temiendo diciendo: "Estamos afligidos, Señor, que los hombres malvados se han rendido, y nos apartaremos de ellos."

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y Miguel dijo: No puedes apartarte de ellos, porque al final el enemigo gana; pero dime qué estás pidiendo.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y ellos dijeron: Te pedimos, Miguel, nuestro comandante principal, que nos traspases de ellos, porque no podemos vivir con hombres impíos e insensatos, porque no hay nada bueno en ellos, pero son todos injustos y codiciosos.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: “Porque nunca los vemos entrar en la iglesia, no como padres espirituales, no en buen trabajo. Pero donde hay asesinatos en medio de eso. Donde hay fornicación, robos, calumnias, perjurias, celos, embriaguez, lucha, envidia, murmullos, susurros, idolatría, adivinación, y tales como, entonces son trabajadores de tales obras, y de otros peores. Por lo tanto queremos apartarnos de ellos.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y Miguel dijo a los ángeles: Espera hasta que aprenda del Señor lo que sucederá.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y en aquella misma hora se fue Miguel, y las puertas estaban cerradas. Y había un sonido como el trueno.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y le pregunté al ángel: ¿Qué es ese sonido? Y me dijo: “Ahora Miguel está presentando los méritos de los hombres a Dios.”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y en aquella misma hora descendió Miguel, y se abrió la puerta, y trajo aceite.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y para los ángeles que trajeron las canastas llenas, las llenó de aceite, diciendo: Apartaos, recompensad a nuestros amigos cien veces, y a los que diligentemente hicieron buenas obras. Porque aquellos que sembraron bien, también cosechan bien. ”

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y dijo también a los que traían las canastas de medio vacío: Ven aquí también; quita la recompensa conforme tú trajiste, y líbrala a los hijos de los hombres.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Entonces dijo también a los que trajeron el íntegro y a los que trajeron las canastas medio vacías: «Id y bendecid a nuestros amigos, y did a los que así dice el Señor: «Vosotros fuisteis fieles sobre algunas cosas, os pondré sobre muchas cosas; entrad en la alegría de vuestro Señor».

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y volviéndose él dijo también a los que no trajeron nada: Así dice el Señor: No te quedes hinchado y no llores, ni dejes solos a los hijos de los hombres.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Pero como me enojaron por sus obras, vayan y enojen y provocan contra aquellos que no son una nación, una nación que carece de entendimiento.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Además, con ellos, envía al oruga y a la langosta desenrollada, y al leve, y a la langosta común, aclama con relámpagos y ira, y castiga con la espada y con la muerte a ellos y a sus hijos con demonios.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Porque no obedecieron mi voz, ni guardaron mis mandamientos, ni los hicieron, sino que eran despreciadores de mis mandamientos, e insolentes hacia los sacerdotes que les proclamaban mis palabras."

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y mientras hablaba, la puerta estaba cerrada, y nos retiramos.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y llevándome, el ángel me restauró al lugar donde estaba al principio.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: Y habiendo venido a mí mismo, dí gloria a Dios, que me contó digno de tal honor.

title: 3 Baruc (Apocalipsis griego de Baruc)
text: En cuanto a vosotros, hermanos, que habéis recibido tal revelación, glorificad a Dios vosotros mismos, para que también os glorifique ahora y para siempre. Amén.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: When I ascended on high to behold the vision of the Merkaba and had entered the six Halls, one within the other:

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: as soon as I reached the door of the seventh Hall I stood still in prayer before the Holy One, blessed be He, and, lifting up my eyes on high (i.e. towards the Divine Majesty), I said :

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: " Lord of the Universe, I pray thee, that the merit of Aaron, the son of Amram, the lover of peace and pursuer of peace, who received the crown of priesthood from Thy Glory on the mount of Sinai, be valid for me in this hour, so that Qafsiel*, the prince, and the angels with him may not get power over me nor throw me down from the heavens ".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Forthwith the Holy One, blessed be He, sent to me Metatron, his Servant ('Ebed) the angel, the Prince of the Presence, and he, spreading his wings, with great joy came to meet me so as to save me from their hand.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And he took me by his hand in their sight, saying to me: "Enter in peace before the high and exalted King3 and behold the picture of the Merkaba".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Then I entered the seventh Hall, and he led me to the camp(s) of Shekina and placed me before 6the Holy One, blessed be He, to behold the Merkaba.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: As soon as the princes of the Merkaba and the flaming Seraphim perceived me, they fixed their eyes upon me. Instantly trembling and shuddering seized me and I fell down and was benumbed by the radiant image of their eyes and the splendid appearance of their faces; until the Holy One, blessed be He, rebuked them, saying:

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: "My servants, my Seraphim, my Kerubim and my 'Ophanniml Cover ye your eyes before Ishmael, my son, my friend, my beloved one and my glory, that he tremble not nor shudder ! "

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Forthwith Metatron the Prince of the Presence, came and restored my spiritand put me upon my feet.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: After that (moment) there was notin me strength enough to say a song before the Throne of Glory of the glorious King, the mightiest of all kings, the most excellent of all princes, until after the hour had passed.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: After one hour (had passed) the Holy One, blessed be He, opened to me the gates of Shekina, the gates of Peace, the gates of Wisdom, the gates of Strength, the gates of Power, the gates of Speech (Dibbur), the gates of Song, the gates of Qedushsha, the gates of Chant.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And he enlightened my eyes and my heart by words of psalm, song, praise, exaltation, thanksgiving, extolment, glorification, hymn and eulogy. And as I opened my mouth, uttering a song before the Holy One, blessed be He, the Holy Chayyoth beneath and above the Throne of Glory answered and said : "HOLY " and "BLESSED BE THE GLORY OF YHWH FROM HIS PLACE !" (i.e. chanted the Qedushsha).

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: In that hour the eagles of the Merkaba, the flaming 'Ophannim and the Seraphim of consuming fire asked Metatron, saying to him:

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: "Youth ! Why sufferest thou one born of woman to enter and behold the Merkaba? From which nation, from which tribe is this one? What is his character?"

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Metatron answered and said to them : "From the nation of Israel whom the Holy One, blessed be He, chose for his people from among seventy tongues (nations), from the tribe of Levi, whom he set aside as a contribution to his name and from the seed of Aaron whom the Holy One, blessed be He, did choose for his servant and put upon him the crown of priesthood on Sinai".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Forthwith they spake and said : "Indeed, this one is worthy to behold the Merkaba ". And they said: "Happy is the people that is in such a case!".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: In that hourl I asked Metatron, the angel, the Prince of the Presence: "What is thy name?"

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: He answered me: "I have seventy names, corresponding to the seventy tongues of the world and all of them are based upon the name Metatron, angel of the Presence; but my King calls me Youth' (Na'ar)"

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: I asked Metatron and said to him: "Why art thou called by the name of thy Creator, by seventy names? Thou art greater than all the princes, higher than all the angels, beloved more than all the servants, honoured above all the mighty ones in kingship, greatness and glory : why do they call thee ' Youth ' in the high heavens ?"

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: He answered and said to me: " Because I am Enoch, the son of Jared.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: For when the generation of the flood sinned and were confounded in their deeds, saying unto God: 'Depart from us, for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways' (Job xxi. 14), then the Holy One, blessed be He, removed me from their midst to be a witness against them in the high heavens to all the inhabitants of the world, that they may not say: 'The Merciful One is cruel".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: What sinned all those multitudes, their wives, their sons and their, daughters, their horses, their mules and their cattle and their property, and all the birds of the world, all of which the Holy One, blessed be He, destroyed from the world together with them in the waters of the flood?

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Hence the Holy One, blessed be He, lifted me up in their lifetime before their eyes to be a witness against them to the future world. And the Holy One, blessed be He, assigned me for a prince and a ruler among the ministering angels.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: In that hour three of the ministering angels, 'UZZA, 'AZZA and 'AZZAEL came forth and brought charges against me in the high heavens, saying before the Holy One, blessed be He: "Said not the Ancient Ones (First Ones) rightly before Thee: < Do not create man! ' " The Holy One, blessed be He, answered and said unto them: "I have made and I will bear, yea, I will carry and will deliver". (Is. xlvi. 4.)

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: As soon as they saw me, they said before Him: "Lord of the Universe ! What is this one that he should ascend to the height of heights? Is not he one from among the sons of [the sons of] those who perished in the days of the Flood? "What doeth he in the Raqia'?"

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Again, the Holy One, blessed be He, answered and said to them: "What are ye, that ye enter and speak in my presence? I delight in this one more than in all of you, and hence he shall be a prince and a ruler over you in the high heavens."

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Forthwith all stood up and went out to meet me, prostrated themselves before me and said: "Happy art thou and happy is thy father for thy Creator doth favour thee".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And because I am small and a youth among them in days, months and years, therefore they call me "Youth" (Na'ar).

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: From the day when the Holy One, blessed be He, expelled the first Adam from the Garden of Eden (and onwards), Shekina was dwelling upon a Kerub under the Tree of Life.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And the ministering angels were gathering together and going down from heaven in parties, from the Raqia in companies and from the heavens in camps to do His will in the whole world.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And the first man and his generation were sitting outside the gate of the Garden to behold the radiant appearance of the Shekina.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: For the silendour of the Shekina traversed the world from one end to the other (with a splendour) 365,000 times (that) of the globe of the sun. And everyone who made use of the splendour of the Shekina, on him no flies and no gnats did rest, neither was he ill nor suffered he any pain. No demons got power over him, neither were they able to injure him.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: When the Holy One, blessed be He, went out and went in; from the Garden to Eden, from Eden to the Garden, from the Garden to Raqia and from Raqia to the Garden of Eden then all and everyone beheld the splendour of His Shekina and they were not injured;

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: until uthe time of the generation of Enosh who was the head of all idol worshippers of the world.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And what did the generation of Enosh do? They went from one end of the world to the other, and each one brought silver, gold, precious stones and pearls in heaps like unto mountains and hills making idols out of them throughout all the world. And they erected the idols in every quarter of the world: the size of each idol was 1000 parasangs.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And they brought down the sun, the moon, planets and constellations, and placed them before the idols on their right hand and on their left, to attend them even as they attend the Holy One, blessed be He, as it is written (1 Kings xxii. 19): "And all the host of heaven was standing by him on his right hand and on his left".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: What power was in them that they were able to bring them down? They would not have been able to bring them down but for 'Uzza, 'Azza and 'Azziel who taught them sorceries whereby they brought them down and made use of them

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: In that time the ministering angels brought charges (against them) before the Holy One, blessed be He, saying before him: "Master of the World! What hast thou to do with the children of men? As it is written (Ps. viii. 4) 'What is man (Enosh) that thou art mindful of him?' 'Mah Adam' is not written here, but 'Mah Enosh', for he (Enosh) is the head of the idol worshippers.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Why hast thou left the highest of the high heavens, the abode of thy glorious Name, and the high and exalted Throne in 'Araboth Raqia' in the highest and art gone and dwellest with the children of men who worship idols and equal thee to the idols.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Now thou art on earth and the idols likewise. What hast thou to do with the inhabitants of the earth who worship idols?"

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Forthwith the Holy One, blessed be He, lifted up His Shekina from the earth, from their midst.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: In that moment came the ministering angels, the troops of hosts and the armies of 'Araboth in thousand camps and ten thousand hosts : they fetched trumpets and took the horns in their hands and surrounded the Shekina with all kinds of songs.And He ascended to the high heavens, as it is written (Ps. xlvii. 5): "God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet ".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: When the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to lift me up on high, He first sent 'Anaphiel H (H = Tetragrammaton) the Prince, and he took me from their midst in their sight and carried me in great glory upon a a fiery chariot with fiery horses, servants of glory. And he lifted me up to the high heavens together with the Shekina.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: As soon as I reached the high heavens, the Holy Chayyoth, the 'Ophannim, the Seraphim, the Kerubim, the Wheels of the Merkaba (the Galgallim), and the ministers of the consuming fire, perceiving my smell from a distance of 365,ooo myriads of parasangs, said: "What smell of one born of woman and what taste of a white drop (is this) that ascends on high, and (lo, he is merely) a gnat among those who 'divide flames (of fire)'?"

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: The Holy One, blessed be He, answered and spake unto them: "My servants, my hosts, my Kerubim, my 'Ophannim, my Seraphim! Be ye not displeased on account of this! Since all the children of men have denied me and my great Kingdom and are gone worshipping idols, I have removed my Shekina from among them and have lifted it up on high. But this one whom I have taken from among them is an ELECT ONE among (the inhabitants of) the world and he is equal to all of them in faith, righteousness and perfection of deed and I have taken him for (as) a tribute from my world under all the heavens".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: When the Holy One, blessed be He, took me away from the generation of the Flood, he lifted me on the wings of the wind of Shekina to the highest heaven and brought me into the great palaces of the 'Araboth Raqia' on high, where are the glorious Throne of Shekina, the Merkaba, the troops of anger, the armies of vehemence, the fiery Shin'anim', the flaming Kerubim, and the burning 'Ophannim, the flaming servants, the flashing Chashmattim and the lightening Seraphim. And he placed me (there) to attend the Throne of Glory day after day.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Before He appointed me to attend the Throne of Glory, the Holy One, blessed be He, opened to me three hundred thousand gates of Understanding three hundred thousand gates of Subtlety three hundred thousand gates of Life three hundred thousand gates of grace and loving-kindness three hundred thousand gates of love three hundred thousand gates of Tora three hundred thousand gates of meekness three hundred thousand gates of maintenance three hundred thousand gates' of mercy three hundred thousand gates of fear of heaven

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: In that hour the Holy One, blessed be He, added in me wisdom unto wisdom, understanding unto understanding, subtlety unto subtlety, knowledge unto knowledge, mercy unto mercy, instruction unto instruction, love unto love, loving-kindness unto loving-kindness, goodness unto goodness, meekness unto meekness, power unto power, strength unto strength, might unto might, brilliance unto brilliance, beauty unto beauty, splendour unto splendour, and I was honoured and adorned with all these good and praiseworthy things more than all the children of heaven.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: After all these things the Holy One, blessed be He, put His hand upon me and blessed me with 5360 blessings.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And I was raised and enlarged to the size of the length and width of the world.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And He caused 72 wings to grow on me, 36 on each side. And each wing was as the whole world.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And He fixed on me 365 eyes : each eye was as the great luminary.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And He left no kind of splendour, brilliance, radiance, beauty in (of) all the lights of the universe that He did not fix on me.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: All these things the Holy One, blessed be He, made for me:He made me a Throne, similar to the Throne of Glory. And He spread over me a curtain of splendour and brilliant appearance, of beauty, grace and mercy, similar to the curtain of the Throne of Glory; and on it were fixed all kinds of lights in the universe.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And He placed it at the door of the Seventh Hall and seated me on it.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And the herald went forth into every heaven, saying:This is Metatron, my servant. I have made him into a prince and a ruler over all the princes of my kingdoms and over all the children of heaven, except the eight great princes, the honoured and revered ones who are called YHWH, by the name of their King.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And every angel and every prince who has a word to speak in my presence (before me) shall go into his presence (before him) and shall speak to him (instead).

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And every command that he utters to you in my name do ye observe and fulfil. For the Prince of Wisdom and the Prince of Understanding have I committed to him to instruct him in the wisdom of heavenly things and of earthly things, in the wisdom of this world and of the world to come.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Moreover, I have set him over all the treasuries of the palapes of Araboih and over all the stores of life that I have in the high heavens.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Henceforth the Holy One, blessed be He, revealed to me all the mysteries of Tora and all the secrets of wisdom and all the depths of the Perfect Law; and all living beings' thoughts of heart and all the secrets of the universe and all the secrets of Creation were revealed unto me even as they are revealed unto the Maker of Creation.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And I watched intently to behold the secrets of the depth and the wonderful mystery. Before a man did think in secret, I saw (it) and before a man made a thing I beheld it.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And there was no thing on high nor in the deep hidden from me.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: By reason of the love with which the Holy One, blessed be He, loved me more than all the children of heaven. He made me a garment of glory on which were fixed all kinds of lights, and He clad me in it.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And He made me a robe of honour on which were fixed all kinds of beauty, splendour, brilliance and majesty.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And he made me a royal crown in which were fixed forty-nine costly stones like unto the light of the globe of the sun.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: For its splendour went forth in the four quarters of the Araboth Raqia', and in (through) the seven heavens, and in the four quarters of the world. And he put it on my head.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And He called me THE LESSER YHWH in the presence of all His heavenly household; as it is written (Ex. xxiii. 21): "For my name is in him".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Because of the great love and mercy with which the Holy One, blessed be He, loved and cherished me more than all the children of heaven. He wrote with his ringer with a flaming style upon the crown on my head the letters by which were created heaven and earth, the seas and rivers, the mountains and hills, the planets and constellations, the Ughtnings, winds, earthquakes and voices (thunders), the snow and hail, the storm-wind and the tempest ; the letters by which were created all the needs of the world and all the orders of Creation.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And every single letter sent forth time after time as it were lightnings, time after time as it were torches, time after time as it were flames of fire, time after time (rays) like [as] the rising of the sun and the moon and the planets.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: When the Holy One, blessed be He, put this crown on my head, (then) trembled before me all the Princes of Kingdoms who are in the height of Araboth Raqiaf and all the hosts of every heaven; and even the princes (of) the 'Elim, the princes (of) the 'Er'ellim and the princes (of) the Tafsarim, who are greater than all the ministering angels who minister before the Throne of Glory, shook, feared and trembled before me when they beheld me.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Even Sammael, the Prince of the Accusers, who is greater than all the princes of kingdoms on high; feared and trembled before me.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And even the angel of fire, and the angel of hail, and the angel of the wind, and the angel of the lightning, and the angel of anger, and the angel of the thunder, and the angel of the snow, and the angel of the rain ; and the angel of the day, and the angel of the night, and the angel of the sun and the angel of the moon, and the angel of the planets and the angel of the constellations who rule the world under their hands, feared and trembled and were affrighted before me, when they beheld me.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: These are the names of the rulers of the world: Gabriel, the angel of the fire, Baradiel, the angel of the hail, Ruchiel who is appointed over the wind, Baraqiel who is appointed over the lightnings, Za'amiel who is appointed over the vehemence, Ziqiel who is appointed over the sparks, Zi'iel who is appointed over the commotion, Zdaphiel who is appointed over the storm-wind, Ra'amiel who is appointed over the thunders, Rctashiel who is appointed over the earthquake, Shalgiel who is appointed over the snow, Matariel who is appointed over the rain, Shimshiel who is appointed over the day, Lailiel who is appointed over the night, Galgalliel who is appointed over the globe of the sun, 'Ophanniel who is appointed over the globe of the moon, Kokbiel who is appointed over the planets, Rahatiel who is appointed over the constellations.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And they all fell prostrate, when they saw me. And they were not able to behold me because of the majestic glory and beauty of the appearance of the shining light of the crown of glory upon my head.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: As soon as the Holy One, blessed be He, took me in (His) service to attend the Throne of Glory and the Wheels (Galgallim) of the Merkaba and the needs of Shekina, forthwith my flesh was changed into flames, my sinews into flaming fire, my bones into coals of burning juniper, the light of my eye-lids into splendour of lightnings, my eye-balls into fire-brands, the hair of my head into dot flames, all my limbs into wings of burning fire and the whole of my body into glowing fire.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And on my right were divisions 6 of fiery flames, on my left fire-brands were burning, round about me stormwind and tempest were blowing and in front of me and behind me was roaring of thunder with earthquake. FRAGMENT OF 'ASCENSION OF MOSES'

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: R. Ishmael said: Said to me Metatron, the Prince of the Presence and the prince over all the princes and he stands befote Him who is greater than all the Elohim. And he goes in under the Throne of Glory. And he has a great tabernacle of light on high. And he brings forth the fire of deafness and puts (it) into the ears of the Holy Chayyoth, that they may not hear the voice of the Word (Dibbur) that goes forth from the mouth of the Divine Majesty.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And when Moses ascended on high, he fasted 121 fasts, till the habitations of the chashmal were opened to him; and he saw the heart within the heart of the Lion and he saw the innumerable companies of the hosts Around about him. And they desired to burn him. But Moses prayed for mercy, first for Israel and after that for himself: and He who sitteth on the Merkaba opened the windows that are above the heads of the Kerubim. And a host of 1800 advocates and the Prince of the Presence, Metatron, with them went forth to meet Moses. And they took the prayers of Israel and put them as a crown on the head of the Holy One, blessed be He.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And they said (Deut. vi. 4): "Hear, O Israel; the Lord our God is one Lord"and their face shone and rejoiced over Shekinaand they said to Metatron: "What are these? And to whom do they give all this honour and glory?" And they answered: "To the Glorious Lord of Israel". And they spake: "Hear, O Israel: the Lord, our God, is one Lord. To whom shall be given abundance of honour and majesty but to Thee YHWH, the Divine Majesty, the King, living and eternal".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: In that moment spake Akatriel Yah Yehod Sebaoth and said to Metatron, the Prince of the Presence: "Let no prayer that he prayeth before me return (to him) void. Hear thou his prayer and fulfil his desire whether (it be) great or small".

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Forthwith Metatron, the Prince of the Presence, said to Moses: "Son of Amram! Fear not, for now God delights in thee. And ask thou u thy desire of the Glory and Majesty. For thy face shines from one end of the world to the other". But Moses answered him: "(I fear) lest I bring guiltiness upon myself". Metatron said to him: "Receive the letters of the oath, in (by) which there is no breaking the covenant" (which precludes any breach of the covenant).

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: At first I was sitting upon a great Throne at the door of the Seventh Hall ; and I was judging the children of heaven, the household on high by authority of the Holy One, blessed be He. And I divided Greatness, Kingship, Dignity, Rulership, Honour and Praise, and Diadem and Crown of Glory unto all the princes of kingdoms, while I was presiding (lit. sitting) in the Celestial Court (Yeshiba), and the princes of kingdoms were standing before me, on my right and on my left by authority of the Holy One, blessed be He.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: But when Acher came to behold the vision of the Merkaba and fixed his eyes on me, he feared and trembled before me and his soul was affrighted even unto departing from him, because of fear, horror and dread of me, when he beheld me sitting upon a throne like a king with all the ministering angels standing by me as my servants and all the princes of kingdoms adorned with crowns surrounding me:

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: in that moment he opened his mouth and said: "Indeed, there are two Divine Powers in heaven!"

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Forthwith Bath Qol (the Divine Voice) went forth from heaven from before the Shekina and said: "Return, ye backsliding children (Jer. iii. 22), except Acher!"

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Then came 'Aniyel, the Prince, the honoured, glorified, beloved, wonderful, revered and fearful one, in commission from the Holy One, blessed be He and gave me sixty strokes with lashes of fire and made me stand on my feet.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Seven (are the) princes, the great, beautiful, revered, wonderful and honoured ones who are appointed over the seven heavens. And these are they : MIKAEL, GABRIEL, SHATQIEL, SHACHAQIEL, BAKARIEL, BAD ARIEL, PACHRIEL.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: And every one of them is the prince of the host of (one) heaven. And each one of them is accompanied by 496,000 myriads of ministering angels.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: MIKAEL, the great prince, is appointed over the seventh heaven, the highest one, which is in the 'Araboth. GABRIEL, the prince of the host, is appointed over the sixth heaven which is in Makon. SHATAQIEL, prince of the host, is appointed over the fifth heaven which is in Ma'on. SHAHAQi'EL, prince of the host, is appointed over the fourth heaven which is in Zebul. BAD ARIEL, prince of the host, is appointed over the third heaven which is in Shehaqim. BARAKIEL, prince of the host, is appointed over the second heaven which is in the height of (Merom) Raqia. PAZRIEL, prince of the host, is appointed over the first heaven which is in Wilon, which is in Shamayim.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Under them is GALGALLIEL, the prince who is appointed over the globe (galgal) of the sun, and with him are 96 great and honoured angels who move the sun in Raqia'.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Under them is 'OPHANNIEL, the prince who is set over the globe ('ophari) of the moon. And with him are 88 angels who move the globe of the moon 354 thousand parasangs every night at the time when the moon stands in the East at its turning point. And when is the moon sitting in the East at its turning point? Answer: in the fifteenth day of every month.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
text: Under them is RAHATIEL, the prince who is appointed over the constellations. And he is accompanied by 72 great and honoured angels. And why is he called RAHATIEL? Because he makes the stars run (marhit) in their orbits and courses 339 thousand parasangs every night from the East to the West, and from the West to the East. For the Holy One, blessed be He, has made a tent for all of them, for the sun, the moon, the planets and the stars in which they travel at night from the West to the East.

title: 3 Enoch (Hebrew Book of Enoch / Sefer Hekhalot)
