text: Mouth! thou shalt not pollute my old age, nor the full stature of a perfect life.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: My fathers shall receive me pure, not having quailed before your compulsion, though unto death.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For over the ungodly thou shalt tyrannize; but thou shalt not lord it over my thoughts about religion, either by thy arguments, or through deeds.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: When Eleazar had in this manner answered the exhortations of the tyrant, the spearbearers came up, and rudely haled Eleazar to the instruments of torture.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And first, they stripped the old man, adorned as he was with the comeliness of piety.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Then tying back his arms and hands, they disdainfully used him with stripes;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: a herald opposite crying out, Obey the commands of the king.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But Eleazar, the high-minded and truly noble, as one tortured in a dream, regarded it not at all.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But raising his eyes on high to heaven, the old man's flesh was stripped off by the scourges, and his blood streamed down, and his sides were pierced through.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And falling upon the ground, from his body having no power to support the pains, he yet kept his reasoning upright and unbending.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Then one of the harsh spearbearers leaped upon his belly as he was falling, to force him upright.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But he endured the pains, and despised the cruelty, and persevered through the indignities;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: and like a noble athlete, the old man, when struck, vanquished his torturers.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: His countenance sweating, and he panting for breath, he was admired by the very torturers for his courage.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Wherefore, partly in pity for his old age,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: partly from the sympathy of acquaintance, and partly in admiration of his endurance, some of the attendants of the king said,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Why do you unreasonably destroy yourself, O Eleazar, with these miseries?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: We will bring you some meat cooked by yourself, and do you save yourself by pretending that you have eaten swine's flesh.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And Eleazar, as though the advice more painfully tortured him, cried out,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Let not us who are children of Abraham be so evil advised as by giving way to make use of an unbecoming pretence;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: for it were irrational, if having lived up to old age in all truth, and having scrupulously guarded our character for it, we should now turn back,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: and ourselves should become a pattern of impiety to the young, as being an example of pollution eating.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: It would be disgraceful if we should live on some short time, and that scorned by all men for cowardice,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: and be condemned by the tyrant for unmanliness, by not contending to the death for our divine law.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Wherefore do you, O children of Abraham, die nobly for your religion.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Ye spearbearers of the tyrant, why do ye linger?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Beholding him so high-minded against misery, and not changing at their pity, they led him to the fire:

title: 4 Maccabees
text: then with their wickedly-contrived instruments they burnt him on the fire, and poured stinking fluids down into his nostrils.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And he being at length burnt down to the bones, and about to expire, raised his eyes God-ward, and said,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Thou knowest, O God, that when I might have been saved, I am slain for the sake of the law by tortures of fire.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Be merciful to thy people, and be satisfied with the punishment of me on their account.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Let my blood be a purification for them, and take my life in recompense for theirs.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Thus speaking, the holy man departed, noble in his torments, and even to the agonies of death resisted in his reasoning for the sake of the law.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Confessedly, therefore, religious reasoning is master of the passions.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For had the passions been superior to reasoning, I would have given them the witness of this mastery.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But now, since reasoning conquered the passions, we befittingly award it the authority of first place.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And it is but fair that we should allow, that the power belongs to reasoning, since it masters external miseries.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Ridiculous would it be were it not so; and I prove that reasoning has not only mastered pains, but that it is also superior to the pleasures, and withstands them.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: The reasoning of our father Eleazar, like a first-rate pilot, steering the vessel of piety in the sea of passions,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: and flouted by the threats of the tyrant, and overwhelmed with the breakers of torture,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: in no way shifted the rudder of piety till it sailed into the harbour of victory over death.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Not so has ever a city, when besieged, held out against many and various machines, as did that holy man, when his pious soul was tried with the fiery trial of tortures and rackings, move his besiegers through the religious reasoning that shielded him.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For father Eleazar, projecting his disposition, broke the raging waves of the passions as with a jutting promontory.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O priest, worthy of the priesthood! thou didst not pollute thy sacred teeth; nor make thy appetite, which had always embraced the clean and lawful, a partaker of profanity.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O harmonizer with the law, and sage devoted to a divine life!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Of such a character ought those to be who perform the duties of the law at the risk of their own blood, and defend it with generous sweat by sufferings even unto death.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Thou, father, hast gloriously established our right government by thy endurance; and making of much account our service past, prevented its destruction, and, by thy deeds, hast made credible the words of philosophy.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O aged man of more power than tortures, elder more vigorous than fire, greatest king over the passions, Eleazar!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For as father Aaron, armed with a censer, hastening through the consuming fire, vanquished the flame-bearing angel,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: so Eleazar, the descendant of Aaron, wasted away by the fire, did not give up his reasoning.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And, what is most wonderful, though an old man, though the labours of his body were now spent, and his fibres were relaxed, and his sinews worn out, he recovered youth.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: By the spirit of reasoning, and the reasoning of Isaac, he rendered powerless the many-headed instrument.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O blessed old age, and reverend hoar head, and life obedient to the law, which the faithful seal of death perfected.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: If, then, an old man, through religion, despised tortures even unto death, confessedly religious reasoning is ruler of the passions.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But perhaps some might say, It is not all who conquer passions, as all do not possess wise reasoning.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But they who have meditated upon religion with their whole heart, these alone can master the passions of the flesh:

title: 4 Maccabees
text: they who believe that to God they die not; for, as our forefathers, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, they live to God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: This circumstance, then, is by no means an objection, that some who have weak reasoning, are governed by their passions:

title: 4 Maccabees
text: since what person, walking religiously by the whole rule of philosophy, and believing in God,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: and knowing that it is a blessed thing to endure all kinds of hardships for virtue, would not, for the sake of religion, master his passion?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For the wise and brave man only is lord over his passions.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Whence it is, that even boys, imbued with the philosophy of religious reasoning, have conquered still more bitter tortures:

title: 4 Maccabees
text: for when the tyrant was manifestly vanquished in his first attempt, in being unable to force the old man to eat the unclean thing,—

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Then, indeed, vehemently swayed with passion, he commanded to bring others of the adult Hebrews, and if they would eat of the unclean thing, to let them go when they had eaten; but if they objected, to torment them more grievously.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: The tyrant having given this charge, seven brethren were brought into his presence, along with their aged mother, handsome, and modest, and well-born, and altogether comely.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Whom, when the tyrant beheld, encircling their mother as in a dance, he was pleased at them; and being struck with their becoming and ingenuous mien, smiled upon them, and calling them near, said,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O youths, with favourable feelings, I admire the beauty of each of you; and greatly honouring so numerous a band of brethren, I not only counsel you not to share the madness of the old man who has been tortured before,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: but I do beg you to yield, and to enjoy my friendship; for I possess the power, not only of punishing those who disobey my commands, but of doing good to those who obey them.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Put confidence in me, then, and you shall receive places of authority in my government, if you forsake your national ordinance,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: and, conforming to the Greek mode of life, alter your rule, and revel in youth's delights.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For if you provoke me by your disobedience, you will compel me to destroy you, every one, with terrible punishments by tortures.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Have mercy, then, upon your own selves, whom I, although an enemy, compassionate for your age and comeliness.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Will you not reason upon this—that if you disobey, there will be nothing left for you but to die in tortures?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Thus speaking, he ordered the instruments of torture to be brought forward, that very fear might prevail upon them to eat unclean meat.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And when the spearman brought forward the wheels, and the racks, and hooks, and catapeltæ, and caldrons, pans, and finger-racks, and iron hands, and wedges, and bellows, the tyrant continued:

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Fear, young men, and the Righteousness which ye worship will be merciful to you if you err from compulsion.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Now they having listened to these words of persuasion, and seeing the fearful instruments, not only were not afraid, but even answered the arguments of the tyrant, and through their good reasoning destroyed his power.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Now let us consider the matter: had any of them been weak-spirited and cowardly among them, what reasonings would they have employed but such as these?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O wretched that we are, and exceeding senseless! when the king exhorts us, and calls us to his bounty, should we not obey him?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Why do we cheer ourselves with vain counsels, and venture upon a disobedience bringing death?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Shall we not fear, O brethren, the instruments of torture, and weigh the threatenings of torment, and shun this vain-glory and destructive pride?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Let us have compassion upon our age and relent over the years of our mother.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And let us bear in mind that we shall be dying as rebels.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And Divine Justice will pardon us if we fear the king through necessity.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Why withdraw ourselves from a most sweet life, and deprive ourselves of this pleasant world?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Let us not oppose necessity, nor seek vain-glory by our own excruciation.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: The law itself is not forward to put us to death, if we dread torture.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Whence has such angry zeal taken root in us, and such fatal obstinacy approved itself to us, when we might live unmolested by giving ear to the king?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But nothing of this kind did the young men say or think when about to be tortured.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For they were well aware of the sufferings, and masters of the pains. So that as soon as the tyrant had ceased counselling them to eat the unclean, they altogether with one voice, as from the same heart, said:

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Why delayest thou, O tyrant? for we are readier to die than to transgress the injunctions of our fathers.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And we should be disgracing our fathers if we did not obey the law, and take knowledge for our guide.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O tyrant, counsellor of law-breaking, do not, hating us as thou dost, pity us more than we pity ourselves.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For we account your pity of us on the terms of unlawful escape to be worse than death.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And you think to scare us, by threatening us with death by tortures, as though thou hadst learned nothing by the death of Eleazar.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But if aged men of the Hebrews have died in the cause of religion after enduring torture, more rightly should we younger men die, scorning your cruel tortures, which our aged instructor overcame.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Make the attempt, then, O tyrant; and if thou puttest us to death for our religion, think not that thou harmest us by torturing us.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For we through this ill-treatment and endurance shall bear off the rewards of virtue.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But thou, for the wicked and despotic slaughter of us, shalt, from the Divine vengeance, endure eternal torture by fire.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: When they had thus spoken, the tyrant was not only exasperated against them as being refractory, but enraged with them as being ungrateful.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: So that, at his bidding, the torturers brought forth the eldest of them, and tearing through his tunic, bound his hands and arms on each side with thongs.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And when they had laboured hard without effect in scourging him, they hurled him upon the wheel.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And the noble youth, extended upon this, became dislocated.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And with every member disjointed, he exclaimed in expostulation,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O most accursed tyrant, and enemy of heavenly justice, and cruel-hearted, I am no murderer, nor sacrilegious man, whom thou thus ill-usest; but a defender of the Divine law.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And when the spearmen said, Consent to eat, that you may be released from your tortures,—

title: 4 Maccabees
text: he answered, Not so powerful, O accursed ministers, is your wheel, as to stifle my reasoning; cut my limbs, and burn my flesh, and twist my joints.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For through all my torments I will convince you that the children of the Hebrews are alone unconquered in behalf of virtue.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: While he was saying this, they heaped up fuel, and setting fire to it, strained him upon the wheel still more.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And the wheel was defiled all over with blood, and the hot ashes were quenched by the droppings of gore, and pieces of flesh were scattered about the axles of the machine.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And although the framework of his bones was now destroyed, the high-minded and Abrahamic youth did not groan.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But, as though transformed by fire into immortality, he nobly endured the rackings, saying,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Imitate me, O brethren, nor ever desert your station, nor abjure my brotherhood in courage: fight the holy and honourable fight of religion;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: by which means our just and paternal Providence, becoming merciful to the nation, will punish the pestilent tyrant.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And saying this, the revered youth abruptly closed his life.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And when all admired his courageous soul, the spearmen brought forward him who was second in point of age, and having put on iron hands, bound him with pointed hooks to the catapelt.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And when, on enquiring whether he would eat before he was tortured, they heard his noble sentiment,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: after they with the iron hands had violently dragged all the flesh from the neck to the chin, the panther-like beasts tore off the very skin of his head: but he, bearing with firmness this misery, said,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: How sweet is every form of death for the religion of our fathers! and he said to the tyrant,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Thinkest thou not, most cruel of all tyrants, that thou art now tortured more than I, finding thy overweening conception of tyranny conquered by our patience in behalf of our religion?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For I lighten my suffering by the pleasures which are connected with virtue.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But thou art tortured with threatenings for impiety; and thou shalt not escape, most corrupt tyrant, the vengeance of Divine wrath.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Now this one, having endured this praiseworthy death, the third was brought along, and exhorted by many to taste and save his life.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But he cried out and said, Know ye not, that the father of those who are dead, begat me also; and that the same mother bare me; and that I was brought up in the same tenets?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: I abjure not the noble relationship of my brethren.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: a Now then, whatever instrument of vengeance ye have, apply it to my body, for ye are not able to touch, even if ye wish it, my soul.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But they, highly incensed at his boldness of speech, dislocated his hands and feet with racking engines, and wrenching them from their sockets, dismembered him.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And they dragged round his fingers, and his arms, and his legs, and his ankles.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And not being able by any means to strangle him, they tore off his skin, together with the extreme tips of his fingers, flayed him, and then haled him to the wheel;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: around which his vertebral joints were loosened, and he saw his own flesh torn to shreds, and streams of blood flowing from his entrails.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And when about to die, he said,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: We, O accursed tyrant, suffer this for the sake of Divine education and virtue.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But thou, for thy impiety and blood-shedding, shalt endure indissoluble torments.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And thus having died worthily of his brethren, they dragged forward the fourth, saying,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Do not thou share the madness of thy brethren: but give regard to the king, and save thyself.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But he said to them, You have not a fire so scorching as to make me play the coward.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: By the blessed death of my brethren, and the eternal punishment of the tyrant, and the glorious life of the pious, I will not repudiate the noble brotherhood.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Invent, O tyrant, tortures; that you may learn, even through them, that I am the brother of those tormented before.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: When he had said this, the bloodthirsty, and murderous, and unhallowed Antiochus ordered his tongue to be cut out.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But he said, Even if you take away the organ of speech, yet God hears the silent.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Behold, my tongue is extended, cut it off; for not for that shalt thou extirpate our reasoning.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Gladly do we lose our limbs in behalf of God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But God shall speedily find you, since you cut off the tongue, the instrument of divine melody.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And when he had died, disfigured in his torments, the fifth leaped forward, and said,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: I intend not, O tyrant, to get excused from the torment which is in behalf of virtue.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But I have come of my own accord, that by the death of me, you may owe heavenly vengeance a punishment for more crimes.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O thou hater of virtue and of men, what have we done that thou thus revellest in our blood?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Does it seem evil to thee that we worship the Founder of all things, and live according to his surpassing law?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But this is worthy of honours, not of torments;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: a hadst thou been capable of the higher feelings of men, and possessed the hope of salvation from God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: b Behold, now, being alien from God, thou makest war against those who are religious toward God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: As he said this, the spearbearers bound him, and drew him to the catapelt:

title: 4 Maccabees
text: to which binding him at his knees, and fastening them with iron fetters, they bent down his loins upon the wedge of the wheel; and his body was then dismembered, scorpion-fashion.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: With his breath thus confined, and his body strangled, he said,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: A great favour thou bestowest upon us, O tyrant, by enabling us to manifest our adherence to the law by means of nobler sufferings.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: He also being dead, the sixth, quite a youth, was brought out; and on the tyrant asking him whether he would eat and be delivered, he said,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: I am indeed younger than my brothers, but in understanding I am as old;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: for having been born and reared unto the same end, we are bound to die also in behalf of the same cause.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: So that if thou think proper to torment us for not eating the unclean;—torment!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: As he said this, they brought him to the wheel.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Extended upon which, with limbs racked and dislocated, he was gradually roasted from beneath.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And having heated sharp spits, they approached them to his back; and having transfixed his sides, they burned away his entrails.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And he, while tormented, said, O period good and holy, in which, for the sake of religion, we brothers have been called to the contest of pain, and have not been conquered.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For religious understanding, O tyrant, is unconquered.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Armed with upright virtue, I also shall depart with my brethren.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: I, too, bearing with me a great avenger, O deviser of tortures, and enemy of the truly pious.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: We six youths have destroyed thy tyranny.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For is not your inability to overrule our reasoning, and to compel us to eat the unclean, thy destruction?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Your fire is cold to us, your catapelts are painless, and your violence harmless.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For the guards not of a tyrant but of a divine law are our defenders: through this we keep our reasoning unconquered.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: When he, too, had undergone blessed martyrdom, and died in the caldron into which he had been thrown, the seventh, the youngest of all, came forward:

title: 4 Maccabees
text: whom the tyrant pitying, though he had been dreadfully reproached by his brethren,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: seeing him already encompassed with chains, had him brought nearer, and endeavoured to counsel him, saying,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Thou seest the end of the madness of thy brethren: for they have died in torture through disobedience; and you, if disobedient, having been miserably tormented, will yourself perish prematurely.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But if you obey, you shall be my friend, and have a charge over the affairs of the kingdom.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And having thus exhorted him, he sent for the mother of the boy; that, by condoling with her for the loss of so many sons, he might incline her, through the hope of safety, to render the survivor obedient.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And he, after his mother had urged him on in the Hebrew tongue, (as we shall soon relate) says,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Release me, that I may speak to the king and all his friends.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And they, rejoicing exceedingly at the promise of the youth, quickly let him go.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And he, running up to the pans, said,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Impious tyrant, and most blasphemous man, wert thou not ashamed, having received prosperity and a kingdom from God, to slay His servants, and to rack the doers of godliness?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Wherefore the divine vengeance is reserving thee for eternal fire and torments, which shall cling to thee for all time.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Wert thou not ashamed, man as thou art, yet most savage, to cut out the tongues of men of like feeling and origin, and having thus abused to torture them?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But they, bravely dying, fulfilled their religion towards God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But thou shalt groan according to thy deserts for having slain without cause the champions of virtue.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Wherefore, he continued, I myself, being about to die,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: will not forsake the testimony of my brethren.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And I call upon the God of my fathers to be merciful to my race.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But thee, both living and dead, he will punish.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Thus having prayed, he hurled himself into the pans; and so expired.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: If then, the seven brethren despised troubles even unto death, it is confessed on all sides that righteous reasoning is absolute master over the passions.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For just as if, had they as slaves to the passions eaten of the unholy, we should have said that they had been conquered by them;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: now it is not so: but by means of the reasoning which is praised by God, they mastered their passions.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And it is impossible to overlook the leadership of reflection: for it gained the victory over both passions and troubles.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: How, then, can we avoid according to these men mastery of passion through right reasoning, since they drew not back from the pains of fire?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For just as by means of towers projecting in front of harbours men break the threatening waves, and thus assure a still course to vessels entering port,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: so that seven-towered right-reasoning of the young men, securing the harbour of religion, conquered the intemperance of passions.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For having arranged a holy choir of piety, they encouraged one another, saying,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Brothers, may we die brotherly for the law. Let us imitate the three young men in Assyria who despised the equally afflicting furnace.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Let us not be cowards in the manifestation of piety.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And one said, Courage, brother; and another, Nobly endure.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And another, Remember of what stock ye are; and by the hand of what father Isaac endured to be slain for the sake of piety.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And one and all, looking on each other serene and confident, said, Let us sacrifice with all our heart our souls to God who gave them, and employ our bodies for the keeping of the law.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Let us not fear him who thinketh he killeth;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: for great is the trial of soul and danger of eternal torment laid up for those who transgress the commandment of God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Let us arm ourselves, therefore, in the abnegation of the divine reasoning.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: If we suffer thus, Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob will receive us, and all the fathers will commend us.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And as each one of the brethren was haled away, the rest exclaimed, Disgrace us not, O brother, nor falsify those who have died before you.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Now you are not ignorant of the charm of brotherhood, which the Divine and all-wise Providence has imparted through fathers to children, and has engendered through the mother's womb.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: In which these brothers having remained an equal time, and having been formed for the same period, and been increased by the same blood, and having been perfected through the same principle of life,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: and having been brought forth at equal intervals, and having sucked milk from the same fountains, hence their brotherly souls are reared up lovingly together;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: and increase the more powerfully by reason of this simultaneous rearing, and by daily intercourse, and by other education, and exercise in the law of God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Brotherly love being thus sympathetically constituted, the seven brethren had a more sympathetic mutual harmony.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For being educated in the same law, and practising the same virtues, and reared up in a just course of life, they increased this harmony with each other.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For a like ardour for what is right and honourable increased their fellow-feeling towards each other.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For it acting along with religion, made their brotherly feeling more desirable to them.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And yet, although nature and intercourse and virtuous morals increased their brotherly love, those who were left endured to behold their brethren, who were ill-used for their religion, tortured even unto death.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And more than this, they even urged them on to this ill-treatment; so that they not only despised pains themselves, but they even got the better of their affections of brotherly love.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O reasonings more royal than a king, and freer than freemen!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Sacred and harmonious concert of the seven brethren as concerning piety!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: None of the seven youths turned cowardly, or shrank back from death.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But all of them, as though running the road to immortality, hastened on to death through tortures.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For just as hands and feet are moved sympathetically with the directions of the soul, so those holy youths agreed unto death for religion's sake, as through the immortal soul of religion.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O holy seven of harmonious brethren! for as the seven days of creation, about religion,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: so the youths, circling around the number seven, annulled the fear of torments.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: We now shudder at the recital of the affliction of those young men; but they not only beheld, and not only heard the immediate execution of the threat, but undergoing it, persevered; and that through the pains of fire.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And what could be more painful? for the power of fire, being sharp and quick, speedily dissolved their bodies.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And think it not wonderful that reasoning bore rule over those men in their torments, when even a woman's mind despised more manifold pains.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For the mother of those seven youths endured the rackings of each of her children.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And consider how comprehensive is the love of offspring, which draws every one to sympathy of affection,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: where irrational animals possess a similar sympathy and love for their offspring with men.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: The tame birds frequenting the roofs of our houses, defend their fledglings.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Others build their nests, and hatch their young, in the tops of mountains and in the precipices of valleys, and the holes and tops of trees, and keep off the intruder.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And if not able to do this, they fly circling round them in agony of affection, calling out in their own note, and save their offspring in whatever manner they are able.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But why should we point attention to the sympathy toward children shewn by irrational animals?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: The very bees, at the season of honey-making, attack all who approach; and pierce with their sting, as with a sword, those who draw near their hive, and repel them even unto death.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But sympathy with her children did not turn aside the mother of the young men, who had a spirit kindred with that of Abraham.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O reasoning of the sons, lord over the passions, and religion more desirable to a mother than progeny!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: The mother, when two things were set before her, religion and the safety of her seven sons for a time, on the conditional promise of a tyrant,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: rather elected the religion which according to God preserves to eternal life.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O in what way can I describe ethically the affections of parents toward their children, the resemblance of soul and of form engrafted into the small type of a child in a wonderful manner, especially through the greater sympathy of mothers with the feelings of those born of them!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: for by how much mothers are by nature weak in disposition and prolific in offspring, by so much the fonder they are of children.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And of all mothers the mother of the seven was the fondest of children, who in seven childbirths had deeply engendered love toward them;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: and through her many pains undergone in connection with each one, was compelled to feel sympathy with them;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: yet, through fear of God, she neglected the temporary salvation of her children.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Not but that, on account of the excellent disposition of her sons, and their obedience to the law, her maternal affection toward them was increased.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For they were both just and temperate, and manly, and high-minded, and fond of their brethren, and so fond of their mother that even unto death they obeyed her by observing the law.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And yet, though there were so many circumstances connected with love of children to draw on a mother to sympathy, in the case of none of them were the various tortures able to pervert her principle.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But she inclined each one separately and all together to death for religion.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O holy nature and parental feeling, and reward of bringing up children, and unconquerable maternal affection!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: At the racking and roasting of each one of them, the observant mother was prevented by religion from changing.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: She beheld her children's flesh dissolving around the fire; and their extremities quivering on the ground, and the flesh of their heads dropped forwards down to their beards, like masks.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O thou mother, who wast tried at this time with bitterer pangs than those of parturition!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O thou only woman who hast brought forth perfect holiness!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Thy first-born, expiring, turned thee not; nor the second, looking miserable in his torments; nor the third, breathing out his soul.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Nor when thou didst behold the eyes of each of them looking sternly upon their tortures, and their nostrils foreboding death, didst thou weep!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: When thou didst see children's flesh heaped upon children's flesh that had been torn off, hands upon hands cut off, heads decapitated upon heads, dead falling upon the dead, and a choir of children turned through torture into a burying-ground, thou lamentedst not.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Not so do siren melodies, or songs of swans, attract the hearers to listening, O voices of children calling upon your mother in the midst of torments!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: With what and what manner of torments was the mother herself tortured, as her sons were undergoing the wheel and the fires!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But religious reasoning, having strengthened her courage in the midst of sufferings, enabled her to forego, for the time, parental love.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Although beholding the destruction of seven children, the noble mother, after one embrace, stripped off [her feelings] through faith in God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For just as in a council-room, beholding in her own soul vehement counsellors, nature and parentage and love of her children, and the racking of her children,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: she holding two votes, one for the death, the other for the preservation of her children,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: did not lean to that which would have saved her children for the safety of a brief space.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But this daughter of Abraham remembered his holy fortitude.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O mother of a nation, avenger of the law, and defender of religion, and prime bearer in the battle of the affections!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O thou nobler in endurance than males, and more manly than men in patience!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For as the ark of Noah, bearing the world in the world-filling flood, bore up against the waves,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: so thou, the guardian of the law, when surrounded on every side by the flood of passions, and straitened by violent storms which were the torments of thy children, didst bear up nobly against the storms against religion.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: If, then, even a woman, and that an aged one, and the mother of seven children, endured to see her children's torments even unto death, confessedly religious reasoning is master even of the passions.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: I have proved, then, that not only men have obtained the mastery of their passions, but also that a woman despised the greatest torments.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And not so fierce were the lions round Daniel, nor the furnace of Misael burning with most vehement fire, as that natural love of children burned within her, when she beheld her seven sons tortured.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But with the reasoning of religion the mother quenched passions so great and powerful.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For we must consider also this: that, had the woman been faint-hearted, as being their mother, she would have lamented over them; and perhaps might have spoken thus:

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Ah! wretched I, and many times miserable; who having born seven sons, have become the mother of none.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O seven useless childbirths, and seven profitless periods of labour, and fruitless givings of suck, and miserable nursings at the breast.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Vainly, for your sakes, O sons, have I endured many pangs, and the more difficult anxieties of rearing.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Alas, of my children, some of you unmarried, and some who have married to no profit, I shall not see your children, nor be felicitated as a grandmother.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Ah, that I who had many and fair children, should be a lone widow full of sorrows!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Nor, should I die, shall I have a son to bury me.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Nor did she divert any of them from death, nor grieve for them as for the dead.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But as one possessed with an adamantine mind, and as one bringing forth again her full number of sons to immortality, she rather with supplications exhorted them to death in behalf of religion.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O woman, soldier of God for religion, thou, aged and a female, hast conquered through endurance even a tyrant; and though but weak, hast been found more powerful in deeds and words.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For when thou wast seized along with thy children, thou stoodest looking upon Eleazar in torments, and saidst to thy sons in the Hebrew tongue,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O sons, noble is the contest; to which you being called as a witness for the nation, strive zealously for the laws of your country.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For it were disgraceful that this old man should endure pains for the sake of righteousness, and that you who are younger should be afraid of the tortures.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Remember that through God ye obtained existence, and have enjoyed it.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And on this account ye ought to bear every affliction because of God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For whom also our father Abraham was forward to sacrifice Isaac our progenitor, and shuddered not at the sight of his own paternal hand descending down with the sword upon him.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And the righteous Daniel was cast unto the lions; and Ananias, and Azarias, and Misael, were slung out into a furnace of fire; yet they endured through God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: You, then, having the same faith towards God, be not troubled.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For it is unreasonable that they who know religion should not stand up against troubles.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: With these arguments, the mother of seven, exhorting each of her sons, over-persuaded them from transgressing the commandment of God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And they saw this, too, that they who die for God, live to God; as Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the patriarchs.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And some of the spearbearers said, that when she herself was about to be seized for the purpose of being put to death, she threw herself upon the pile, rather than that they should touch her person.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O thou mother, who together with seven children didst destroy the violence of the tyrant, and render void his wicked intentions, and exhibit the nobleness of faith!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For thou, as a house bravely built upon the pillar of thy children, didst bear without swaying, the shock of tortures.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Be of good cheer, therefore, O holy-minded mother! holding the firm [substance of the] hope of your steadfastness with God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Not so gracious does the moon appear with the stars in heaven, as thou art established honourable before God, and fixed in the firmament with thy sons whom thou didst illuminate with religion to the stars.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For thy bearing of children was after the fashion of a child of Abraham.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And, were it lawful for us to paint as on a tablet the religion of thy story, the spectators would not shudder at beholding the mother of seven children enduring for the sake of religion various tortures even unto death.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And it had been a worthy thing to have inscribed upon the tomb itself these words as a memorial to those of the nation,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Here an aged priest, and an aged woman, and seven sons, are buried through the violence of a tyrant, who wished to destroy the polity of the Hebrews.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: These also avenged their nation, looking unto God, and enduring torments unto death.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For it was a truly divine contest which was carried through by them.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For at that time virtue presided over the contest, approving the victory through endurance, namely, immortality, eternal life.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Eleazar was the first to contend: and the mother of the seven children entered the contest; and the brethren contended.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: The tyrant was the opposite; and the world and living men were the spectators.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And reverence for God conquered, and crowned her own athletes.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Who did not admire those champions of true legislation? who were not astonied?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: The tyrant himself, and all their council, admired their endurance;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: through which, also, they now stand beside the divine throne, and live a blessed life.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For Moses saith, And all the saints are under thy hands.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: These, therefore, having been sanctified through God, have been honoured not only with this honour, but that also by their means the enemy did not overcome our nation;

title: 4 Maccabees
text: and that the tyrant was punished, and their country purified.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For they became the antipoise to the sin of the nation; and the Divine Providence saved Israel, aforetime afflicted, by the blood of those pious ones, and their propitiatory death.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For the tyrant Antiochus, looking to their manly virtue, and to their endurance in torture, proclaimed that endurance as an example to his soldiers.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And they proved to be to him noble and brave for land battles and sieges; and he conquered and stormed the towns of all his enemies.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O Israelitish children, descendants of the seed of Abraham, obey this law, and in every way be religious.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Knowing that religious reasoning is lord of the passions, and those not only inward but outward.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Whence those persons giving up their bodies to pains for the sake of religion, were not only admired by men, but were deemed worthy of a divine portion.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And the nation through them obtained peace, and having renewed the observance of the law in their country, drove the enemy out of the land.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And the tyrant Antiochus was both punished upon earth, and is punished now he is dead; for when he was quite unable to compel the Israelites to adopt foreign customs, and to desert the manner of life of their fathers,

title: 4 Maccabees
text: then, departing from Jerusalem, he made war against the Persians.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And the righteous mother of the seven children spake also as follows to her offspring: I was a pure virgin, and went not beyond my father's house; but I took care of the built-up rib.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: No destroyer of the desert, [or] ravisher of the plain, injured me; nor did the destructive, deceitful, snake, make spoil of my chaste virginity; and I remained with my husband during the period of my prime.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And these my children, having arrived at maturity, their father died: blessed was he! for having sought out a life of fertility in children, he was not grieved with a period of loss of children.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And he used to teach you, when yet with you, the law and the prophets.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: He used to read to you the slaying of Abel by Cain, and the offering up of Isaac, and the imprisonment of Joseph.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And he used to tell you of the zealous Phinehas; and informed you of Ananias and Azarias, and Misael in the fire.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And he used to glorify Daniel, who was in the den of lions, and pronounce him blessed.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: And he used to put you in mind of the scripture of Esaias, which saith, Even if thou pass through the fire, it shall not burn thee.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: He chanted to you David, the hymn-writer, who saith, Many are the afflictions of the just.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: He declared the proverbs of Solomon, who saith, He is a tree of life to all those who do His will.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: He used to verify Ezekiel, who said, Shall these dry bones live?

title: 4 Maccabees
text: For he did not forget the song which Moses taught, proclaiming, I will kill, and I will make to live.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: This is our life, and the length of our days.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: O that bitter, and yet not bitter, day when the bitter tyrant of the Greeks, quenching fire with fire in his cruel caldrons, brought with boiling rage the seven sons of the daughter of Abraham to the catapelt, and to all his torments!

title: 4 Maccabees
text: He pierced the balls of their eyes, and cut out their tongues, and put them to death with varied tortures.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: Wherefore divine retribution pursued and will pursue the pestilent wretch.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: But the children of Abraham, with their victorious mother, are assembled together to the choir of their fathers; having received pure and immortal souls from God.

title: 4 Maccabees
text: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Como voy a demostrar una proposición más filosófica, es decir, que el razonamiento religioso es el maestro absoluto de las pasiones, le aconsejaría voluntariamente que merece la máxima atención a la filosofía.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por la razón es necesario para cada uno como un paso a la ciencia; y más especialmente abraza la comprensión de la prudencia, la virtud más alta.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Si, entonces, el razonamiento parece tener el dominio sobre las pasiones que están en el camino de la templanza, como la glotonía y la lujuria,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Ciertamente también y manifiestamente tiene la regla sobre los afectos que son contrarios a la justicia, como la malicia; y de aquellos que son obstáculos a la obediencia, como la ira, y el dolor, y el miedo.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¿Cómo, entonces, es, tal vez algunos pueden decir, que el razonamiento, si gobierna los afectos, no es también maestro de olvidar e ignorar? Intentan un argumento.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque el razonamiento no gobierna sobre sus propios afectos, sino sobre los que son contrarios a la justicia, y a la mansedumbre, y a la prudencia; y tía sobre éstos, para resistir, sin destruirlos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Podría demostrarles, desde muchas otras consideraciones, que el razonamiento religioso es el único maestro de las pasiones;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero lo pruebaé con la mayor fuerza de la fortaleza de Eleazar, y siete hermanos, y su madre, que sufrieron la muerte en defensa de la virtud.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por todos estos dolores, hasta la muerte, por este desprecio, demostró que el razonamiento tiene el mando sobre las pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por sus virtudes, entonces, es correcto que encomiende a los hombres que murieron con su madre en este momento en nombre de la rectitud; y por sus honores, puedo contarlos felices.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque ellos, supuestamente admiración no sólo de los hombres en general, sino incluso de sus perseguidores, por su humildad y resistencia, se desprende en los medios de la destrucción de la tiranía contra su nación, habiendo conquistado el tirano por su resistencia, para que por ellos su país fuese purificado.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero ahora podemos entrar inmediatamente en la pregunta, habiendo comenzado, como es nuestro, con la imposición de la doctrina, y así proceder a la cuenta de estas personas, dando gloria al Dios sabio.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por lo tanto, la cuestión es si el razonamiento es un maestro absoluto de las pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Vamos a determinar, entonces, ¿Qué es el motivo? ¿Y pasión qué? ¿Y distorsionas formas de las pasiones? ¿Y si el razonamiento de los osos pasa por todas estas cosas?

title: 4 Macabeos
text: La razón es, entonces, el intelecto acompañado de una vida de rectitud, poniendo sobre todo la consideración de la sabiduría.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y la sabiduría es un conocimiento de las cosas divinas y humanas, y de sus causas.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y esto está contenido en la educación de la ley; mediante la cual aprendemos cosas divinas reverentemente, y cosas humanas provechosamente.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y las formas de sabiduría son prudencia, justicia, mansedumbre y temperancia.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: El principal de estos es la prudencia; por cuyos medios, de hecho, es que el razonamiento domina las pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: De las pasiones, el placer y el dolor son los dos más completos; y también por naturaleza se refieren al alma.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y hay muchos afectos que rodean el placer y el dolor.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Antes del placer es la lujuria; y después del placer, la alegría.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y antes del dolor es el miedo; y después del dolor, el dolor.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: La ira es un afecto, común al placer y al dolor, si alguien prestará atención cuando se trata de él.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y existe en el placer una disposición maliciosa, que es la más multiforme de todos los afectos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: En el alma es la arrogancia, y el amor del dinero, y la vaingloridad, y la contención, y la impiedad, y el mal ojo.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: En el cuerpo es la codicia y la gormandiza, y la gluttonía solitaria.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Como placer y dolor son, por lo tanto, dos crecimientos del cuerpo y del alma, por lo que hay muchas ondas de estas pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y el razonamiento, el marido universal, la purga y la poda varias veces, y el riego, y el trasplante, de todas maneras mejora los materiales de la moral y los afectos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por razonar es el líder de las virtudes, pero es el único gobernante de las pasiones. Observe entonces primero, a través de las mismas cosas que están en el camino de la templanza, que el razonamiento es el gobernante absoluto de las pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Ahora el temperamento consiste en un comando sobre los deseos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero de las concupiscencias, algunos pertenecen al alma, otros al cuerpo; y sobre cada una de estas clases el razonamiento parece llevar el camino.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque ¿de otro modo, cuando se insta a prohibir las carnes, rechazamos la gratificación que se produciría de ellas? ¿No es porque el razonamiento es capaz de ordenar los deseos? Eso creo.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por lo tanto es, entonces, que cuando la lujuria por los animales y aves de agua, y las bestias de cuatro pies, y todo tipo de alimento que nos está prohibido por la ley, nos retenemos a través del dominio del razonamiento.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque los afectos de nuestros deseos se resisten por la comprensión templada, y se doblan de nuevo, y todos los impulsos del cuerpo se retienen por el razonamiento.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¿Y qué maravilla? si los deseos del alma, después de la participación con lo que es hermoso, están frustrados,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: en este terreno, por lo tanto, el temperado José es alabado en eso por el razonamiento, él sometió, sobre la reflexión, la indulgencia del sentido.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque, aunque joven, y madura para la relación sexual, se desbrogó por razonar el estímulo de sus pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y no es simplemente el estímulo de la indulgencia sensual, sino el de todo deseo, que el razonamiento es capaz de dominar.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por ejemplo, la ley dice: No codiciarás la mujer de tu recompensa, ni nada que pertenezca a tu empeño.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Ahora, pues, como es la ley que nos ha prohibido desear, os persuadiré mucho más fácilmente, que el razonamiento es capaz de gobernar nuestros deseos, así como hace los afectos que son impedimentos a la justicia.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¿Desde qué manera es un restaurante solitario, y un glotón, y un borracho regenerado, a menos que sea claro que el razonamiento es el señor de las pasiones?

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Un, por lo tanto, que regula su curso por la ley, incluso si él es amante del dinero, directamente pone la fuerza sobre su propia disposición; prestar a los necesitados sin interés, y cancelar la deuda del sábado entrante.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y si un hombre es parsimonioso, él es gobernado por la ley actuando a través del razonamiento; de modo que él no recoge sus cosechas, ni cosecha; y en referencia a otros puntos podemos percibir que es el razonamiento que conquista sus pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque la ley conquista incluso afecto hacia los padres, no entregando virtud por su cuenta.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y prevalece sobre el amor matrimonial, condenandolo cuando transgrede la ley.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y se enseñorea del amor de los padres hacia sus hijos, porque ellos los castigan por vicio; y los hace por la intimidad de los amigos, reprenderlos cuando son malos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y pensar que no es una afirmación extraña que el razonamiento puede en nombre de la ley conquistar incluso la enemistad.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: No permite derribar el herbaje cultivado de un enemigo, sino preservarlo de los destructores, y recoger sus ruinas caídas.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y el razonamiento parece ser el maestro de las pasiones más violentas, como el amor del imperio y el jactarse vacío, y la arrogancia, y el jactarse fuerte, y calumniar.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque el entendimiento templado repele todas estas pasiones malignas, como hace la ira: porque domina incluso esto.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Así Moisés, cuando enojó contra Datán y Abiram, no les hizo nada en ira, sino que regulaba su ira por la razón.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque la mente templada es capaz, como dije, de ser superior a las pasiones, y de transferir algunas, y destruir otras.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por qué, si no, nuestro padre más sabio Jacob culpa a Simeón y a Leví por haber matado irracionalmente toda la raza de los Siquemitas, diciendo: Maldito sea su ira.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque si el razonamiento no poseía el poder de someter los afectos perdonas, no habría hablado así.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque cuando Dios creó al hombre, implantó dentro de él sus pasiones y su naturaleza moral.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y en ese momento Él entrometió sobre toda la mente del santo líder, a través del medio de los sentidos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y Él dio una ley a esta mente, viviendo según la cual mantiene un reinado templado, y justo, y bueno, y masculino.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¿Cómo, entonces, puede decir un hombre, si razonar ser maestro de las pasiones, no tiene control sobre el olvido y la ignorancia?

title: 4 Macabeos
text: El argumento es extremadamente ridícula: porque el razonamiento no parece llevarse sobre sus propios afectos, sino sobre los del cuerpo,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: de tal manera que cualquiera de ustedes no pueda arraigar el deseo, pero el razonamiento le permitirá evitar ser esclavizado a él.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Uno no puede ser capaz de erradicar la ira del alma, pero es posible soportar la ira.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Cualquiera de ustedes no puede ser capaz de erradicar la malicia, pero el razonamiento tiene fuerza para trabajar con usted para prevenir su rendimiento a la malicia.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: El razonamiento no es un erradicador, sino un antagonista de las pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y esto puede ser más claramente comprendido de la sed del rey David.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque después que David había estado atacando a los filisteos todo el día, él con los soldados de su nación mató a muchos de ellos;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Entonces cuando llegó la noche, sudando y muy cansado, vino a la carpa real, sobre la cual se acampó todo el ejército de nuestros enemigos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Todos los demás estaban a cenar;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: pero el rey, siendo muy atraco, aunque tenía numerosos manantiales, no podía por sus medios apagar su sed;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: pero un cierto anhelo irracional por el agua en el campamento del enemigo consigue más fuerte y más feroz sobre él, y lo consumió con angustia.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por lo tanto, sus guardaespaldas se preocupan por este anhelo del rey, dos valientes soldados jóvenes, reverenciando el deseo del rey, poniendo sus panoplies, y tomando una jarra, se apoderaron de las murallas de los enemigos:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y no percibidos por los guardianes de la puerta, fueron por todo el campamento del enemigo en la búsqueda.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y habiendo descubierto audazmente la fuente, ellos llenoron de ella el draught para el rey.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero él, aunque empapado con sed, razonó que un draught reputado de igual valor a la sangre, sería terriblemente peligroso para su alma.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por lo tanto, estableciendo el razonamiento en oposición a su deseo, derramó el draught a Dios.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque la mente templada tiene poder para conquistar la presión de las pasiones, y para apagar los fuegos de la emoción,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y para luchar contra los dolores del cuerpo, sin embargo excesivo; y, a través de la excelencia del razonamiento, para abominar todos los ataques de las pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero la ocasión ahora nos invita a dar una ilustración del razonamiento templado de la historia.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque en un momento en que nuestros padres estaban en posesión de paz sin perturbar por la obediencia a la ley, y eran prósperos, de modo que Seleucus Nicanor, el rey de Asia, ambos les asignaron dinero para el servicio divino, y aceptaron su forma de gobierno,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: entonces ciertas personas, trayendo cosas nuevas contrarias a la unanimidad general, de diversas maneras caer en calamidades.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Para un hombre llamado Simón, que estaba en oposición a Onias, que una vez retuvo el sumo sacerdocio por la vida, y era un hombre honorable y bueno, después de eso al calumniarlo en todos los sentidos, no podía herirlo con el pueblo, se fue como un exilio, con la intención de vender a su país.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Cuando llegó a Apolonio, el gobernador militar de Siria, y Phœnicia, y Cilicia, dijo:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Tener buena voluntad para los asuntos del rey, él vino para informarte que la riqueza privada infinita está establecida en los tesoros de Jerusalén que no pertenecen al templo, sino que pertenecen al rey Seleucus.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Apolonio, conociendo los detalles de esto, elogió a Simón por su cuidado de los intereses del rey, y subiendo a Seleucus le informó del tesoro;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y conseguir autoridad sobre ello, y avanzar rápidamente en nuestro país con el acatado Simon y una fuerza muy pesada,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Dijo que vino con los mandamientos del rey para tomar que el dinero privado del tesoro.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y la nación, indignada por esta proclamación, y rigurosa al efecto de que era extrema injusta que aquellos que habían cometido depósitos al tesoro sagrado fueran privados de ellos, resistidos así como podían.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero Apolonio se fue con amenazas en el templo.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y los principios, con las mujeres y los hijos, habiendo súplicado a Dios para arrojar su escudo sobre el lugar santo, despreciado,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y Apolonio subiendo con su fuerza armada a la convulsión del cielo, apareció de los ángeles del montando a caballo, todos radiantes en armadura, llenándolos con mucho miedo y temblor.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y Apolonio cayó medio muerto sobre el atrio que está abierto a todas las naciones, y extendió sus manos al cielo, e imploró a los deseos, con lágrimas, para orar por él, y propiciar al ejército celestial.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque él dijo que había pecado, para ser en consecuencia muerte; y que si fuera salvo, celebraría a todos los hombres la bendición del lugar santo.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Onias el sumo sacerdote, inducido por estas palabras, aunque por otras razones ansioso por que el rey Seleucus no debería suponer que Apolonio fue asesinado por el dispositivo humano y no por el castigo divino, oró por él;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y siendo así inesperadamente salva, se fue a manifestar al rey lo que le había sucedido.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero en la muerte de Seleucus el rey, su hijo Antioquía Epifanes tiene éxito al reino: un hombre de soberbia y terrible.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Que habiendo depuesto a Onias del sumo sacerdocio, designó a su hermano Jason para ser sumo sacerdote:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: que había hecho un pacto, si él le daría esta autoridad, para pagar anual tres mil seiscientos sesenta talentos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y se comprometió con él el sumo sacerdocio y el dominio sobre la nación.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y ambos cambiaron la forma de vivir del pueblo, y pervertieron sus costumbres civiles en toda ilegalidad.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Así que no sólo erigió un gimnasio en la misma ciudadela de nuestro país, [pero segurodo] la tutela del templo.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: En el cual la venganza Divina se entristeció, instigó al propio Antioquío contra ellos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por estar en guerra con Ptolomeo en Egipto, entendido que en un informe de su muerte se extendía al extranjero, los habitantes de Jerusalén se habían alegrado mucho, y rápidamente marchaba contra ellos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y después de someterlos, estableció un decreto que si alguno de ellos estuviese conforme a las leyes de su país, debía morir.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y cuando no pudo destruir por sus decretos la obediencia a la ley de la nación, pero vio todas sus amenazas y castigos sin efecto,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: para incluso las mujeres, porque seguíancida circunndo a sus hijos, estaban derribando un precipicio junto con ellos, sabiendo de antemano del castigo.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Cuando, por lo tanto, sus decretos fueron desatendidos por el pueblo, él mismo se vio obligado por medio de torturas a cada una de estas razas, probando carnes prohibiciones, para aborrecer la religión judía.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: El tirano Antioquía, por lo tanto, sentado en estado público con sus asesores en un lugar elevado, con sus tropas armadas de pie en un círculo alrededor de él,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ordenó a sus lanzadores que se apoderaran de cada uno de los secretos, y que los obligaran a probar la carne de cerdo, y las cosas ofrecidas a los ídolos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y si alguno de ellos no estaba dispuesto a comer la comida aterrada, iban a ser torturados en el volante, y así lo recuerdos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y cuando muchos habían sido incautados, un hombre mayor de la asamblea, un entendido, por nombre Eleazar, un sacerdote por familia, por profesión un abogado, y avanzado en años, y por esta razón conocida por muchos de los seguidores del rey, fue llevado cerca de él.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y Antioquía viéndole, dijo:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Yo te aconsejaría, viejo, antes de que dijeran tus torturas, probar la carne de los cerdos, y salvar tu vida; porque siento respeto por tu edad y la cabeza pesada, que desde que ha tenido tanto tiempo, me parece no ser filósofo en retener la superstición de los judíos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por lo tanto, ya que la naturaleza os ha conferido la carne más excelente de este animal, ¿lo saqueáisáis?

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Parece sin sentido no disfrutar de lo que es agradable, pero no deshonroso; y de nociones de pecaminosidad, rechazar los capullos de la naturaleza.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y estás actuando, creo, aún más sin sentido, si sigues vanos concesiones sobre la verdad.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y tú, además, yo despojarás de tu propio castigo.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¿No te despertarás de tu filosofía de trifling? y renunciar a la insensatez de sus nociones; y, recuperando la comprensión digna de su edad, buscar en la verdad de un curso conveniente?

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y, reverenciando mi amabilidad admonición, tienen piedad en sus propios años?

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque, tened en cuenta, que si hay algún poder que vela por esta religión, tuya os perdonará por todas las transgresiones de la ley que cometéis a través de la compulsión.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Mientras el tirano le incitaba de esta manera a comer ilegalmente carne, Eleazar rogó permiso para hablar.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y recibido poder para hablar, comenzó así a entregarse:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Nosotros, O Antioquía, que estamos persuadidos de que vivimos bajo una ley divina, no existe que la compulsión sea tan forzada como la obediencia a esa ley;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por lo tanto, existe que no debemos transgredir la ley en ningún momento.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y de hecho, si nuestra ley (como ustedes suponen) no es divina, y si erróneamente piensa que es divina, no debemos tener ningún derecho incluso en ese caso para destruir nuestro sentido de religión.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Piensa no comer al inmundo, entonces, un delito de trifling.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Para la transgresión de la ley, ya sea en asuntos pequeños o grandes, es de momento igual;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: en cualquier caso la ley es igualmente leve.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero aborreces nuestra filosofía, como si viviésemos irracionalmente en ella.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Sin embargo, nos instruye en la templanza, de modo que somos superiores a todos los placeres y lujurias; y nos ejercen en la obediencia, de modo que nos sometemos alegremente a toda queja.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y nos instruye en la justicia, para que en todos nuestros tratos hagan lo que es debido; y nos enseñamos piedad, para que adoramos al único Dios cada vez más.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por lo tanto, no comemos a los inmundos; por creer que la ley fue establecida por Dios, estamos convencidos de que el Creador del mundo, al dar sus leyes, simpatiza con nuestra naturaleza.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Las cosas que son convenientes para nuestras almas, nos ha dirigido a un comer; pero las que son repugnantes para ellos, él ha interdicido.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero, como tirano, no sólo nos obliga a quebrantar la ley, sino también a comer, para que nos ridiculices como comemos profanamente:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: pero no tienen esta causa de risa contra mí;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ni voy a transgredir los sagrados juramentos de mis intenciones para mantener la ley.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: No, no si me sacas los ojos, y consume mal entrañas.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: No soy tan viejo, y sin piedad, pero que mis poderes racionales son jóvenes en defensa de mi religión.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Ahora bien, prepara tus ruedas y enciende una llama más feroz.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: No me compadeceré tanto de mi vejez, como de mi parte mono la ley de mi país.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¡No te interpreté, oh ley, mi instructor! o te desamparaste, oh venera autocontrol.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: No te avergonzaré, oh filósofo Razón; o te negaré, oh sacerdocio honrado, y ciencia de la ley.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¡Música! No contaminarás mi vejez, ni la estatura completa de una vida perfecta.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Mis padres me recibirán puros, sin haber acuñado antes de vuestra compulsión, aunque hasta la muerte.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque sobre los impíos acariciarás; mas no lo enseñorearás sobre mis pensamientos acerca de la religión, ni por tus argumentos, ni por hechos.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Cuando Eleazar respondió así a las exhortaciones del tirano, su rotación los lanzadores, y despidieron a Eleazar a los instrumentos de la tortura.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y primero, despojaron al anciano, adornado como estaba con la comeza de la piedad.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: entonces atando sus brazos y manos, lo usaron desdénmente con rayas;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: un heraldo opuesto al llanto, Obedezca los mandamientos del rey.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero Eleazar, de mente alta y consciente noble, como uno torturado en un sueño, no lo consideraba en absoluto.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero alzando sus ojos en lo alto del cielo, la carne del anciano fue despojada por los flagelos, y su sangre se arrojó, y sus lados fueron atravesados.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y cayendo sobre el suelo, de su cuerpo sin poder para soportar los dolores, él mantuvo su razonamiento recto e inflexible.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: entonces uno de los duros lanzadores saltó sobre su vientre mientras caía, para forzarlo recto.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero él sufrió los dolores, y menospreció la crueldad, y perseveró a través de las indignidades;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y como un noble atleta, el viejo, cuando golpeó, venció a sus torturadores.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Su rostro sudando, y respirando, fue admirado por los mismos torturadores por su recompensa.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por lo tanto, en parte en penitencia por su vejez,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: parte de la simpatía del conocido, y en parte en admiración de su resistencia, algunos de los asistentes del rey dijeron:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¿Por qué te destruyes irrazonablemente, O Eleazar, con estas miserias?

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Te traeremos algo de carne cocinada por ti mismo, y te salvas fingiendo que tiene comer carne de cerdo.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y Eleazar, como si el consejo le torturase más dolorosamente, clamó:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: No seamos nosotros los hijos de Abraham tan mal aconsejados como dar camino para hacer uso de una pretensión incesante;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: porque era irracional, si habiendo vivido hasta la vejez en toda verdad, y habiendo guardado escrupulosamente nuestro carácter por ello, ahora inevitable regresar,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y nosotros debemos convertirnos en un patrón de impiedad para los jóvenes, como un ejemplo de comer contaminación.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: sería deshonroso si pudiéramos vivir en poco tiempo, y que todos los hombres deshonraran por cobardía,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y ser condenado por el tirano por la inmanisa, por no contender a la muerte por nuestra ley divina.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por lo cual vosotros, hijos de Abraham, muráis sin piedad por vuestra religión.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Vosotros, lanzadores del tirano, ¿por qué lleváisáisáis?

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Al verlo tan alto contra la miseria, y sin cambiar a su piedad, le llevaron al fuego;

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Entonces con sus instrumentos malignos lo quemaron en el fuego, y derramaron líquidos apestosos en sus fosas nasales.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y siendo él alargado hasta los huesos, y a punto de expirar, levantó sus ojos hacia Dios, y dijo:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Tú sabes, oh Dios, que cuando yo pudiera haber sido llevada, soja matado por causa de la ley por torturas de fuego.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Sea misericordioso con tu pueblo, y esté satisfecho con el castigo de mí por su cuenta.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Que mi sangre sea una purificación para ellos, y tome mi vida en recompensa por la suya.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Así, el hombre santo se fue, noble en sus tormentos, e incluso a las agonías de la muerte resistió en su razonamiento por el bien de la ley.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Con confianza, por lo tanto, el razonamiento religioso es maestro de las pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque si las pasiones fueran superiores al razonamiento, les habría dado el testimonio de este dominio.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero ahora, desde que el razonamiento conquistó las pasiones, le otorgamos la autoridad de primer lugar.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y es justo lo que debemos permitir, que el poder pertenece al razonamiento, ya que domina las miserias externas.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Ridículo sería que no fuera así; y comprobé que el razonamiento no sólo ha dominado los dolores, sino que también es superior a los placeres, y los resiste.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: El razonamiento de nuestro padre Eleazar, como un piloto de primera categoría, dirigiendo el código de la piedad en el mar de las pasiones,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y desatado por las amenazas del tirano, y abrumado con los rompedores de la tortura,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: de ninguna manera cambió el timón de la piedad hasta que navegó al puerto de la victoria sobre la muerte.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: No es así que alguna vez una ciudad, sitiada, retenida contra muchas y varias máquinas, como lo hizo ese hombre santo, cuando su alma piadosa fue juzgada con la prueba preliminar de torturas y perplejos, mueve sus sitijos a través del razonamiento religioso que lo protegió.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Para el padre Eleazar, proyectando su disposición, rompió las ondas de rabia de las pasiones como con un promontorio de juicio.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¡Oh sacerdote, soy del sacerdocio! No contaminaste tus dientes sagrados, ni pequeñas tu apetito, que siempre había abrazado a los limpios y lícitos, un partaker de profanidad.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¡Oh armonizador con la ley, y sabio dedicado a una vida divina!

title: 4 Macabeos
text: De tal carácter, los que cumplen los deberes de la ley a riesgo de su propia sangre, y la defienden con sudor moral por sufrimientos hasta la muerte.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Tú, padre, ha establecido gloriosamente nuestro buen gobierno por tu resistencia; y haciendo de mucho cuenta nuestro servicio pasado, impidió su destrucción, y, por tus obras, ha hecho creíble las palabras de la filosofía.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¡Oh hombre viejo de más poder que torturas, mayor vigor que fuego, alcalde rey sobre las pasiones, Eleazar!

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque como el padre Aarón, armado con un incensario, apresurándose por el fuego consumidor, derrocó al ángel portador de la llama,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Así que Eleazar, el descendiente de Aarón, desperdiciado por el fuego, no abandonó su razonamiento.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Y, lo que es más maravilloso, aunque un anciano, aunque los trabajos de su cuerpo ahora se gastaon, y sus fibras fueron relajadas, y sus sinovas desgastadas, él recuperó la juventud.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Por el espíritu de razonamiento, y el razonamiento de Isaac, él hizo impotente el instrumento de muchos cabezas.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: ¡Oh edad dobleita, y reverendo cabeza de manguera, y vida obediente a la ley, que el fiel sello de la muerte perfeccionó!

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Si, entonces, un anciano, a través de la religión, despreciaba las torturas hasta la muerte, el razonamiento confeso religioso es el gobernante de las pasiones.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero tal vez algunos podrían decir, No todos los que conquistan las pasiones, como todos no poseen un sabio sabio.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Pero los que han meditado sobre la religión con todo su corazón, estos solos pueden dominar las pasiones de la carne:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: los que creen que a Dios no mueren; porque, como nuestros enemigos, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, viven a Dios.

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Esta circunstancia, entonces, no es en modo alguno una objeción, que algunos que tienen un razonamiento débil, se rigen por sus pasiones:

title: 4 Macabeos
text: desde qué persona, caminando religiosamente por toda la regla de la filosofía, y creyendo en Dios,

title: 4 Macabeos
text: y sabiendo que es algo bendecido soportar todo tipo de dificultades por virtud, ¿no sería, por el bien de la religión, dominar su pasión?

title: 4 Macabeos
text: Porque el hombre sabio y valiente sólo es señor sobre sus pasiones.
