text: To announce to those who have songs of the coming of the Lord, that they may go forth to meet Him and may sing to Him, with joy and with the harp of many tones.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The Seers shall go before Him, and they shall be seen before Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And they shall praise the Lord in His love, because He is near and does see.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And hatred shall be removed from the earth, and with jealousy it shall be drowned.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For ignorance was destroyed upon it, because the knowledge of the Lord arrived upon it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Let the singers sing the grace of the Lord Most High, and let them bring their songs.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And let their heart be like the day, and their gentle voices like the majestic beauty of the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And let there not be anyone who breathes that is without knowledge or voice.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For He gave a mouth to His creation: to open the voice of the mouth towards Him, and to praise Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Confess His power and declare His grace. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Open, open your hearts to the exultation of the Lord, and let your love abound from the heart to the lips.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: In order to bring forth fruits to the Lord, a holy life; and to talk with watchfulness in His light.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Rise up and stand erect, you who sometimes were brought low.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: You who were in silence, speak, for your mouth has been opened.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: You who were despised, from henceforth be lifted up, for your Righteousness has been lifted up;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the right hand of the Lord is with you, and He will be your Helper.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And peace was prepared for you, before what may be your war.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Hear the word of truth, and receive the knowledge of the Most High.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Your flesh may not understand that which I am about to say to you; nor your garment that which I am about to show you.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Keep my mystery, you who are kept by it; keep my faith, you who are kept by it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And understand my knowledge, you who know me in truth; love me with affection, you who love;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For I turn not my face from my own, because I know them.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And before they had existed, I recognized them; and imprinted a seal on their faces.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I fashioned their members, and my own breasts I prepared for them, that they might drink my holy milk and live by it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I am pleased by them, and am not ashamed by them.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For my workmanship are they, and the strength of my thoughts.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Therefore who can stand against my work? Or who is not subject to them?

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I willed and fashioned mind and heart, and they are my own. And upon my right hand I have set my elect ones.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And my righteousness goes before them, and they shall not be deprived of my name; for it is with them.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Pray and increase, and abide in the love of the Lord;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And you who were loved in the Beloved, and you who are kept in Him who lives, and you who are saved in Him who was saved.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And you shall be found incorrupt in all ages, on account of the name of your Father. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Open your ears, and I shall speak to you.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Give me yourself, so that I may also give you myself.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The word of the Lord and His desires, the holy thought which He has thought concerning His Messiah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For in the will of the Lord is your life, and His purpose is eternal life, and your perfection is incorruptible.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Be enriched in God the Father; and receive the purpose of the Most High. Be strong and redeemed by His grace.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For I announce peace to you, His holy ones, so that none of those who hear shall fall in the war.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And also that those who have known Him may not perish, and so that those who received Him may not be ashamed.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: An everlasting crown is Truth; blessed are they who set it on their head.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: It is a precious stone, for the wars were on account of the crown.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But Righteousness has taken it, and has given it to you.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Put on the crown in the true covenant of the Lord, and all those who have conquered will be inscribed in His book.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For their book is the reward of victory which is for you, and she sees you before her and wills that you shall be saved. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The Lord has directed my mouth by His Word, and has opened my heart by His Light.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He has caused to dwell in me His immortal life, and permitted me to proclaim the fruit of His peace.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: To convert the lives of those who desire to come to Him, and to lead those who are captive into freedom.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I took courage and became strong and captured the world, and the captivity became mine for the glory of the Most High, and of God my Father.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the Gentiles who had been dispersed were gathered together, but I was not defiled by my love for them, because they had praised me in high places.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the traces of light were set upon their heart, and they walked according to my life and were saved, and they became my people for ever and ever. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: My heart was pruned and its flower appeared, then grace sprang up in it, and my heart produced fruits for the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the Most High circumcised me by His Holy Spirit, then He uncovered my inward being towards Him, and filled me with His love.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And His circumcising became my salvation, and I ran in the Way, in His peace, in the way of truth.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: From the beginning until the end I received His knowledge.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I was established upon the rock of truth, where He had set me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And speaking waters touched my lips from the fountain of the Lord generously.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And so I drank and became intoxicated, from the living water that does not die.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And my intoxication did not cause ignorance, but I abandoned vanity,

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And turned toward the Most High, my God, and was enriched by His favors.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I rejected the folly cast upon the earth, and stripped it off and cast it from me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the Lord renewed me with His garment, and possessed me by His light.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And from above He gave me immortal rest, and I became like the land that blossoms and rejoices in its fruits.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the Lord is like the sun upon the face of the land.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: My eyes were enlightened, and my face received the dew;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And my breath was refreshed by the pleasant fragrance of the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He took me to His Paradise, wherein is the wealth of the Lord's pleasure. I beheld blooming and fruit-bearing trees, And self-grown was their crown. Their branches were sprouting and their fruits were shining. From an immortal land were their roots. And a river of gladness was irrigating them, And round about them in the land of eternal life.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then I worshipped the Lord because of His magnificence.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I said, Blessed, O Lord, are they who are planted in Your land, and who have a place in Your Paradise;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And who grow in the growth of Your trees, and have passed from darkness into light.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Behold, all Your laborers are fair, they who work good works, and turn from wickedness to your pleasantness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the pungent odor of the trees is changed in Your land,

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And everything becomes a remnant of Yourself. Blessed are the workers of Your waters, and eternal memorials of Your faithful servants.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Indeed, there is much room in Your Paradise. And there is nothing in it which is barren, but everything is filled with fruit.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Glory be to You, O God, the delight of Paradise for ever. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: He has filled me with words of truth, that I may proclaim Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And like the flowing of waters, truth flows from my mouth, and my lips declare His fruits.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He has caused His knowledge to abound in me, because the mouth of the Lord is the true Word, and the entrance of His light.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the Most High has given Him to His generations, which are the interpreters of His beauty, And the narrators of His glory, And the confessors of His purpose, And the preachers of His mind, And the teachers of His works.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the subtlety of the Word is inexpressible, and like His utterance so also is His swiftness and His acuteness, for limitless is His progression.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: He never falls but remains standing, and one cannot comprehend His descent or His way.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For as His work is, so is His expectation, for He is the light and dawning of thought.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And by Him the generations spoke to one another, and those that were silent acquired speech.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And from Him came love and equality, and they spoke one to another that which was theirs.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And they were stimulated by the Word, and knew Him who made them, because they were in harmony.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the mouth of the Most High spoke to them, and His exposition prospered through Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the dwelling place of the Word is man, and His truth is love.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Blessed are they who by means of Him have perceived everything, and have known the Lord in His truth. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Behold, the Lord is our mirror. Open your eyes and see them in Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And learn the manner of your face, then declare praises to His Spirit.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And wipe the paint from your face, and love His holiness and put it on.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then you will be unblemished at all times with Him. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: As the eyes of a son upon his father, so are my eyes, O Lord, at all times towards You.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because my breasts and my pleasure are with You.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Turn not aside Your mercies from me, O Lord; and take not Your kindness from me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Stretch out to me, my Lord, at all times, Your right hand, and be to me a guide till the end according to Your will.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Let me be pleasing before You, because of Your glory, and because of Your name let me be saved from the Evil One.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And let Your gentleness, O Lord, abide with me, and the fruits of Your love.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Teach me the odes of Your truth, that I may produce fruits in You.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And open to me the harp of Your Holy Spirit, so that with every note I may praise You, O Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And according to the multitude of Your mercies, so grant unto me, and hasten to grant our petitions.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For You are sufficient for all our needs. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: As the sun is the joy of them who seek its daybreak, so is my joy the Lord;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because He is my Sun, and His rays have lifted me up; and His light has dismissed all darkness from my face.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Eyes I have obtained in Him, and have seen His holy day.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Ears I have acquired, and have heard His truth.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The thought of knowledge I have acquired, and have enjoyed delight fully through Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I repudiated the way of error, and went towards Him and received salvation from Him abundantly.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And according to His generosity He gave to me, and according to His excellent beauty He made me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I put on immortality through His name, and took off corruption by His grace.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Death has been destroyed before my face, and Sheol has been vanquished by my word.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And eternal life has arisen in the Lord's land, and it has been declared to His faithful ones, and has been given without limit to all that trust in Him. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: As the occupation of the ploughman is the ploughshare, and the occupation of the helmsman is the steering of the ship, so also my occupation is the psalm of the Lord by His hymns.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: My art and my service are in His hymns, because His love has nourished my heart, and His fruits He poured unto my lips.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For my love is the Lord; hence I will sing unto Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For I am strengthened by His praises, and I have faith in Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I will open my mouth, and His Spirit will speak through me the glory of the Lord and His beauty,

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The work of His hands, and the labor of His fingers;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the multitude of His mercies, and the strength of His Word.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the Word of the Lord investigates that which is invisible, and reveals His thought.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the eye sees His works, and the ear hears His thought.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: It is He who made the earth broad, and placed the waters in the sea.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: He expanded the heaven, and fixed the stars.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He fixed the creation and set it up, then He rested from His works.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And created things run according to their courses, and work their works, for they can never cease nor fail.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the hosts are subject to His Word.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The reservoir of light is the sun, and the reservoir of darkness is the night.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For He made the sun for the day so that it will be light; but night brings darkness over the face of the earth.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And by their portion one from another they complete the beauty of God.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And there is nothing outside of the Lord, because He was before anything came to be.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the worlds are by His Word, and by the thought of His heart.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Praise and honor to His name. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then I was crowned by my God, and my crown was living.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I was justified by my Lord, for my salvation is incorruptible.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I have been freed from vanities, and am not condemned.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: My chains were cut off by His hands, I received the face and likeness of a new person, and I walked in Him and was saved.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the thought of truth led me, and I went after it and wandered not.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And all who saw me were amazed, and I seemed to them like a stranger.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He who knew and exalted me, is the Most High in all His perfection.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He glorified me by His kindness, and raised my understanding to the height of truth.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And from there He gave me the way of His steps, and I opened the doors which were closed.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I shattered the bars of iron, for my own shackles had grown hot and melted before me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And nothing appeared closed to me, because I was the opening of everything.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I went towards all my bound ones in order to loose them; that I might not leave anyone bound or binding.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I gave my knowledge generously, and my resurrection through my love.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I sowed my fruits in hearts, and transformed them through myself.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then they received my blessing and lived, and they were gathered to me and were saved;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because they became my members, and I was their Head.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Glory to You, our Head, O Lord Messiah. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: My heart was lifted up and enriched in the love of the Most High, so that I might praise Him with my name.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: My members were strengthened, that they may not fall from His power.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Infirmities fled from my body, and it stood firm for the Lord by His will; because His kingdom is firm.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: O Lord, for the sake of those who are in need, do not dismiss Your Word from me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Nor, for the sake of their works, withhold Your perfection from me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Let not light be conquered by darkness, nor let truth flee from falsehood.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Let Your right hand set our salvation to victory, and let it receive from every region, and preserve it on the side of everyone who is besieged by misfortunes.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: You are my God, falsehood and death are not in Your mouth; only perfection is Your will.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And vanity You know not, because neither does it know You.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And You know not error; because neither does it know You.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And ignorance appeared like dust, and like the foam of the sea.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And vain people thought that it was great, and they became like its type and were impoverished.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But those who knew understood and contemplated, and were not polluted by their thoughts;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because they were in the mind of the Most High, and mocked those who were walking in error.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then they spoke the truth, from the breath which the Most High breathed into them.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Praise and great honor to His name. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: A cup of milk was offered to me, and I drank it in the sweetness of the Lord's kindness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The Son is the cup, and the Father is He who was milked; and the Holy Spirit is She who milked Him;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because His breasts were full, and it was undesirable that His milk should be ineffectually released.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The Holy Spirit opened Her bosom, and mixed the milk of the two breasts of the Father.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then She gave the mixture to the generation without their knowing, and those who have received it are in the perfection of the right hand.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The womb of the Virgin took it, and she received conception and gave birth.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: So the Virgin became a mother with great mercies.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And she labored and bore the Son but without pain, because it did not occur without purpose.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And she did not require a midwife, because He caused her to give life.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: She brought forth like a strong man with desire, and she bore according to the manifestation, and she acquired according to the Great Power.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And she loved with redemption, and guarded with kindness, and declared with grandeur. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I am a priest of the Lord, and Him I serve as a priest;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And to Him I offer the offering of His thought.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For His thought is not like the world, nor like the flesh, nor like them who worship according to the flesh.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The offering of the Lord is righteousness, and purity of heart and lips.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Offer your inward being faultlessly; and let not your compassion oppress compassion; and let not yourself oppress a self.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: You should not purchase a stranger because he is like yourself, nor seek to deceive your neighbor, nor deprive him of the covering for his nakedness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But put on the grace of the Lord generously, and come to His Paradise, and make for yourself a garland from His tree.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then put it on your head and be joyful, and recline upon His rest.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For His glory will go before you; and you shall receive of His kindness and of His grace; and you shall be anointed in truth with the praise of His holiness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Praise and honor to His name. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I lifted up my arms on high on account of the compassion of the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because He cast off my bonds from me, and my Helper lifted me up according to His compassion and His salvation.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I put off darkness, and put on light.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And even I myself acquired members. In them there was no sickness or affliction or suffering.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And abundantly helpful to me was the thought of the Lord, and His everlasting fellowship.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I was lifted up in the light, and I passed before Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I was constantly near Him, while praising and confessing Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: He caused my heart to overflow, and it was found in my mouth; and it sprang forth unto my lips.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then upon my face increased the exultation of the Lord and His praise. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: He who caused me to descend from on high, and to ascend from the regions below;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He who gathers what is in the Middle, and throws them to me;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: He who scattered my enemies, and my adversaries;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: He who gave me authority over bonds, so that I might unbind them;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: He who overthrew by my hands the dragon with seven heads, and set me at his roots that I might destroy his seed;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: You were there and helped me, and in every place Your name surrounded me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Your right hand destroyed his evil venom, and Your hand leveled the Way for those who believe in You.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And It chose them from the graves, and separated them from the dead ones.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: It took dead bones and covered them with flesh.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But they were motionless, so It gave them energy for life.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Incorruptible was Your way and Your face; You have brought Your world to corruption, that everything might be resolved and renewed.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the foundation of everything is Your rock. And upon it You have built Your kingdom, and it became the dwelling-place of the holy ones. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Joy is for the holy ones. And who shall put it on but they alone?

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Grace is for the elect ones. And who shall receive it but they who trusted in it from the beginning?

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Love is for the elect ones. And who shall put it on but they who possessed it from the beginning?

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Walk in the knowledge of the Lord, and you will know the grace of the Lord generously; both for His exultation and for the perfection of His knowledge.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And His thought was like a letter, and His will descended from on high.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And it was sent like an arrow which from a bow has been forcibly shot.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And many hands rushed to the letter, in order to catch it, then take and read it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But it escaped from their fingers; and they were afraid of it and of the seal which was upon it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because they were not allowed to loosen its seal; for the power which was over the seal was greater than they.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But those who saw the letter went after it; that they might learn where it would land, and who should read it, and who should hear it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But a wheel received it, and it came over it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And a sign was with it, of the kingdom and of providence.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And everything which was disturbing the wheel, it mowed and cut down.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And it restrained a multitude of adversaries; and bridged rivers.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And it crossed over and uprooted many forests, and made an open way.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The head went down to the feet, because unto the feet ran the wheel, and whatever had come upon it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The letter was one of command, and hence all regions were gathered together.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And there was seen at its head, the head which was revealed, even the Son of Truth from the Most High Father.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He inherited and possessed everything, and then the scheming of the many ceased.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then all the seducers became headstrong and fled, and the persecutors became extinct and were blotted out.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the letter became a large volume, which was entirely written by the finger of God.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the name of the Father was upon it; and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, to rule for ever and ever. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The dove fluttered over the head of our Lord Messiah, because He was her head.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And she sang over Him, and her voice was heard.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then the inhabitants were afraid, and the foreigners were disturbed.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The bird began to fly, and every creeping thing died in its hole.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the chasms were opened and closed; and they were seeking the Lord as those who are about to give birth.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But He was not given to them for nourishment, because He did not belong to them.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But the chasms were submerged in the seal of the Lord, and they perished in the thought with which they had remained from the beginning.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For they were in labor from the beginning, and the end of their travail was life.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And all of them who were lacking perished, because they were not able to express the word so that they might remain.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the Lord destroyed the devices, of all those who had not the truth with them.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For they were lacking in wisdom, they who exalted themselves in their mind.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: So they were rejected, because the truth was not with them.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the Lord revealed His way, and spread widely His grace.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And those who understood it knew His holiness. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I was rescued from my chains, and I fled unto You, O my God.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because You are the right hand of salvation, and my Helper.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: You have restrained those who rise up against me, and no more were they seen.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because Your face was with me, which saved me by Your grace.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But I was despised and rejected in the eyes of many, and I was in their eyes like lead.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I acquired strength from You, and help.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: A lamp You set for me both on my right and on my left, so that there might not be in me anything that is not light.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I was covered with the covering of Your Spirit, and I removed from me my garments of skin.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because Your right hand exalted me, and caused sickness to pass from me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I became mighty in Your truth, and holy in Your righteousness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And all my adversaries were afraid of me, and I became the Lord's by the name of the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I was justified by His kindness, and His rest is for ever and ever. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I poured out praise to the Lord, because I am His own.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I will recite His holy ode, because my heart is with Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For His harp is in my hand, and the odes of His rest shall not be silent.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I will call unto Him with all my heart, I will praise and exalt Him with all my members.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For from the East and unto the West is His praise;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Also from the South and unto the North is His thanksgiving.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Even from the crest of the summits and unto their extremity is His perfection.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Who can write the odes of the Lord, or who can read them?

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Or who can train himself for life, so that he himself may be saved?

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Or who can press upon the Most High, so that He would recite from His mouth?

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Who can interpret the wonders of the Lord? Though he who interprets will be destroyed, yet that which was interpreted will remain.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For it suffices to perceive and be satisfied, for the odists stand in serenity;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Like a river which has an increasingly gushing spring, and flows to the relief of them that seek it. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I extended my hands and hallowed my Lord,

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the expansion of my hands is His sign.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And my extension is the upright cross. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: As the wings of doves over their nestlings, and the mouths of their nestlings towards their mouths, so also are the wings of the Spirit over my heart.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: My heart continually refreshes itself and leaps for joy, like the babe who leaps for joy in his mother's womb.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I trusted, consequently I was at rest; because trustful is He in whom I trusted.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: He has greatly blessed me, and my head is with Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the dagger shall not divide me from Him, nor the sword;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because I am ready before destruction comes, and have been set on His immortal side.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And immortal life embraced me, and kissed me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And from that life is the Spirit which is within me. And it cannot die because it is life.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Those who saw me were amazed, because I was persecuted.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And they thought that I had been swallowed up, because I seemed to them as one of the lost.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But my injustice became my salvation.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I became their abomination, because there was no jealousy in me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because I continually did good to every man I was hated.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And they surrounded me like mad dogs, those who in stupidity attack their masters.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because their thought is depraved, and their mind is perverted.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But I was carrying water in my right hand, and their bitterness I endured by my sweetness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I did not perish, because I was not their brother, nor was my birth like theirs.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And they sought my death but did not find it possible, because I was older than their memory; and in vain did they cast lots against me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And those who were after me sought in vain to destroy the memorial of Him who was before them.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because the thought of the Most High cannot be prepossessed; and His heart is superior to all wisdom. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The Lord is my hope, I shall not be ashamed of Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For according to His praise He made me, and according to His grace even so He gave to me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And according to His mercies He exalted me, and according to His great honor He lifted me up.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And he caused me to ascend from the depths of Sheol, and from the mouth of death He drew me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I humbled my enemies, and He justified me by His grace.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For I believed in the Lord's Messiah, and considered that He is the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He revealed to me His sign, and He led me by His light.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He gave me the scepter of His power, that I might subdue the devices of the people, and humble the power of the mighty.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: To make war by His Word, and to take victory by His power.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the Lord overthrew my enemy by His Word, and he became like the dust which a breeze carries off.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I gave praise to the Most High, because He has magnified His servant and the son of His maidservant. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Fill for yourselves water from the living fountain of the Lord, because it has been opened for you.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And come all you thirsty and take a drink, and rest beside the fountain of the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because it is pleasing and sparkling, and perpetually refreshes the self.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For much sweeter is its water than honey, and the honeycomb of bees is not to be compared with it;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because it flowed from the lips of the Lord, and it named from the heart of the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And it came boundless and invisible, and until it was set in the middle they knew it not.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Blessed are they who have drunk from it, and have refreshed themselves by it. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Chasms vanished before the Lord, and darkness dissipated before His appearance.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Error erred and perished on account of Him; and contempt received no path, for it was submerged by the truth of the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: He opened His mouth and spoke grace and joy; and recited a new chant to His name.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then He lifted his voice towards the Most High, and offered to Him those that had become sons through Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And His face was justified, because thus His Holy Father had given to Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Come forth, you who have been afflicted, and receive joy.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And possess yourselves through grace, and take unto you immortal life.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And they condemned me when I stood up, me who had not been condemned.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then they divided my spoil, though nothing was owed them.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But I endured and held my peace and was silent, that I might not be disturbed by them.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But I stood undisturbed like a solid rock, which is continuously pounded by columns of waves and endures.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I bore their bitterness because of humility; that I might redeem my nation and instruct it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And that I might not nullify the promises to the patriarchs, to whom I was promised for the salvation of their offspring. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: To the blessed ones the joy is from their heart, and light from Him who dwells in them;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the Word of truth who is self-originate,

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because He has been strengthened by the Holy Power of the Most High; and He is unshaken for ever and ever. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But again Grace was swift and dismissed the Corruptor, and descended upon him to renounce him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And he caused utter destruction before him, and corrupted all his work.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And he stood on the peak of a summit and cried aloud from one end of the earth to the other.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then he drew to him all those who obeyed him, for he did not appear as the Evil One.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: However, the perfect Virgin stood, who was preaching and summoning and saying:

title: Odes of Solomon
text: O you sons of men, return, and you their daughters, come.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And leave the ways of that Corruptor, and approach me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I will enter into you, and bring you forth from destruction, and make you wise in the ways of truth.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Be not corrupted nor perish.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Obey me and be saved, for I am proclaiming unto you the grace of God.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And through me you will be saved and become blessed. I am your judge;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And they who have put me on shall not be falsely accused, but they shall possess incorruption in the new world.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: My elect ones have walked with me, and my ways I will make known to them who seek me; and I will promise them my name. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: There is no hard way where there is a simple heart, nor barrier for upright thoughts,

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Nor whirlwind in the depth of the enlightened thought.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Where one is surrounded on every side by pleasing country, there is nothing divided in him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The likeness of that which is below is that which is above.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For everything is from above, and from below there is nothing, but it is believed to be by those in whom there is no understanding.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Grace has been revealed for your salvation. Believe and live and be saved. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The gentle showers of the Lord overshadowed me with serenity, and they caused a cloud of peace to rise over my head;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: That it might guard me at all times. And it became salvation to me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Everyone was disturbed and afraid, and there came from them smoke and judgment.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But I was tranquil in the Lord's legion; more than shade was He to me, and more than foundation.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I was carried like a child by its mother; and He gave me milk, the dew of the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I was enriched by His favor, and rested in His perfection.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I spread out my hands in the ascent of myself, and I directed myself towards the Most High, and I was redeemed towards Him. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I rested on the Spirit of the Lord, and She lifted me up to heaven;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And caused me to stand on my feet in the Lord's high place, before His perfection and His glory, where I continued glorifying Him by the composition of His Odes.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The Spirit brought me forth before the Lord's face, and because I was the Son of Man, I was named the Light, the Son of God;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because I was the most glorified among the glorious ones, and the greatest among the great ones.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For according to the greatness of the Most High, so She made me; and according to His newness He renewed me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He anointed me with His perfection; and I became one of those who are near Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And my mouth was opened like a cloud of dew, and my heart gushed forth like a gusher of righteousness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And my approach was in peace, and I was established in the Spirit of Providence. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I stretched out my hands towards the Lord, and towards the Most High I raised my voice.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I spoke with the lips of my heart, and He heard me when my voice reached Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: His Word came towards me, in order to give me the fruits of my labors;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And gave me rest by the grace of the Lord. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I went up into the light of Truth as into a chariot, and the Truth led me and caused me to come.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And caused me to pass over chasms and gulfs, and saved me from cliffs and valleys.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And became for me a haven of salvation, and set me on the place of immortal life.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And He went with me and caused me to rest and did not allow me to err; because He was and is the Truth.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And there was no danger for me because I constantly walked with Him; and I did not err in anything because I obeyed Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For Error fled from Him, and never met Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But Truth was proceeding on the upright way, and whatever I did not understand He exhibited to me:

title: Odes of Solomon
text: All the poisons of error, and pains of death which are considered sweetness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the corrupting of the Corruptor, I saw when the bride who was corrupting was adorned, and the bridegroom who corrupts and is corrupted.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I asked the Truth, Who are these? And He said to me: This is the Deceiver and the Error.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And they imitate the Beloved and His Bride, and they cause the world to err and corrupt it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And they invite many to the wedding feast, and allow them to drink the wine of their intoxication;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: So they cause them to vomit up their wisdom and their knowledge, and prepare for them mindlessness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then they abandon them; and so they stumble about like mad and corrupted men.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Since there is no understanding in them, neither do they seek it.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But I have been made wise so as not to fall into the hands of the Deceivers, and I myself rejoiced because the Truth had gone with me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For I was established and lived and was redeemed, and my foundations were laid on account of the Lord's hand; because He has planted me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For He set the root, and watered it and endowed it and blessed it, and its fruits will be forever.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: It penetrated deeply and sprang up and spread out, and it was full and was enlarged.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the Lord alone was glorified, in His planting and in His cultivation;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: In His care and in the blessing of His lips, in the beautiful planting of His right hand;

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And in the attainment of His planting, and in the understanding of His mind. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Raging rivers are the power of the Lord; they send headlong those who despise Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And entangle their paths, and destroy their crossings.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And snatch their bodies, and corrupt their natures.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For they are more swift than lightnings, even more rapid.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: But those who cross them in faith shall not be disturbed.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And those who walk on them faultlessly shall not be shaken.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Because the sign on them is the Lord, and the sign is the Way for those who cross in the name of the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Therefore, put on the name of the Most High and know Him, and you shall cross without danger; because rivers shall be obedient to you.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The Lord has bridged them by His Word, and He walked and crossed them on foot.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And His footsteps stand firm upon the waters, and were not destroyed; but they are like a beam of wood that is constructed on truth.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: On this side and on that the waves were lifted up, but the footsteps of our Lord Messiah stand firm.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And they are neither blotted out, nor destroyed.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And the Way has been appointed for those who cross over after Him, and for those who adhere to the path of His faith; and who adore His name. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: As honey drips from the honeycomb of bees, and milk flows from the woman who loves her children, so also is my hope upon You, O my God.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: As a fountain gushes forth its water, so my heart gushes forth the praise of the Lord, and my lips bring forth praise to Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And my tongue becomes sweet by His anthems, and my members are anointed by His odes.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: My face rejoices in His exultation, and my spirit exults in His love, and my nature shines in Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And he who is afraid shall trust in Him, and redemption shall be assured in Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And His possessions are immortal life, and those who receive it are incorruptible. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Let all the Lord's babes praise Him, and let us receive the truth of His faith.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And His children shall be acknowledged by Him, therefore let us sing by His love.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: We live in the Lord by His grace, and life we receive by His Messiah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For a great day has shined upon us, and wonderful is He who has given to us of His glory.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Let us, therefore, all of us agree in the name of the Lord, and let us honor Him in His goodness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And let our faces shine in His light, and let our hearts meditate in His love, by night and by day.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Let us exult with the exultation of the Lord.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: All those who see me will be amazed, because I am from another race.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For the Father of Truth remembered me; he who possessed me from the beginning.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For His riches begat me, and the thought of His heart.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And His Word is with us in all our way, the Savior who gives life and does not reject ourselves.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The Man who humbled Himself, but was exalted because of His own righteousness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The Son of the Most High appeared in the perfection of His Father.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And light dawned from the Word that was before time in Him.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: The Messiah in truth is one. And He was known before the foundations of the world, that He might give life to persons for ever by the truth of His name.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: A new chant is for the Lord from them that love Him. Hallelujah.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I extended my hands and approached my Lord, for the expansion of my hands is His sign.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And my extension is the upright cross, that was lifted up on the way of the Righteous One.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I became useless to those who knew me not, because I shall hide myself from those who possessed me not.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I will be with those who love me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: All my persecutors have died, and they sought me, they who declared against me, because I am living.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then I arose and am with them, and will speak by their mouths.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: For they have rejected those who persecute them; and I threw over them the yoke of my love.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Like the arm of the bridegroom over the bride, so is my yoke over those who know me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And as the bridal chamber is spread out by the bridal pair's home, so is my love by those who believe in me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I was not rejected although I was considered to be so, and I did not perish although they thought it of me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Sheol saw me and was shattered, and Death ejected me and many with me.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: I have been vinegar and bitterness to it, and I went down with it as far as its depth.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then the feet and the head it released, because it was not able to endure my face.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I made a congregation of living among his dead; and I spoke with them by living lips; in order that my word may not be unprofitable.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And those who had died ran towards me; and they cried out and said, Son of God, have pity on us.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And deal with us according to Your kindness, and bring us out from the bonds of darkness.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And open for us the door by which we may come out to You; for we perceive that our death does not touch You.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: May we also be saved with You, because You are our Savior.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: Then I heard their voice, and placed their faith in my heart.

title: Odes of Solomon
text: And I placed my name upon their head, because they are free and they are mine. Hallelujah.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El Señor está en mi cabeza como una corona, y nunca estaré sin Él.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Platizado para mí es la corona de la verdad, y causó que Sus ramas florecieran en mí.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque no es como una corona que no florece;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque Tú vives sobre mi cabeza, y has florecido sobre mí.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Sus frutos están llenos y completos; están llenos de Su salvación...

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Este odo está desaparecido; ningún texto ha sobrevivido.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: ... Estoy poniendo el amor del Señor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y sus miembros están con Él, y yo soy dependiente de ellos; y Él me ama.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque no debería haber sabido amar al Señor, si Él no me hubiera amado continuamente.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: ¿Quién es capaz de distinguir el amor, excepto el que es amado?

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Me encanta el Amado y yo mismo lo amo, y donde Su resto es, yo también.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y no seré extraño, porque no hay celos con el Señor Altísimo y Misericordioso.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: He estado unido a Él, porque el amante ha encontrado al Amado, porque yo amo al que es el Hijo, me convertiré en un hijo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: De hecho, el que se une a Aquel que es inmortal, verdaderamente será inmortal.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y el que se deleita en la Vida se volverá vivo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Este es el Espíritu del Señor, que no es falso, que enseña a los hijos de los hombres a conocer sus caminos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Sé sabio y comprensivo y despierto. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Ningún hombre puede pervertido Tu lugar santo, Dios mío, ni puede cambiarlo, y ponerlo en otro lugar.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque no tiene poder sobre él; para Tu santuario Diseñaste antes de que hicieras lugares especiales.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El antiguo no será pervertido por aquellos que son inferiores a él. Has dado Tu corazón, Señor, a tus creyentes.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Nunca. Tú estás ocioso, ni estarás sin frutos;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Por una hora de Su fe es más excelente que todos los días y años.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque ¿quién pondrá tu gracia y será rechazado?

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque... Tu sello es conocido; y Tus criaturas son conocidas.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y sus anfitriones lo poseen, y los arcángeles elegidos están vestidos con él.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Nos has dado tu compañerismo, no que estuvieras en necesidad de nosotros, sino que siempre estamos necesitados de ti.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Ducha sobre nosotros Tu suave lluvia, y abre tus abundantes manantiales que abundantemente nos suministran leche y miel.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque no hay arrepentimiento contigo; que debes arrepentirte de todo lo que has prometido;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Desde que el resultado se manifestó a Ti.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Por lo que diste, diste libremente, de modo que ya no volverás a dibujar y tomarlos de nuevo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque todo fue manifestado a Ti como Dios, y fue puesto en orden desde el principio delante de Ti.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y tú, oh Señor, has hecho todo. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Te alaba, Señor, porque te amo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Altísimo, no me abandones, porque eres mi esperanza.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Libremente he recibido tu gracia, que viva por ella.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Mis perseguidores vendrán pero no me vean.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Que una nube de oscuridad caiga sobre sus ojos; y que un aire de oscuridad espesa los oculte.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y que no tengan luz para ver, para que no puedan apoderarse de mí.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Que sus diseños se endurezcan, para que todo lo que hayan conspirado vuelva sobre sus propias cabezas.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque han ideado un plan, pero no fue para ellos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Se prepararon malintencionadamente, pero se encontraron impotentes.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Ciertamente mi confianza está sobre el Señor, y no temeré.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y porque el Señor es mi salvación, no temeré.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y él es como una corona tejida sobre mi cabeza, y no seré sacudido.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Aunque todo sea sacudido, estaré firme.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y aunque todas las cosas visibles perezcan, no moriré;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque el Señor está conmigo, y yo con Él. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Mientras el viento se desliza por el arpa y las cuerdas hablan,

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Así el Espíritu del Señor habla a través de mis miembros, y hablo a través de Su amor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque Él destruye lo que es extranjero, y todo es del Señor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque así fue desde el principio, y será hasta el fin.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Para que nada sea contrario, y nada se levantará contra Él.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El Señor ha multiplicado su conocimiento, y Él fue celoso de que esas cosas sean conocidas que a través de Su gracia se nos ha dado.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y su alabanza Él nos dio a causa de Su nombre, nuestros espíritus alaban Su Espíritu Santo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque salió un arroyo, y se convirtió en un río grande y ancho; de hecho lo llevó todo, y lo destrozó y lo llevó al Templo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y las barreras que fueron construidas por los hombres no pudieron contenerla, ni siquiera las artes de aquellos que habitualmente restringen el agua.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque se extendió sobre la superficie de toda la tierra, y llenó todo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Entonces toda la sed sobre la tierra bebía, y la sed era aliviada y apagada;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Para el Altísimo se dio la bebida.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Bienaventurados, pues, los ministros de esa bebida, que han sido confiados con Su agua.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Ellos han refrescado los labios empapados, y han despertado la voluntad paralizada.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Incluso las personas que estaban a punto de expirar, han retenido de la muerte.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y las extremidades que han colapsado, han restaurado y establecido.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Ellos dieron fuerza para su venida, y luz para sus ojos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque todos los reconocieron como el Señor, y vivían junto al agua viva de la eternidad. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Como es el curso de la ira sobre la maldad, así es el curso de la alegría sobre los Amados; y trae de sus frutos sin obstáculos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Mi alegría es el Señor y mi curso es hacia Él, este camino mío es hermoso.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque hay un Ayudante para mí, el Señor. Él se ha mostrado generosamente a mí en Su simplicidad, porque Su bondad ha disminuido Su temor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Se hizo como yo, para recibirlo. En forma Él era considerado como yo, para ponerlo en.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y no temblé cuando lo vi, porque Él era amable conmigo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Como mi naturaleza Se convirtió en él, para poder entenderlo. Y como mi forma, para no alejarme de Él.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El Padre del conocimiento es la Palabra del conocimiento.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El que creó la sabiduría es más sabio que Sus obras.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y el que me creó cuando aún no sabía lo que haría cuando entré en ser.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: A causa de esto Él era bondadoso conmigo en Su abundante gracia, y me permitió pedir de Él y beneficiarse de Su sacrificio.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Para Él es quien es incorrupto, la perfección de los mundos y su Padre.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Él le ha permitido aparecer a los que son suyos; para que puedan reconocer al que los hizo, y no suponen que ellos vinieron de sí mismos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Para alcanzar el conocimiento Él ha puesto Su camino, lo ha ensanchado y lo ha alargado y lo ha llevado a la perfección completa.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y ha puesto sobre él las huellas de Su luz, y procedió desde el principio hasta el final.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque por Él fue servido, y Él fue complacido por el Hijo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y por su salvación Él poseerá todo. Y el Altísimo será conocido por Sus santos:

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Para anunciar a los que tienen canciones de la venida del Señor, que puedan salir a reunirse con Él y cantarle con alegría y con el arpa de muchos tonos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Los videntes irán delante de él, y serán vistos delante de él.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y alabarán al Señor en Su amor, porque Él está cerca y ve.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y el odio será quitado de la tierra, y con celos será ahogado.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque la ignorancia fue destruida sobre ella, porque el conocimiento del Señor llegó sobre ella.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Que los cantantes canten la gracia del Señor Altísimo, y que traigan sus canciones.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y que su corazón sea como el día, y sus suaves voces como la majestuosa belleza del Señor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y no haya nadie que respire sin conocimiento ni voz.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Para Él dio una boca a Su creación: para abrir la voz de la boca hacia Él, y para alabarle.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Confess Su poder y declara Su gracia. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Abre, abre tus corazones a la exultación del Señor, y deja que tu amor abunde de corazón a los labios.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Para dar frutos al Señor, una vida santa, y hablar con vigilancia en su luz.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Levántate y ponte erguido, tú que a veces fuiste bajado.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Tú que estabas en silencio, habla, porque tu boca ha sido abierta.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Ustedes que fueron despreciados, desde ahora sean levantados, porque su justicia ha sido levantada;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque la diestra del Señor está contigo, y Él será tu Ayudante.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y la paz estaba preparada para ti, antes de lo que pudiera ser tu guerra.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Escucha la palabra de verdad, y recibe el conocimiento del Altísimo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Tu carne no puede entender lo que estoy a punto de decirte; ni tu vestido lo que estoy a punto de mostrarte.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Mantén mi misterio, los que están guardados por él; guarda mi fe, los que están guardados por ella.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y comprended mi conocimiento, vosotros que me conocéis en verdad; amadme con afecto, vosotros que amáis;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque no me vuelvo la cara por mi cuenta, porque los conozco.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y antes de que existieran, los reconocí; e imprimí un sello en sus rostros.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Modié a sus miembros, y mis propios pechos les preparé, para que beban mi leche santa y vivan junto a ella.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Estoy complacido por ellos, y no estoy avergonzado por ellos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Por mi trabajo son ellos, y la fuerza de mis pensamientos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Por lo tanto, ¿quién puede oponerse a mi trabajo? ¿O quién no está sujeto a ellos?

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Me desgarré y desperté la mente y el corazón, y ellos son míos. Y en mi mano derecha he puesto mis elegidos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y mi justicia va delante de ellos, y no serán privados de mi nombre; porque está con ellos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Oren y aumenten, y permanezcan en el amor del Señor;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y vosotros que fuisteis amados en el Amado, y vosotros que estáis guardados en el que vive, y vosotros que sois salvos en el que fue salvo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y os encontraréis incorruptos en todas las edades, por el nombre de vuestro Padre. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Abre tus oídos, y te hablaré.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Dame, para que yo también te dé.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: La palabra del Señor y sus deseos, el pensamiento santo que Él ha pensado en Su Mesías.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque en la voluntad del Señor es vuestra vida, y Su propósito es vida eterna, y vuestra perfección es incorruptible.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Enriquezcan en Dios Padre; y reciban el propósito del Altísimo. Ser fuerte y redimido por Su gracia.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque os anuncio paz, Sus santos, para que ninguno de los que oyen caiga en la guerra.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y también los que han conocido Él no puede perecer, y para que los que le recibieron no se avergüencen.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Una corona eterna es la Verdad; bienaventurados los que la pusieron en su cabeza.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Es una piedra preciosa, porque las guerras eran a causa de la corona.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Pero la justicia lo ha tomado, y te lo ha dado.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Ponga la corona en el verdadero pacto del Señor, y todos los que han conquistado serán inscritos en Su libro.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque su libro es la recompensa de la victoria que es para ti, y ella te ve delante de ella y te quiere que seas salvo. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El Señor ha dirigido mi boca por Su Palabra, y ha abierto mi corazón por Su Luz.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y ha causado morar en mí Su vida inmortal, y me ha permitido proclamar el fruto de Su paz.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Convertir las vidas de aquellos que desean venir a Él, y llevar a aquellos que son cautivos a la libertad.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Tomé coraje y me hice fuerte y capturó el mundo, y la cautividad se convirtió en mía para la gloria del Altísimo, y de Dios mi Padre.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y los gentiles que habían sido dispersos se juntaron, pero no fui contaminado por mi amor por ellos, porque me habían alabado en lugares altos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y los vestigios de luz se pusieron sobre su corazón, y anduvieron según mi vida y fueron salvos, y se convirtieron en mi pueblo para siempre y para siempre. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Mi corazón fue podado y su flor apareció, entonces la gracia surgió en ella, y mi corazón produjo frutos para el Señor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque el Altísimo me circuncidó por Su Espíritu Santo, entonces descubrió mi interior hacia Él, y me llenó de Su amor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y su circuncisión se convirtió en mi salvación, y corrí en el Camino, en Su paz, en el camino de la verdad.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Desde el principio hasta el final recibí Su conocimiento.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y fui establecido sobre la roca de la verdad, donde Él me había puesto.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y las aguas hablantes tocaron mis labios de la fuente del Señor generosamente.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y así bebí y me intoxicé, del agua viva que no muere.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y mi intoxicación no causó ignorancia, pero abandoné la vanidad,

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y se volvió hacia el Altísimo, Dios mío, y fue enriquecido por Sus favores.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y rechacé la necedad echada sobre la tierra, y la despojé y la echó de mí.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y el Señor me renovó con Su vestido, y me poseyó por Su luz.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y desde arriba Él me dio reposo inmortal, y me convertí en la tierra que florece y se regocija en sus frutos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y el Señor es como el sol sobre la faz de la tierra.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Mis ojos fueron iluminados, y mi rostro recibió el rocío;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y mi aliento fue refrescado por la agradable fragancia del Señor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y Él me llevó a Su Paraíso, donde está la riqueza del placer del Señor. Miré árboles florecientes y frutales, y el autocreciente era su corona. Sus ramas estaban brotando y sus frutos brillaban. De una tierra inmortal eran sus raíces. Y un río de alegría los regaba, Y alrededor de ellos en la tierra de la vida eterna.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Entonces adoraba al Señor por Su magnificencia.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y dije: Bienaventurados, oh Señor, son los que están plantados en Tu tierra, y que tienen un lugar en Tu Paraíso;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y que crecen en el crecimiento de Tus árboles, y han pasado de la oscuridad a la luz.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: He aquí, todos tus obreros son justos, los que obran buenas obras, y se vuelven de la maldad a tu agrado.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Para el olor pungente de los árboles se cambia en su tierra,

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y todo se convierte en un remanente de ti mismo. Bienaventurados los obreros de Tus aguas, y memorias eternas de Tus siervos fieles.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: De hecho, hay mucho espacio en Tu Paraíso. Y no hay nada en él que sea estéril, pero todo está lleno de fruta.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Gloria a ti, oh Dios, el placer del Paraíso para siempre. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Él me ha llenado de palabras de verdad, para que pueda proclamarlo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y como el flujo de aguas, la verdad fluye de mi boca, y mis labios declaran Sus frutos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y Él ha hecho que Su conocimiento abunde en mí, porque la boca del Señor es la verdadera Palabra, y la entrada de Su luz.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y el Altísimo le ha dado a Sus generaciones, que son los intérpretes de Su belleza, Y los narradores de Su gloria, Y los confesores de Su propósito, Y los predicadores de Su mente, Y los maestros de Sus obras.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque la sutileza de la Palabra es inexpresible, y como Su pronunciación también es Su rapidez y Su agudeza, porque ilimitada es Su progresión.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Él nunca cae sino permanece de pie, y uno no puede comprender Su descenso o Su camino.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque como Su obra es, así es Su expectativa, porque Él es la luz y el amanecer del pensamiento.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y por Él las generaciones se hablaron entre sí, y los que eran silenciosos adquirieron discurso.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y de Él vino amor e igualdad, y se hablaron uno a otro aquello que era suyo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y fueron estimulados por la Palabra, y conocieron al que los hizo, porque estaban en armonía.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque la boca del Altísimo les habló, y su exposición prosperó a través de Él.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque la morada de la Palabra es hombre, y Su verdad es amor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Bienaventurados los que por medio de Él han percibido todo, y han conocido al Señor en Su verdad. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: He aquí, el Señor es nuestro espejo. Abre tus ojos y míralos en Él.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y aprende la manera de tu rostro, luego declara alabanzas a Su Espíritu.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y limpia la pintura de tu rostro, y ama Su santidad y ponla.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Entonces serás sin mancha en todo momento con Él. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Como ojos de un hijo sobre su padre, así son mis ojos, oh Señor, en todo momento hacia ti.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque mis pechos y mi placer están contigo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: No te apartes de mí tus misericordias, oh Señor; y no me quites tu bondad.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Extiende a mí, mi Señor, en todo momento, tu mano derecha, y séme un guía hasta el final según tu voluntad.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Permítanme ser agradables ante ustedes, debido a su gloria, y debido a su nombre permítanme ser salvo del Maligno.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y tu dulzura, Señor, permanece conmigo, y los frutos de tu amor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Enséñame los odos de tu verdad, para que pueda producir frutos en ti.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y ábreme el arpa de tu Espíritu Santo, para que con cada nota te alabare, oh Señor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y conforme a la multitud de tus misericordias, así concédeme, y apresúrate a conceder nuestras peticiones.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque eres suficiente para todas nuestras necesidades. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Como el sol es la alegría de los que buscan su amanecer, así es mi alegría el Señor;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque... Él es mi Sol, y Sus rayos me han levantado; y Su luz ha desechado toda oscuridad de mi rostro.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Ojos que he obtenido en Él, y he visto Su día santo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Orejas que he adquirido, y he oído Su verdad.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El pensamiento del conocimiento que he adquirido, y he disfrutado del placer por completo a través de Él.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Yo repudié el camino del error, y fui hacia Él y recibí la salvación de Él abundantemente.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y según Su generosidad Me dio, y según su excelente belleza Me hizo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Puse la inmortalidad a través de Su nombre, y quité la corrupción por Su gracia.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: La muerte ha sido destruida antes de mi cara, y Sheol ha sido vencido por mi palabra.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y la vida eterna ha surgido en la tierra del Señor, y ha sido declarada a Sus fieles, y ha sido dada sin límite a todos los que confían en Él. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Como la ocupación del arado es el arado, y la ocupación del helmsman es la dirección del barco, así también mi ocupación es el salmo del Señor por Sus himnos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Mi arte y mi servicio están en Sus himnos, porque Su amor ha nutrido mi corazón, y Sus frutos Derramó a mis labios.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque mi amor es el Señor; por eso le cantaré.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque he sido fortalecido por Sus alabanzas, y tengo fe en Él.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Abriré mi boca, y Su Espíritu hablará por mí la gloria del Señor y su belleza,

title: Odas de Salomón
text: La obra de Sus manos, y el trabajo de Sus dedos;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Por la multitud de Sus misericordias, y la fuerza de Su Palabra.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque la Palabra del Señor investiga lo invisible, y revela Su pensamiento.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque el ojo ve Sus obras, y el oído oye Su pensamiento.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Es Él quien hizo la tierra ancha, y puso las aguas en el mar.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Él expandió el cielo, y arregló las estrellas.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y Él arregló la creación y la arregló, entonces Él reposó de Sus obras.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y las cosas creadas funcionan según sus cursos, y trabajan sus obras, porque nunca pueden cesar ni fracasar.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y los anfitriones están sujetos a Su Palabra.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El embalse de la luz es el sol, y el embalse de la oscuridad es la noche.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Para Hizo el sol para el día para que sea luz; pero la noche trae oscuridad sobre la faz de la tierra.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y por su porción uno de otro completan la belleza de Dios.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y no hay nada fuera del Señor, porque Él estaba antes de que nada llegara a ser.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y los mundos son por Su Palabra, y por el pensamiento de Su corazón.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Alabanza y honor a Su nombre. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Entonces fui coronado por mi Dios, y mi corona estaba viviendo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y fui justificado por mi Señor, porque mi salvación es incorruptible.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: He sido liberado de vanidades, y no estoy condenado.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Mis cadenas fueron cortadas por Sus manos, recibí la cara y semejanza de una nueva persona, y caminé en Él y fui salvado.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y el pensamiento de la verdad me llevó, y fui tras ella y no vagué.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y todos los que me vieron estaban sorprendidos, y les parecía un extraño.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y el que me conoció y exaltó, es el Altísimo en toda su perfección.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y me glorificaba por Su bondad, y levantó mi entendimiento a la altura de la verdad.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y desde allí Me dio el camino de Sus pasos, y abrí las puertas cerradas.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y destrocé las barras de hierro, porque mis propios grilletes habían crecido calientes y derribados delante de mí.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y nada me pareció cerrado, porque yo era la apertura de todo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y me dirigí hacia todos mis ataduras para soltarlos; para que no dejara a nadie atado ni atado.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y yo di mi conocimiento generosamente, y mi resurrección a través de mi amor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y sembró mis frutos en los corazones, y los transformé por mí mismo.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Entonces recibieron mi bendición y vivieron, y se reunieron para mí y fueron salvados;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque se convirtieron en mis miembros, y yo era su Cabeza.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Gloria a ti, nuestra cabeza, Señor Mesías. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Mi corazón fue levantado y enriquecido en el amor del Altísimo, para que pueda alabarle con mi nombre.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Mis miembros fueron fortalecidos, para que no caigan de Su poder.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Las enfermedades huyeron de mi cuerpo, y era firme para el Señor por Su voluntad; porque Su reino es firme.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Señor, por el bien de los que están necesitados, no me desestimes tu palabra.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Tampoco, por el bien de sus obras, retener tu perfección de mí.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Que la luz no sea conquistada por la oscuridad, ni que la verdad huya de la falsedad.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Deja que Tu mano derecha ponga nuestra salvación a la victoria, y déjala recibir de cada región, y preservarla en el lado de todos los que son asediados por desgracias.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Tú eres mi Dios, la falsedad y la muerte no están en Tu boca; sólo la perfección es Tu voluntad.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y vanidad No lo sabes, porque tampoco te conoce.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y no sabes el error, porque tampoco te conoce.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y la ignorancia parecía polvo, y como la espuma del mar.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y la gente vana pensó que era genial, y se volvieron como su tipo y fueron empobrecidos.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Pero los que conocían entendían y contemplaban, y no estaban contaminados por sus pensamientos;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque estaban en la mente del Altísimo, y se burlaban de los que caminaban en error.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Luego hablaron la verdad, desde el aliento que el Altísimo les inspiró.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Alabado y gran honor a Su nombre. Aleluya.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Una taza de leche me fue ofrecida, y la bebí en la dulzura de la bondad del Señor.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El Hijo es la copa, y el Padre es Aquel que fue ordeño; y el Espíritu Santo es Ella quien le ordeño;

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Porque... Sus pechos estaban llenos, y era indeseable que Su leche fuera liberada ineficazmente.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El Espíritu Santo abrió Su seno, y mezcló la leche de los dos senos del Padre.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Entonces Ella dio la mezcla a la generación sin su conocimiento, y los que la han recibido están en la perfección de la mano derecha.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: El vientre de la Virgen la tomó, y ella recibió la concepción y dio a luz.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Así que la Virgen se convirtió en madre con grandes misericordias.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y ella trabajó y llevó al Hijo, pero sin dolor, porque no ocurrió sin propósito.

title: Odas de Salomón
text: Y no requirió una partera, porque la hizo dar vida.

title: Odas de Salomón
